ResearchProjectDef.label: noble apparel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor noble-specific apparel like formal shirts and top hats.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->crafted formal corsetry for urbworld student graduations
subject_story->was employed by a noble house to shape its top hats
subject_story->invented a new style of beret that was all the rage for an entire season

ResearchProjectDef.label: royal apparel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor royal apparel of the highest tier, like royal robes and crowns.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->worked for an entire year to create royal robes for a coronation
subject_story->studied the heraldric requirements of different noble groups to ensure any outfits were appropriate
subject_story->was raised to the Imperial nobility and commissioned their own robes and coronet

ResearchProjectDef.label: cataphract armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft cataphract armor, heavy powered armor that slows the user but which can absorb extreme punishment. Note that these also require advanced components.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->first developed [ANYPAWN_possessive] cataphract-equivalent armor as a method of exploring active volcanoes
subject_story->was commissioned to produce custom sets of cataphract armor for Imperial boarding parties
subject_story->fought with the rebels and studied the armor of a captured cataphract

ResearchProjectDef.label: jump packs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build jump packs to perform aerial assaults during combat.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->operated an entertainment park focused on extreme experiences, including boomrat petting and jump pack courses
subject_story->ran mountaineering tours on low-grav planets, where jump packs and oxygen masks were mandatory
subject_story->bypassed the turret defenses of officer training with a jump pack assault

ResearchProjectDef.label: gunlink
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build wearable gunlinks to enhance your soldiers' shooting accuracy.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->converted a glitterworld ocular implant into a more generic targeting computer
subject_story->was happy at the performance of the factory's gunlinks, though the increased death rate due to helmet loss was troubling
subject_story->bulk-purchased gunlinks for the snipers in the army, forbidding them to front-line soldiers

ResearchProjectDef.label: brain wiring
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft brain implants that induce or prevent blunt sensations like joy or pain.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->wrote a paper about the masochist cults use of mindscrews to improve their morale
subject_story->implanted painstoppers in an assault squad. They eliminated a much larger force, but were all mortally wounded or killed
subject_story->had a joywire installed and, though happy after that, stumbled simply through life

ResearchProjectDef.label: specialized limbs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft specialized bionic limbs built for specific purposes - both combat and labor.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->interviewed the indentured farmers of a feudal world, before and after their field hand installations
subject_story->watched a pit fighter equipped with a power claw face off against a miner with two drill arms
subject_story->worked as a surgeon on the rim, replacing missing arms with everything from a woodhand to a power claw

ResearchProjectDef.label: compact weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft compact, concealable bionic weapons which can be embedded in various body parts.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->was employed as a detective and was saved more than once by the concealed knee spike
subject_story->spent a summer recovering from being slashed by an escaped slave's hand talon
subject_story->was working in security, scanning visitors to the hall, when the cyborg attempted to enter

ResearchProjectDef.label: poison synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionics that synthesize venom from internal chemical reactors for use in toxifying attacks.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->worked on chemical reactors at small scales, which could be shrunk and stored internally
subject_story->studied the waste rats of a trash world and wrote a paper on the unique toxins in their bite
subject_story->learned to love sharp little cutting edges, which could kill with a mere nick

ResearchProjectDef.label: artificial metabolism
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionics that process food more safely or efficiently than a biological stomach.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->developed a hunger so all-consuming that the installation of an artificial stomach was the only solution
subject_story->did not tell the Queen about the installation of the sterilizing stomach, but continued as her food tester all the same
subject_story->developed a loathing for food. A nuclear stomach heavily reduced food consumption, though the radioactivity was a nuisance

ResearchProjectDef.label: neural computation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft brain implants that assist thought and learning by use of a direct, shallow brain-computer interface.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->knew exactly how to take out the jailor, with an EMP attack that would brain shock their learning assistant, buying time to free the prisoners
subject_story->mandated the installation of learning assistants or neurocalculators through the entire faculty
subject_story->had a learning assistant installed. It proved to be a problem later, when captured by pirates, who halted any escape attempts with EMP attacks

ResearchProjectDef.label: skin hardening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionic implants which induce the toughening of natural skin, producing an armor-like effect.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->researched the glands of the barkskin dryads and reasoned they could be adapted to humanity
subject_story->traveled among the stoneskin tamers of the dinoworld, studying the thick keratin plates that covered them
subject_story->worked with nanonmachine glands to thicken the human epidermis, at the expense of meeting traditional standards of beauty

ResearchProjectDef.label: healing factors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionics that enhance natural healing processes.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->studied the Imperial royalty, to see if they had blue blood. They did not, but it did coagulate implausibly quickly
subject_story->ensured that all the pit fighters had Healing Enhancers and appropriate xenogerms, so that they could fight more often
subject_story->studied the ancient corpses found in a cryptosleep shrine and harvested rapid healing devices from them

ResearchProjectDef.label: flesh shaping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionics which induce the reshaping of natural flesh, usually for the purposes of aesthetic enhancement or personal pleasure.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->halted the population decline on the urbworld, by distributing free love enhancers and lavish drugs
subject_story->was hired as chief flesh-shaper for an aesthetics clinic, spending [ANYPAWN_possessive] days making shapely limbs
subject_story->gathered the glitterworld children around the campfire and told horror stories about getting their non-aesthetic noses back

ResearchProjectDef.label: molecular analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft bionics with molecular analyzers for assisting the immune system or analyzing food.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->explained to the chefs of the cooking school that they must never get aesthetic noses, lest their gastro-analyzers fail
subject_story->had an immunoenhancer installed and so was able to walk freely in the isolation colony
subject_story->lectured on the potential hardware conflicts between bionic parts and molecular analysis implants

ResearchProjectDef.label: circadian influence
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft brain implants that chemically manipulate the circadian rhythm, reducing or altering the need to sleep.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->studied unihemispheric sleep patterns in cetaceans and proposed a new form of circadian half-cycler
subject_story->forced any applicants for city guard to receive a half-cycler, so they could stay at post indefinitely, if necessary
subject_story->studied bullfrogs and giraffes to ascertain what xenogerms would be necessary for a circadian assistance gland

ResearchProjectDef.label: harp
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the harp, a simple stationary musical instrument popular among nobility in some cultures.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->trained in the school of music
subject_story->constructed a harp from common feral world materials
subject_story->performed a harp solo for the Imperial nobility
subject_story->researched the cultural significance of stringed instrument usage

ResearchProjectDef.label: harpsichord
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the harpsichord, a complex stationary musical instrument.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->led a renaissance in the harpsichord in the coreworld systems
subject_story->tuned harpsichords for concert use on Glitterworlds
subject_story->took up a role as lead harpischordist for the local philharmonic
subject_story->constructed dual-keyboard harpsichords focused on harmonics

ResearchProjectDef.label: piano
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the piano, an advanced stationary musical instrument.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->was acquainted with the entire corpus of stringed instruments
subject_story->joined a music academy, where the students learned about composers as much as the piano itself
subject_story->recorded the techniques of several master pianists

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: recharge psyfocus
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: the psyfocus of all participants will be recharged to full.
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.letterInfoText: The psyfocus of all participants has been fully recharged.

RitualBehaviorDef.letterText: {ORGANIZER_labelShort} is giving a speech from the throne. \nIf all goes well, listeners will feel inspired, and gain respect for {ORGANIZER_labelShort}. If it goes poorly, the speech will do social damage. The outcome depends on {ORGANIZER_labelShort}'s social abilities.

li.label: linker
li.noCandidatesGizmoDesc: Need a colonist with the natural meditation focus type who is below maximum psylink level and not psychically deaf.
li.customChildDisallowMessage: Only adults can link with an anima tree.

RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: Depending on ritual quality, the bestowee gets up to 3 bonus honor. Other participants get up to +6 mood boost for 6 days.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: steel drop
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call for a drop of 250 steel.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: food drop
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call for a drop of 20 packaged survival meals.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: silver drop
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call for a drop of 500 silver.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: glitter med drop
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call for a drop of 5 glitterworld medicine.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call laborer team
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a group of 4 laborers to assist you for 4 days. These workers can only do general labor tasks. You can control them as though they were your own colonists. You are required to keep them safe.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call laborer gang
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a group of 8 laborers to assist you for 4 days. These workers can only do general labor tasks. You can control them as though they were your own colonists. You are required to keep them safe.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call trooper squad
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a group of 4 light troopers to aid you in battle.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call janissary squad
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a group of 4 professional janissaries to aid you in battle.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call cataphract squad
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a group of 4 heavy cataphracts to aid you in battle.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call aerodrone strike
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a single-impact aerodrone strike at a target position.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call aerodrone salvo
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a salvo of aerodrone strikes around a target position.

RoyalTitlePermitDef.label: call transport shuttle
RoyalTitlePermitDef.description: Call a shuttle for your own use. It will transport colonists, items, and animals anywhere you like within 70 world tiles.

RoyalTitleDef.label: freeholder
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of freeholder is used by the Empire to signifies a fully-respected individual. Most Imperial citizens earn it while young through volunteer work or military service. The title is also offered to outsiders who act with honor in the eyes of the Empire.

RoyalTitleDef.label: novice
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of novice is held by those who have recently been initiated into the ranks of the psychic cult. It gives the holder the right to use low-level psychic abilities as part of their learning.\n\nThis title is often held by senior soldiers, warskiff pilots, spies, advisors, diplomats, intrusion operatives, and other key individuals. Many important people spend their entire lives as novices.

RoyalTitleDef.label: acolyte
RoyalTitleDef.description: The title of acolyte is the title of senior learners in the psychic cult, and encompasses a wide range of practical positions. Some acolytes are purely students, learning to lead troops, manage societies, or use psycasts in specialized schools. Others come from wealthy families and might own city buildings or farm complexes.\n\nDuring wartime, an acolyte might lead a platoon of troops, captain a small frigate, or serve their liege as an advisor.

RoyalTitleDef.label: knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: The title of knight is held by agents of the psychic cult who have fully passed their training, but who have not ascended to higher leadership roles. Many knights never advance further, and spend their lives as respected warriors, advisors, or commanders.\n\nIn war, some knights lead troop companies and assault squadrons, while psychic-focused knights engage in espionage, sabotage, and battlefield psychic combat.

RoyalTitleDef.label: praetor
RoyalTitleDef.description: The title of praetor is denotes a member of the psychic cult who carries out field missions in a more senior role than a mere knight. Praetors often act alone, but may also command knights and lower members.\n\nDuring peacetime, a praetor will usually manage a city district, asteroid sector, or agricultural region. During war, they take authority over the smallest independent combat units - terrestrial troop cohorts, or space-borne destroyers or combat groups.

RoyalTitleDef.label: baron
RoyalTitleDef.description: The title of baron is the lowest of the psychic lords who can act as a semi-independent ruler. Most barons are subordinate to a higher lord. The baron is obliged to provide both personal service as a warrior or advisor, and economic support like money and troops.\n\nIn the Empire, a baron will typically own a city sector, mining colony, or similar outfit. At wartime, a baron may captain a capital ship in name, or control a regiment of soldiers.

RoyalTitleDef.label: archon
RoyalTitleDef.description: The title of archon is middle rank among the independent members of the psychic cult.\n\nIn peacetime, an archon may rule to a city or colony. A successful archon might have a small personal fleet, possibly including capital ships.

RoyalTitleDef.label: dominus
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of dominus is the highest of the middle-ranked independent rulers.\n\nIn the Empire, domini control provinces, mega-cities, or moons. At war, a dominus can field a division-level force, or a fleet with capital ships and dozens of support craft.

RoyalTitleDef.label: consul
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of consul is a lower level of high nobility.\n\nIn the Empire, consuls control planets. At war, a consul can usually field an army-sized force of multiple divisions, supported by several fleets. Some command from a super-capital ship or control space-based megastructures.

RoyalTitleDef.label: stellarch
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of stellarch represents dominion over an entire star system.\n\nIn the Empire, since interstellar travel times are years long, stellarchs rule their systems with a great degree of independence. They each swear fealty to the Emperor, but since the Emperor may be many light-years away, a stellarch may go years or decades without interacting with him.

RoyalTitleDef.label: emperor
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Imperial title of emperor indicates sovereign dominion over the entire Empire, all its peoples, planets, and fleets. All other lords swear fealty to a high lord, while the Emperor swears fealty to no one. However, even the Emperor depends on the support of lower nobles to remain in power.

li.label: Received {TITLE} title
li.description: I have been given the title of {TITLE}. I love the recognition!

li.label: Lost {TITLE} title
li.description: I lost my {TITLE} title.

li.label: want {TITLE_label}-specific apparel
li.description: {TITLE_indefinite} like myself should be covered in apparel appropriate to my stature:\n\n{0}

li.label: want {TITLE_label}-quality apparel
li.description: {TITLE_indefinite} like myself should only wear apparel of {QUALITY} quality or better.

li.label: undignified throneroom
li.description: I am {TITLE_indefinite} and I should have these items in my throneroom:\n\n{0}

li.label: undignified bedroom
li.description: {TITLE_indefinite} like myself deserves a bedroom that meets these requirements:\n\n{0}

li.label: no throne room
li.description: What is a royal with no throneroom?

li.label: no personal bedroom
li.description: {TITLE_indefinite} should have a personal bedroom.

SitePartDef.Name: SitePart_MechCluster
SitePartDef.label: mech cluster
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There is a cluster of hostile mechanoids and their combat support structures in this area.\n\nThe cluster can include artillery, turrets, combat mechanoids, and other support and defense structures.

SitePartDef.label: raid source
SitePartDef.description: A guarded military staging area which sends periodic raids.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There is an enemy outpost in this area.

StatDef.label: Jump range
StatDef.description: The maximum jump distance.

StatDef.label: meditation plant growth offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to the growth rate of plants, like anima grass, from meditation. This value can change based on the number of artificial buildings nearby.

StatDef.label: neural heat gain
StatDef.description: A multiplier on neural heat gained from any source.

rulesStrings.li: desc_sentence->There's a cheerful vibe in the air.
image->[ORGANIZER_nameFull] inviting the crowd to sing along

TerrainTemplateDef.label: fine carpet ({0})
TerrainTemplateDef.description: Luxurious, ornately-patterned carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. Beautiful to look at, but cleaning it is a labor-intensive process.

TerrainDef.Name: FineTileStoneBase
TerrainDef.description: Exquisite stone tiles, made with no compromises, for expressing economic status. Slow to construct.

ThingDef.label: sun blocker
ThingDef.description: An ultratech machine that generates a sheet of exotic fields at high altitude, turning the sky opaque and blocking the sun.

GameConditionDef.label: sun blocked
GameConditionDef.description: A nearby sun blocker machine is turning the upper atmosphere opaque, blocking the sun.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A sun blocker machine has begun blocking the sun.

SitePartDef.label: sun blocker
SitePartDef.description: A sun blocker machine which turns the sky opaque.

ThingDef.label: smoke spewer
ThingDef.description: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. By harvesting available compounds and converting them into self-reproducing opaque molecules, it can spew enough smoke to block the sun in a whole region of the planet.

GameConditionDef.label: giant smoke cloud
GameConditionDef.description: A nearby smoke spewer is reducing sunlight in this region.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A smoke spewer machine has begun obscuring the sun.

ThingDef.label: toxic spewer
ThingDef.description: An ultratech weapon of mass destruction designed for area denial. This device harvests available compounds and converts them into self-reproducing poisons. By spewing these into the atmosphere, it can poison a whole region of the planet.

GameConditionDef.label: toxic spewer
GameConditionDef.description: A nearby toxic spewer is blanketing this whole region with poison.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A toxic spewer machine has begun blanketing the whole region with poison.

ThingDef.label: weather controller
ThingDef.description: An ultratech device for controlling weather. Using chemicals and exotic fields, it forces the weather into a particular configuration.

GameConditionDef.label: forced weather
GameConditionDef.description: A nearby weather controller is forcing the weather into this configuration.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a weather-control system will force the weather around [map_definite] to be [forcedWeather_indefinite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The weather controller is no longer changing the weather.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A weather controller machine has begun affecting the weather.

ThingDef.label: climate adjuster
ThingDef.description: An ultratech device for controlling climate. Using chemicals and exotic fields to manipulate the atmosphere, it shifts the temperature in this region of the world.

GameConditionDef.label: climate adjustment
GameConditionDef.description: A nearby climate adjuster is shifting the temperature.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A climate adjuster machine has begun shifting the temperature.

ThingDef.label: psychic droner
ThingDef.description: An archotech device transmitting the thoughts of a mad superintelligence. It generates a massive psychic drone tuned to one gender and affecting a whole region of the planet. People of that gender will be disturbed by the effect, reducing their mood and possibly driving them insane. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: psychic suppressor
ThingDef.description: An archotech device that generates a massive psychic suppression field tuned to a particular gender. People of that gender have their psychic activity suppressed, reducing their consciousness. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.

HediffDef.label: psychic suppression
HediffDef.description: The effect of a psychic suppression field. Coordination and reasoning are muddled.

GameConditionDef.label: psychic suppression
GameConditionDef.description: A psychic suppression field is affecting {0}s and reducing their consciousness. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a psychic suppression wave will reduce the consciousness of all [psychicSuppressorGender]s around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The psychic suppressor field has dissipated.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A psychic suppressor field has begun reducing the consciousness of {0}s across the whole region. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: EMI dynamo
ThingDef.description: A massive electromagnetic interference generator. It interferes with or shuts down electrical devices in nearby regions.

GameConditionDef.label: EMI field
GameConditionDef.description: An electromagnetic interference dynamo is projecting an EM interference field, disabling electrical devices.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a distant EMI dynamo will blast [map_definite] with an EMI field, shutting down electrical devices for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
GameConditionDef.letterText: An EMI field has been generated. It is disabling electrical devices.

ThingDef.label: burnout low-shield
ThingDef.description: A man-portable low-angle shield projector. Bullets can go out, but not in. Its compact power source burns out after a few seconds of use.

ThingDef.label: drape
ThingDef.description: A decorative sheet hanging from a vertical wooden frame. Appropriate for royal rooms.

ThingDef.Name: Brazier
ThingDef.label: brazier
ThingDef.description: A bowl-shaped furnishing used to hold a fire. Will light the surroundings and create heat.

ThingDef.label: darklight brazier
ThingDef.description: A specially treated brazier that illuminates its surroundings with darklight and creates heat. These satisfy royal brazier requirements.

li.noAssignablePawnsDesc: Throne ownership requires a person with a royal title.

ThingDef.label: meditation throne
ThingDef.description: A large, ornate chair designed for a dignity-focused psycaster to sit and meditate. Reigning on a throne is a form of meditation that builds up psyfocus. For dignity psycasters, more impressive meditation thrones and thronerooms increase the rate of psyfocus gain.

ThingDef.label: grand meditation throne
ThingDef.description: A massive, ornate chair, designed for a dignity-focused psycaster to sit and meditate. Reigning on a throne is a form of meditation that builds up psyfocus. For dignity psycasters, more impressive meditation thrones and thronerooms increase the rate of psyfocus gain.

ThingDef.label: unstable power cell
ThingDef.description:
A mechanoid power generation unit. The vanometric power core will run forever, extracting energy from quantum foam fluctuations.

An internal amplifier system makes it unstable. If damaged, the unit will generate a massive explosion.

Some brave humans steal these from mechanoids for their own use as power plants or defensive bombs. However, an unintentional detonation can be devastating.

ThingDef.label: mech node
ThingDef.description: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Mech nodes can be deconstructed to yield valuable resources - but only if they are captured intact. The internal micro power cell will flame out and ruin the materials if the unit takes too much damage.

ThingDef.label: defoliator
ThingDef.description: An area-denial device which annihilates nearby plants without affecting animals.\n\nIn planetary wars, these weapons are scattered across farmlands or jungles to deny the enemy food or cover. They're usually associated with orbital-drop mechanoid swarms.

ThingDef.label: count-down activator
ThingDef.description: A timed mechanoid activation unit. After counting down, it will wake nearby dormant mechanoids and structures.

ThingDef.label: proximity activator
ThingDef.description: A proximity alarm for dormant mechanoids. If it detects a human-like threat nearby, it will awaken any nearby dormant mechanoids or structures.

ThingDef.label: mech high-shield
ThingDef.description:
A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Shots can go out, but not in.

This one is tuned to high angles, so it will block mortar rounds.

The unit can be temporarily disabled by EMP attacks, either by shocking the projector unit itself, or using EMP munitions on the shield.

ThingDef.label: mech low-shield
ThingDef.description:
A shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Shots can go out, but not in.

This one is tuned to low angles, so it will block ground-level projectiles like bullets.

The unit can be temporarily disabled by EMP attacks, either by shocking the projector unit itself, or using EMP munitions on the shield.

ThingDef.label: mech capsule
ThingDef.description: A mechanoid storage and deployment capsule. It can contain a number of mechanoids, ready to emerge and fight upon being awakened.

ThingDef.label: mech assembler
ThingDef.description: An automated mechanoid factory. It periodically assembles and deploys new mechanoids.

ThingDef.label: mech drop beacon
ThingDef.description: A mechanoid reinforcement drop beacon. When activated, it calls in a group of mechs to land in drop pods nearby.

ThingDef.label: mini-slugger turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered defense turret mounted with a weak but long-ranged slug-thrower. May explode when damaged.

ThingDef.label: mini-slugger
ThingDef.description: An automatic turret-mounted slug-thrower.

ThingDef.label: auto charge turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.

ThingDef.label: light charge blaster
ThingDef.description: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area fire.

ThingDef.label: auto inferno turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.

ThingDef.label: auto mortar
ThingDef.description: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.

ThingDef.label: ship landing beacon
ThingDef.description: Marks the corner of a landing area. Four of these placed at the corners of a clear area (minimum 9x9) create a landing pad. Spacecraft usually land on pads if possible.

ThingDef.label: meditation spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot for meditation. Psycasters can meditate here to gain psyfocus. If a focus object like a sculpture is nearby, the psycaster will be able to focus on it to boost their psyfocus gain. However, different people are able to use different focus objects.

ThingDef.label: small nature shrine
ThingDef.description: A small shrine for honoring spiritual beings. Tribal psycasters can focus on this shrine while meditating to increase psyfocus gain. Nature shrines lose their power if they are close to artificial structures, so they are always built in nature. Since they look like natural objects to unobservant outsiders, raiders will generally ignore them.

ThingDef.label: large nature shrine
ThingDef.description: A large shrine for honoring spiritual beings. Tribal psycasters can focus on this shrine while meditating to increase psyfocus gain. Nature shrines lose their power if they are close to artificial structures, so they are always built in nature. Since they look like natural objects to unobservant outsiders, raiders will generally ignore them.

ThingDef.label: animus stone
ThingDef.description: An ancient jade stone marked with sacred tribal carvings. Tribal psycasters can focus on these stones during meditation to increase their psyfocus gain more than a typical nature shrine.\n\nDifferent tribal cultures tell different stories about these stones, but most agree that they were crafted by an ancient world spirit during a time of great power. Since they look like natural objects to unobservant outsiders, raiders will generally ignore them.

ThingDef.label: harp
ThingDef.description: A simple stationary musical instrument. A row of strings are stretched over a frame and plucked directly by a musician's fingers.\n\nIt can be crafted at a crafting spot or smithy.

ThingDef.label: harpsichord
ThingDef.description: A complex stationary musical instrument crafted at a smithy. A musician touches a row of keys on the front of the instrument. Each key is attached to an internal mechanism which plucks one of a row of strings stretched over a wooden frame. While it permits more complex composition than the harp, its wooden construction and plucking mechanism limit its output volume and expressiveness.

ThingDef.label: unfinished piano
ThingDef.description: An unfinished piano.

ThingDef.label: piano
ThingDef.description: An advanced stationary musical instrument. It is played by pressing a row of keys, which causes hammers to strike internal strings stretched over a steel frame. The hammer mechanism and high-tension strings allow the musician to play both very soft and very loud, making the piano a very expressive instrument.\n\nIt can be crafted at a smithy.

ThingDef.label: shield core
ThingDef.description: A piece of ultratechnology that can generate a momentum-repulsor shield. This can't do anything on its own, but it is necessary to craft some other usable shield items.\n\nShield cores can be obtained by deconstructing mechanoid shield generators.

ThingDef.label: jump pack
ThingDef.description: A single-person burst rocket for short-ranged flight. With its integrated harness and guidance assistant, the jump pack allows anyone to leap long distances at high speed, even over obstacles. It must be recharged after several uses.\n\nSome spacer tech militaries have melee combat specialists who use jump packs to bypass obstacles and rapidly close with the enemy.

ThingDef.label: low-shield pack
ThingDef.description: A single-use man-portable low-shield projector. Deployed on the ground, it generates a circular shield that allows bullets out but not in. The unit is designed to last only a short time before burning out.\n\nMany ultratech combat squads owe their lives to a shield pack deployed at just the right time.

ThingDef.label: eltex helmet
ThingDef.description: A lightweight helmet designed for psychic focusing. While it provides little physical protection, its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.

ThingDef.label: eltex skullcap
ThingDef.description: A tight skullcap designed for psychic focusing. It provides no physical protection, but its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.

ThingDef.label: eltex shirt
ThingDef.description: A shirt embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.

ThingDef.label: eltex vest
ThingDef.description: A thin vest embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
A long robe embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
ThingDef.label: eltex robe
formal shirt
ThingDef.description: A decorated formal shirt with buttons.

ThingDef.label: corset
ThingDef.description: An embroidered corset with strong wire support to maintain a ladylike shape.

ThingDef.label: formal vest
ThingDef.description: A vest embroidered with complex decorative designs.

ThingDef.label: prestige robe
ThingDef.description: A long, flowing robe embroidered with complex decorative designs.

ThingDef.label: ladies hat
ThingDef.description: A decorative traditional hat with complex embroidery.

ThingDef.label: top hat
ThingDef.description: A tall, stiff, shiny hat.

ThingDef.label: coronet
ThingDef.description: A small crown-like piece of headwear made of metal.

ThingDef.label: crown
ThingDef.description: A crown of metal with an elaborate design.

ThingDef.label: stellic crown
ThingDef.description: A grand crown of metal with an elaborate, overbearing design.

ThingDef.label: beret
ThingDef.description: A soft, round, flat-crowned hat.

ThingDef.label: prestige recon armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: prestige recon helmet
ThingDef.description: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective plasteel-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: prestige marine armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: prestige marine helmet
ThingDef.description: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered plasteel-weave plates.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: cataphract armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.

ThingDef.label: cataphract helmet
ThingDef.description: A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.

ThingDef.label: prestige cataphract armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: prestige cataphract helmet
ThingDef.description: A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: locust armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.\n\nUnlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. They usually avoid static shootouts, preferring to jump straight into enemy fortifications and fight hand-to-hand. They do poorly in static defense or confined quarters, but excel in mixed cover or shipcracking operations.

ThingDef.label: grenadier armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nGrenadiers usually specialize in breaching buildings or internal ship bulkheads. While not effective at very long range, grenadiers can be surprisingly deadly in confined quarters.

ThingDef.label: phoenix armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nPhoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, as in underground or shipborne operations. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.

ThingDef.label: gunlink
ThingDef.description: A targeting computer that helps the user aim. It detects and analyzes targets using infrared, visible, and millimeter-wave electromagnetic sensors. An onboard targeting computer displays firing solutions on a retinal projection. It offers no protection at all.

ThingDef.label: monument marker
ThingDef.description: Marks the place where you intend to build a monument. Once placed, this cannot be moved.

ThingDef.label: persona monosword
ThingDef.description: A crystal-metallic longsword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge. It cuts through even thick armor with ease, while its light weight and onboard persona permit extremely fast attacks. \nThis weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

ThingDef.label: persona zeushammer
ThingDef.description: A warhammer with an embedded EMP capacitor. Upon impact, it blasts the target with an EMP burst in addition to the physical damage. \nThis weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

ThingDef.label: persona plasmasword
ThingDef.description: A metal-cored sword with a cutting edge. Plasma is wrapped around the core, held in place by an energy field. Targets are both sliced by the metal core, as well as burned or ignited by the plasma sheath. \nThis weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

ThingDef.label: axe
ThingDef.description: An advanced form of one of mankind's oldest weapons, the war axe is a short blade attached to a shaft. The simple, ancient design concentrates cutting power generated from strong overhand swings.

ThingDef.label: warhammer
ThingDef.description: A long polearm topped with a brutal hammer. The powerful blunt impacts can pulverize an enemy's insides, even through armor.

ThingDef.label: monosword
ThingDef.description: A crystal-metallic longsword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge. It cuts through even thick armor with ease, and its light weight permits fast attacks.

ThingDef.label: zeushammer
ThingDef.description: A warhammer with an embedded EMP capacitor. Upon impact, it blasts the target with an EMP burst in addition to the physical damage.

ThingDef.label: plasmasword
ThingDef.description: A metal-cored sword with a cutting edge. Plasma is wrapped around the core, held in place by an energy field. Targets are both sliced by the metal core, as well as burned or ignited by the plasma sheath.

ThingDef.label: orbital mech cluster targeter
ThingDef.description: An ancient military targeting device. It signals an orbital platform to drop a mechanoid combat cluster at the targeted point. The cluster may include any mixture of mechanoids and mech defense structures. \nThough they may have once had some allegiance to the ancient army that created this unit, any mechs dropped now will indiscriminately attack any human they see - including the one that summoned them. \nThe unit only contains one usage code, so it can only be used once.

ThingDef.label: eltex staff
ThingDef.description: An ultratech staff threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it is a solid melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, allowing more use of psychic powers.

ThingDef.Name: TreeAnima
ThingDef.label: anima tree
ThingDef.description:
A rare tree with warm, skin-smooth bark and long iridescent leaves. Infused with bioluminescent micro-organisms, anima trees develop a unique form of psychic symbiosis with surrounding lifeforms, allowing them to grow in a wide variety of biomes.

If a person (psycaster or not) meditates near an anima tree, it will grow anima grass around its base. Once enough grass is grown, it becomes possible to carry out a psychic linking ritual with the tree and upgrade a person's psychic powers. Only tribal peoples know the secret of this ritual. Tribal psycasters are also able to draw psyfocus from anima trees while meditating to them.

Anima trees' psychic properties are weakened if artificial structures are placed nearby. They refuse to be caged or studied, and must remain part of nature.

Most tribes believe that anima trees are not simply trees, but are rather the physical extremities of a single world spirit.

li.enoughPlantsLetterText:
The anima tree now has {0} anima grass around it. This is enough for a tribal person to begin their first linking ritual!

The linking ritual gives a level of psylink and the ability to use psychic powers. Upgrading to a higher level requires 20 grass.

The anima grass requirements for linking rituals to upgrade psycasters are:

{1}

Note: Only those with the nature focus type can meditate to or link with anima trees. You can see a person's focus types by looking at their info card with the 'i' button.

li.message: The anima tree has died and emitted a disturbing psychic scream.

ThingDef.label: chopped anima stump
ThingDef.description: A stump left behind after an anima tree has been felled. The stump can be extracted but yields very little usable wood. Left outdoors, the stump will deteriorate in time.

ThingDef.label: smashed anima stump
ThingDef.description: The remnants of an anima tree destroyed by damage. It's ugly. The stump can be extracted but yields very little usable wood. Left outdoors, the stump will deteriorate in time.

ThingDef.label: anima grass
ThingDef.description:
A grass infused with luminous microorganisms. Tribal peoples find that anima grass grows around the base of an anima tree as they meditate. It seems to reflect some kind of strengthening of the tree's psychic power.

Offworld scientists have tried to study the phenomenon, but the grass degenerates into normal plant matter when observed too closely.

Animals refuse eat anima grass. Tribal stories say this is done out of respect and fear.

li.label: traveler died
li.description: One of our companions died.

li.label: ate low-class food
li.description: That meal was below my station. My title's formal requirements should always be respected.

li.label: traveler arrested
li.description: One of our companions was taken prisoner!

li.label: traveler surgically violated
li.description: One of our companions was surgically violated. Nothing could justify that.

li.label: terrible bestowing ceremony
li.description: The bestowing ceremony somehow felt petty and self-indulgent at the same time.

li.label: unimpressive bestowing ceremony
li.description: The bestowing ceremony felt mechanical and lifeless.

li.label: honorable bestowing ceremony
li.description: The bestowing ceremony brought a sense of dignity and honor to the participants.

li.label: grandiose bestowing ceremony
li.description: The bestowing ceremony was like a taste of true grandeur, and a moment of participation in something greater.

li.label: awful throneroom
li.description: I had to reign in an awful throneroom. It's like a deliberate insult from my inferiors.

li.label: dull throneroom
li.description: I had to reign in a dull throneroom. It clearly diminished my stature.

li.label: mediocre throneroom
li.description: I had to reign in a mediocre throneroom. It didn't express my stature.

li.label: very impressive throneroom
li.description: I reigned in a very impressive throneroom. It expressed noticeable stature.

li.label: extremely impressive throneroom
li.description: I reigned in an extremely impressive throneroom. It effectively demonstrated my stature.

li.label: unbelievably impressive throneroom
li.description: I reigned in an unbelievably impressive throneroom. The commoners will be amazed at my highness.

li.label: wondrously impressive throneroom
li.description: I reigned in a heavenly throneroom. It matched my grace and nobility.

li.label: decree satisfied
li.description: My noble authority has been respected as it should be.

li.label: decree failed
li.description: My noble authority has not been respected as it should be.

li.label: disinherited
li.description: I was disinherited of my title. Do I need to get medieval on these people?

li.label: neuroquake echo
li.description: Distant, unfamilliar echoes of terror and grief. It makes me feel nervous and shaky.

li.label: listening to harp
li.description: The harp is so soothing.

li.label: listening to harpsichord
li.description: The complexity of the harpsichord fulfills my mind.

li.label: listening to piano
li.description: The piano's range makes me feel melancholy, excited, and whimsical at the same time. What a sound.

li.label: decree ignored
li.description: My decree has been ignored for far too long {0}.

li.label: minor psychic breakdown
li.description: There's an electrical pain behind my eyes. It's hard to focus; hard to think.

li.label: major psychic breakdown
li.description: My mind has been stir-fried. Dizzy, fuzzy, can't think, always aching.

li.label: total psychic breakdown
li.description: I'm spinning, it hurts, I'm dizzy, think, can't think, can't think...

li.label: anima scream
li.description: Such a pain in my head when the tree died. And it keeps echoing...

li.label: joyfuzz
li.description: No matter what happens, I feel like I'm okay with it for some reason.

tips.li: Some title permits allow the holder to call for military aid. This can save you in a tough moment.
Nobles from the Empire will demand all the privileges of their title. Your own titled colonists will be more flexible, unless they are greedy or jealous.
Prestige armor and eltex apparel will also satisfy the apparel requirements of royal titles.
If a title holder dies, their title goes to their chosen heir.
You can change the heir of a title holder through the comms console. However, this requires completing a ritual.
The Empire bestows a free level of psylink upon anyone who earns the title required to use it.
Psylink neuroformers can be acquired through quests. These items can give a person psychic powers.
Gaining a new level of psylink grants knowledge of one random psychic power.
Psychic powers can give you significant advantage in combat.
Using a psychic power on an ally will harm faction relations - but only if it has negative effects.
Psychic invisibility doesn't wear off when you attack.
Going over your neural heat limit can save you in a desperate situation - but the psychic breakdown can last a while.
Creatures with higher psychic sensitivity are affected more by psychics.
Dressing your psycasters in eltex gear will increase their neural heat limit and dissipation rate.
When fighting a mech cluster, try shooting their power cells. They explode, dealing heavy damage to surrounding creatures and structures.
Some mech clusters remain dormant until disturbed. Use that time to prepare your attack.
The Imperial royal tribute collector arrives twice per year, and accepts prisoners and gold in exchange for honor.
You can safely walk right past a dormant mech cluster, as long as you don't attack it or trigger a proximity activator.
The psychic skip power works on self, allies, enemies, and even items. The tactical possibilities are endless.
You can carry a downed ally while using the jump pack. Aerial rescues save lives.

ConceptDef.label: Meditation schedule
ConceptDef.helpText: You can assign your colonists to meditate on a specific schedule.\n\nOpen the SCHEDULE tab, select the 'Meditate' assignment and click-drag the times when you want someone to meditate.

ConceptDef.label: Meditation desired psyfocus
ConceptDef.helpText: You can set a desired psyfocus level for each colonist. To do this, select a colonist with psylink, and click on their psyfocus bar.\n\nIf a colonist's psyfocus is below their desired level, they will meditate automatically during the "Anything" time assignment.

WeaponTraitDef.label: psychic hypersensitizer
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon amplifies the wielder's psychic sensitivity by 40%. This only applies while the weapon is held.

WeaponTraitDef.label: psychic sensitizer
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon amplifies the wielder's psychic sensitivity by 20%. This only applies while the weapon is held.

WeaponTraitDef.label: psychic quiet
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon suppresses the wielder's psychic sensitivity by 15%. This only applies while the weapon is held.

WeaponTraitDef.label: psychic fog
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon suppresses the wielder's psychic sensitivity by 30%. This only applies while the weapon is held.

WeaponTraitDef.label: kind thoughts
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona is kind and supportive. It whispers kind thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kind thoughts
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, is whispering kind thoughts to me.

WeaponTraitDef.label: calm thoughts
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona is relaxed and steady. It whispers calming thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, increasing their mood.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s calm thoughts
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, is whispering calming thoughts to me.

WeaponTraitDef.label: mad muttering
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona is neurotic and unstable. It mutters mad thoughts to whoever it is bonded with, reducing their mood.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s muttering
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, is muttering in my head. It's hard to ignore sometimes.

WeaponTraitDef.label: mad wailing
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona is highly disturbed and won't shut up about it. It wails mad notions to whoever it is bonded with, suppressing their mood.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s wailing
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, is wailing madly in my head. I wish I could ignore it.

WeaponTraitDef.label: kill-focused
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona focuses on deaths. If the weapon kills someone, the wielder will instantly gain 20% psyfocus.

WeaponTraitDef.label: kill-happy
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona loves to kill. If this weapon kills someone, its joy will transmit psychically to the wielder, making them happier for a few days.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kill happiness
li.description: {WEAPON} was overjoyed with its kill, and I feel some of that too.

WeaponTraitDef.label: kill sorrow
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona hates killing. If this weapon kills someone, its sorrow will transmit psychically to the wielder, reducing their mood for a few days.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kill sorrow
li.description: {WEAPON}'s sorrow over its kill is affecting my mind as well.

WeaponTraitDef.label: kill thirst
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona finds purpose in bloodshed. If it does not kill for 20 days, it will become angry and psychically complain to whoever is bonded to it.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kill thirst
li.description: My bonded weapon {WEAPON} is angry it has gone so long without killing. I can feel its rage.

WeaponTraitDef.label: psy-meditative
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona is naturally meditative and helps its wielder focus in psychic meditation. The wielder gains an extra 10% psyfocus per day of meditation, as long as the weapon is held.

WeaponTraitDef.label: painless
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona has some method of psychically disabling pain. The one holding the weapon will feel no pain of any kind.

HediffDef.label: psychic painlessness
HediffDef.description: Pain is disabled by the psychic influence of a wielded weapon.

WeaponTraitDef.label: fast mover
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona has a sense of motion. It confers this onto the wielder, making them move 15% faster as long as the weapon is held.

HediffDef.label: psychic speed
HediffDef.description: Movement is sped up by the psychic influence of a wielded weapon.

WeaponTraitDef.label: hunger pangs
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona loves food, and transmits that onto whoever bonds with it. The bonded person's hunger rate will be 50% higher.

HediffDef.label: psychic hunger
HediffDef.description: Hunger is increased by the psychic influence of a bonded weapon.

WeaponTraitDef.label: neural cooling
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona has the ability to help dissipate the wielder's neural heat. The wielder's neural heat dissipation is improved by 0.15 per second.

HediffDef.label: assisted neural cooling
HediffDef.description: Neural heat dissipation is improved by the psychic influence of a bonded weapon.

WeaponTraitDef.label: freewielder
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona does not form bonds in the normal way. Anyone can pick it up and use it.

WeaponTraitDef.label: jealous
WeaponTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona becomes angry when the bonded individual uses another weapon, thus reducing their mood.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s jealousy
li.description: My bonded weapon {WEAPON} is jealous I am using another weapon. I can feel the rage it is screaming into my head.

AbilityDef.label: leader speech
AbilityDef.description: Initiate a leader speech. If it goes well, listeners will gain improved mood, respect for the speaker, and possibly new inspirations. If it goes poorly, social damage will occur.

AbilityDef.label: trial
AbilityDef.description: Charge someone with a terrible wrongdoing and initiate a trial where they will be either convicted or exonerated. If the target is convicted, they can be freely imprisoned, executed or banished without penalty. The chance of conviction depends on the social abilities of the accuser and accused.

AbilityDef.label: conversion ritual
AbilityDef.description: Try to persuade someone to adopt your beliefs. If it goes well, they will lose some certainty in their ideoligion and may convert. If it backfires, they will gain certainty in their old beliefs.\n\nTo start this ritual at a specific place, select a ritual spot or matching altar/ideogram.

AbilityDef.label: work drive
AbilityDef.description: Call on a person to work harder for some time.

AbilityDef.label: combat command
AbilityDef.description: Create an aura that boosts the combat skills of everyone nearby. The effect lasts 24 hours and remains attached to the leader for the duration.

AbilityDef.label: convert
AbilityDef.description: Attempt to convert someone to the speaker's ideoligion. This will reduce the target's certainty in their own beliefs. The certainty reduction depends on the speaker's negotiation ability.

li.failMessage: {INITIATOR_labelShort} failed to convert {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} was upset by the attempt, but {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty fell from {CERTAINTYBEFORE} to {CERTAINTYAFTER}.

AbilityDef.label: preach health
AbilityDef.description: Preach moral strength to a sick or wounded person through the concepts of your ideology. This will improve their rate of wound healing and immunity gain.

AbilityDef.label: reassure
AbilityDef.description: Increase someone's certainty in their own beliefs. The regained certainty is based on the speaker's negotiation ability.

li.successMessage: {INITIATOR_labelShort} has reassured {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, increasing {RECIPIENT_possessive} certainty in {IDEO} from {BEFORECERTAINTY} to {AFTERCERTAINTY}.

AbilityDef.label: counsel
AbilityDef.description: Offer counsel to a person to cancel the effect of a sad memory. The chance of success depends on the speaker's social skills and their relationship with the listener.

li.successMessage: {INITIATOR_labelShort} successfully counselled {RECIPIENT_labelShort}, canceling the mood impact of {2}.
li.failMessage: {INITIATOR_labelShort} botched the attempt to counsel {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} has become upset.

AbilityDef.label: marksman command
AbilityDef.description: Call out shots and boost the shooting skills of everyone nearby. The effect remains attached to the caster for 24 hours.

AbilityDef.label: berserk trance
AbilityDef.description: The caster fills themself with anger over ideological grievances. This strengthens the body past normal limits, but also means losing control and attacking every enemy nearby in an unstoppable rage. The berserk state will last for 3 hours.

AbilityDef.label: research command
AbilityDef.description: Provide suggestions and mental support, boosting the research speed of everyone nearby. The effect remains attached to the caster for 24 hours.

AbilityDef.label: farming command
AbilityDef.description: Offer guidance on farming techniques, boosting the farming abilities for everyone nearby. The effect remains attached to the caster for 24 hours.

AbilityDef.label: production command
AbilityDef.description: Offer guidance on construction techniques, boosting construction and crafting abilities for everyone nearby. The effect remains attached to the caster for 24 hours.

AbilityDef.label: mining command
AbilityDef.description: Offer guidance on mining techniques, boosting the mining speed for everyone nearby. The effect remains attached to the caster for 24 hours.

AbilityDef.label: Animal calm
AbilityDef.description: Use unique methods of connecting with animals to calm a maddened beast.

AbilityDef.label: Immunity drive
AbilityDef.description: Offer moral support that energizes the body, boosting someone's immunity gain for one day.

FactionDef.label: beggars
FactionDef.description: A group of beggars seeking charity.

FactionDef.label: cannibal tribe
FactionDef.description:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particularly vicious tribe believes eating the flesh of their enemies is a great honor.

FactionDef.label: nudist tribe
FactionDef.description:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular tribe believes that covering one's body is wrong.

FactionDef.label: cannibal pirate gang
FactionDef.description:
A loose confederation of pirate groups who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.

Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.

This particular gang of pirates are cannibals.

FactionDef.label: pilgrims
FactionDef.description: A group of pilgrims seeking to venerate an ancient relic.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: carrier
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in carrying items. Under human influence, it can help haul things where they need to go.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: clawer
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in aggression and damage-dealing attacks. The clawer dryad is named for its massive claws. Though it can do tremendous damage, it is vulnerable to attacks itself.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: barkskin
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in absorbing hits during combat. Barkskin dryads are covered by a thick bark-like hide which is partly formed by the Gauranlen tree itself. Under human influence, it can act as a damage-absorbing fighter.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: woodmaker
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A slow, bumbling caste of dryad which specializes in wood production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate a wood-like material on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: medicinemaker
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in medicine production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate medicinal herbs on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: berrymaker
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in food production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate nourishing berries on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

GauranlenTreeModeDef.label: gaumaker
GauranlenTreeModeDef.description: A dryad caste with the unique ability to produce new Gauranlen pods and reproduce the Gauranlen tree along with its symbiote, the dryad queen. To do this, three gaumaker dryads must slowly merge.

HediffDef.label: work drive
HediffDef.description: The sense of being called upon by a leader to work harder.

HediffDef.label: combat command
HediffDef.description: By encouraging and commanding nearby allies, this person can enhance their focus in combat and thus their battle performance.

HediffDef.label: combat command
HediffDef.description: Combat abilities are boosted thanks to being near someone who is using the combat command ability.

HediffDef.label: preach health
HediffDef.description: This person's will to survive was reinforced by a talk with a moral guide of their ideoligion. That moral certainty has improved their healing and immunization gain rates.

HediffDef.label: marksman command
HediffDef.description: This person is using a special ability to call out shots. Everyone within an effect radius gains shooting bonuses.

HediffDef.label: marksman command
HediffDef.description: Someone is using the marksman command ability nearby, boosting this person's shooting abilities.

HediffDef.label: berserk trance
HediffDef.description: Driven by fierce moral certainty and stories of ideoligious grievance, this person has driven him or herself into a rage. Every muscle is at peak performance, but it's hard to shut down the anger.

HediffDef.label: research command
HediffDef.description: This person is using a special ability to provide suggestions and mental support, boosting the research speed of everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: research command
HediffDef.description: This person's research speed is boosted because they are near someone who is using the research command ability.

HediffDef.label: farming command
HediffDef.description: This person is offering guidance on farming techniques, boosting the farming abilities for everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: farming command
HediffDef.description: This person's farming abilities are boosted thanks to being near someone who is using the farming command ability.

HediffDef.label: production command
HediffDef.description: This person is offering guidance on construction techniques, boosting construction and crafting abilities for everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: production command
HediffDef.description: This person's construction and crafting speeds are boosted thanks to being near someone who is using the production command ability.

HediffDef.label: mining command
HediffDef.description: This person is offering guidance on mining techniques, boosting the mining speed for everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: mining command
HediffDef.description: This person's mining speed is boosted thanks to being near someone who is using the mining command ability.

HediffDef.label: immunity drive
HediffDef.description: This person has received moral support of an ideoligious nature. Their mental certainty has energized their body and boosted their immune system.

HediffDef.label: torture crown
HediffDef.description: A crown-like headpiece with stubby spikes that poke the head uncomfortably. It is used to put the wearer in pain.

HediffDef.label: blindfolded
HediffDef.description: A blindfold is blocking this person's vision.

HediffDef.label: neural supercharge
HediffDef.description: An externally-induced increase in sensitivity and synchronicity of neurons. This boosts consciousness and learning rate at the cost of increased hunger.

HediffDef.label: Biosculpting sickness
HediffDef.description: The after-effects of an incomplete biosculpting cycle. It causes nausea, dizziness, and fuzzy thinking.

HediffDef.label: work focus
HediffDef.description: This person was energized by a ritual or event they participated in. The energy means they can now work harder.

IncidentDef.label: Gauranlen pod sprout
IncidentDef.letterText:
A Gauranlen pod has sprouted nearby!

Harvest it to collect a Gauranlen seed. This special seed can be used to plant the majestic Gauranlen tree.

Your colonists can connect with Gauranlen trees and make them spawn resources and helpful dryads to work or fight for you.

IncidentDef.label: insect jelly
IncidentDef.letterText: Giant insects have tunneled up from underneath and deposited some surplus insect jelly on the surface.

IncidentDef.label: Wanderers
IncidentDef.letterText: Your skylanterns have attracted some friendly travelers. The travelers were amazed by the spectacle you created and hope they'll get to participate next time.\n\nThey will visit and leave a gift.
