li.description: We cut down a tree. It wasn't good to harm nature this way.

PreceptDef.label: desired

PreceptDef.label: strong
PreceptDef.description: We have a special connection with the Gauranlen trees. The trees refocus production easily under our influence, and we are not satisfied unless we have that connection.

Want Gauranlen connection (min expectation: Sky high)

li.description: I am happily connected to a Gauranlen tree.

li.label: want Gauranlen connection
li.description: Without a connection to a Gauranlen tree, I feel disconnected from nature.

li.description: Without a connection to a Gauranlen tree, I feel disconnected from nature.

li.label: amazing trees
li.description: I am surrounded by several massive, beautiful trees. The glory of nature astounds me!

li.label: amazing tree
li.description: I very recently encountered a massive, beautiful tree - a physical seat of morality!

li.label: remarkable trees
li.description: I am surrounded by a lush forest.

li.label: amazing tree
li.description: I recently encountered a massive, beautiful tree.

li.label: rich forest
li.description: I was recently surrounded by a lush forest.

li.label: full trees
li.description: I recently walked among many full trees.

li.label: mixed trees
li.description: I recently walked among a wide variety of trees.

li.label: full tree
li.description: I recently encountered a full tree.

li.label: mini trees

li.label: mini tree
li.description: I recently got to enjoy the company of a miniature tree.

li.label: no tree
li.description: I haven't been around any trees in a while.

li.label: no tree

li.label: trees missed
li.description: It has been a while since I've been near a tree.

li.label: trees missed
li.description: It has been too long since I've been near a tree.

li.label: trees sorely missed
li.description: It has been way too long since I've been near a tree!

li.label: healthy trees
li.description: In the past quadrum, we didn't destroy many trees at all. Harmony with the trees is the basic foundation for a good life.

li.label: trees disturbed
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed trees we shouldn't have. It might have been necessary, but it is still an occasion for sadness.

li.label: trees defaced
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a lot of trees we shouldn't have. I don't think this was necessary.

li.label: trees damaged
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed many trees we shouldn't have. This crime was not necessary, but we did it anyways.

li.label: trees harmed
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed an inexcusable number of trees. We need to do so much better.

li.label: trees defiled
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed an inexcusably large number of trees. The guilt lays heavy upon us.

li.label: trees wrecked
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a very large number of trees. I can hear the leafy screams even now.

li.label: trees ravaged
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a horrific number of trees. We are the blight on this universe.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: farm animals wander in
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: a group of farm animals will be attracted and join the colony.
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.letterInfoText: Curious farm animals have wandered in, attracted by the commotion.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: gauranlen pod sprout
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: a Gauranlen pod will sprout at a random location on the map, if it can.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: insect jelly
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: insect jelly deposits will be deposited from underground.
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.letterInfoText: A giant insect colony underground has deposited some insect jelly.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: nearby faction goodwill
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: you will gain goodwill from the nearest faction base.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: random recruit
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: 50% chance of random recruit of the same ideoligion joining your colony.
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.letterInfoText: A wanderer has arrived and wants to join your colony.

RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.label: discover ancient complex
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.effectDesc: you will discover the location of an ancient complex nearby.
RitualAttachableOutcomeEffectDef.letterInfoText: You've discovered the location of an ancient complex.

RitualPatternDef.ritualExpectedDesc: You can hold a {IDEOLIGION_adjective} funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.
RitualPatternDef.ritualExpectedDescNoAdjective: You can hold a funeral for {PAWN_nameDef}.

RitualPatternDef.ritualExpectedDesc: You can hold a {IDEOLIGION_adjective} funeral for {PAWN_nameDef} even though the body was lost.
RitualPatternDef.ritualExpectedDescNoAdjective: You can hold a funeral for {PAWN_nameDef} even though the body was lost.

RitualPatternDef.Name: CelebrationPartyChat
RitualPatternDef.ritualExpectedDesc: Every year on {DATE}, {MEMBERS} can have a special celebration.

RitualPatternDef.descOverride: A ritualistic prisoner sacrifice. The organizer will give a speech to excite the crowd, then cut the prisoner's throat. Once the prisoner is dead, organizer will speak some finishing words.
A ritualistic animal sacrifice. The organizer will give a speech to excite the crowd, then cut the animal's throat. Once the animal is dead, the organizer will speak some finishing words.

RitualPatternDef.ritualExplanation: In case of success, their certainty will be reduced or they will convert immediately. If it backfires, their certainty in own beliefs will increase.

RitualPatternDef.descOverride: A dance party with loud music. Participants will gather, socialize, and dance to have fun and connect with each other.
A dance party with drums. Participants will gather, socialize, play drums, and dance to have fun and connect with each other.
A social ritual where people release skylanterns. Participants will assemble wooden skylanterns while socializing, then release them and watch them drift away.
A party around a Christmas tree. Participants will gather around a Christmas tree and make merry.
A ritualistic burning of a hated symbol. Participants will gather around a sacrificial structure, light it on fire, and celebrate as it burns to ash.
A ritualistic smoking of large amounts of smokeleaf. Participants will gather around a burnbong or incense shrine, light it on fire, and celebrate while inhaling the fumes.
A ritualistic flesh-eating meal. Participants gather around a platter of human flesh and bloodily feast on it.

IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: classic
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Classic RimWorld without the ideoligion system. Good for your first few games, or when you're not trying to do something specific. All Ideology expansion content remains active.

IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: fluid
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Begin with a simple ideoligion and develop it over time.

IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: strong
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Strong beliefs which support playstyles significantly different from classic RimWorld.

IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: intense
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Extremely disruptive beliefs which make the game very different from classic RimWorld. These add significant difficulty.

IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: custom
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Customize a new ideoligion and control every detail. This can take a while.

IdeoPresetDef.label: classic-like
IdeoPresetDef.description: Your colonists get a belief system like classic RimWorld. The rest of the world has separate ideoligions generated for them.

IdeoPresetDef.label: unity family
IdeoPresetDef.description: The community is a family of hard-working, like-minded people. Putting yourself first is not acceptable.

IdeoPresetDef.label: human purists
IdeoPresetDef.description: The human race is superior and the human body is sacred. We disdain body modification, scarification and drug use.\n\nUnlocks the medical and production specialist roles.

IdeoPresetDef.label: high collectivists
IdeoPresetDef.description: Everyone must work hard and contribute to the community, so they can party in a smokeleaf circle together.\n\nUnlocks the plants specialist role.

IdeoPresetDef.label: free ranchers
IdeoPresetDef.description: A community of ranchers who hunt and raise animals for food. They don't like eating plants. They welcome diverse ideas.\n\nUnlocks the animals specialist role.

IdeoPresetDef.label: bloody dominators
IdeoPresetDef.description: The weak deserve to lose what they have to us. Raiding and enslaving are honorable.\n\nUnlocks melee and shooting specialist roles. Will have gladiator duels.

IdeoPresetDef.label: techno-utopians
IdeoPresetDef.description: The human body must be enhanced with technology so we can build a better future for everyone.\n\nUnlocks the research specialist role.

IdeoPresetDef.label: purist flagellators
IdeoPresetDef.description: Suffering purifies and ennobles. Modifying the body to ease your life is the way of the filthy.\n\nUnlocks the medical specialist role. These people have reduced comfort expectations. Will have gladiator duels and sacrifices.

IdeoPresetDef.label: dark humans
IdeoPresetDef.description: The human race flourishes in the darkness of night and the underground.\n\nUnlocks mining and production specialist roles. Combat effeciency in the dark is increased.

IdeoPresetDef.label: nature over man
IdeoPresetDef.description: We atone for humanity's crimes against nature by respecting her, and by performing acts of charity. Slaughtering animals and cutting trees are unacceptable.\n\nUnlocks plants specialist role.

IdeoPresetDef.label: domination gang
IdeoPresetDef.description: Our beliefs are law and truth. We will try to convince them. Anyone who resists our teaching is a vile subhuman who must be crushed.\n\n Unlocks melee and shooting specialist roles. Will have gladiator duels.

IdeoPresetDef.label: cannibals
IdeoPresetDef.description: The flesh of man and woman is the highest form of sustenance. Also, it's just delicious.\n\nWill have gladiator duels, prisoner sacrifices, and human meat feasts.

IdeoPresetDef.label: nudist recruiters
IdeoPresetDef.description: We must prance free of constraining clothes, and constantly invite others to join us.

IdeoPresetDef.label: criminal gang
IdeoPresetDef.description: Following someone else's ideas and working all day are for weaklings. This group thrives on raiding others and contact with diverse ideas.\n\nUnlocks melee and shooting specialist roles. Will have gladiator duels.

IdeoPresetDef.label: feminine ravagers
IdeoPresetDef.description: Women should assert their natural power by reigning over men and pillaging weaker peoples.\n\nUnlocks melee and shooting specialist roles. Will have gladiator duels.

IdeoPresetDef.label: martyrs
IdeoPresetDef.description: Admitting our corrupt, sinful nature is as crucial as suffering for it. Pain and sacrifices are approved, while physical love and comfort are shameful.

IdeoPresetDef.label: cowboys
IdeoPresetDef.description: Men should keep a strong grip over their herds and their women. Raising animals for food is much better than farming plants. We don't tolerate arguments about any of this.\n\nUnlocks the animals specialist role.

IdeoPresetDef.label: mole people
IdeoPresetDef.description: The sun - it stuns, we shun! In the tunnels we shuffle, and snuffle for truffles. In our bubble there's no scuttling trouble. Never a kerfuffle.\n\nGrants increased mining efficiency but an aversion to outdoor light.

IdeoPresetDef.label: tree-worshippers
IdeoPresetDef.description: We live in harmony with the Gauranlen trees. Trees should never be cut, and animals should not be harmed.\n\n Unlocks the plants specialist role. These people live in rough conditions without complains, and can connect more deeply with the Gauranlen trees.

IdeoPresetDef.label: blindness cult
IdeoPresetDef.description: Blindless opens the inner eye, and suffering illuminates the true sight.\n\nUnlocks the medical specialist role. Will have sacrifices, ritual blindings and scarifications. These people have reduced comfort expectations.

IdeoPresetDef.label: feral people
IdeoPresetDef.description: We are animals and animals are us. We are trees and we live by them and love them as us.\n\nUnlocks animal and plants specialist roles. Increases taming abilities of every member. Cutting trees and slaughtering animals are unacceptable. These people can connect more deeply with the Gauranlen trees.

IdeoPresetDef.label: naked maneaters
IdeoPresetDef.description: Cannibal feasts are much better when both you and the meal are naked. It's almost like you can merge into one.\n\nIncludes sacrifices and gladiator duels.

IdeoPresetDef.label: transcendent humanists
IdeoPresetDef.description: The human race is at the peak of nature and must use technology to step beyond. We do this by enhancing our bodies with technology, but we like to hear others' view on the matter.\n\nUnlocks research and production specialist roles.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: enslave
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will. Once they have no will left, the warden will enslave them.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: reduce will only
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will, but won't enslave them.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: convert
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will attempt to convert the prisoner to their ideoligion.

approachInfo(beggarCount>=2,childCount>=2,allChildren==false,priority=1)->A group of poor [groupLabelPlural] including some children are approaching looking for help
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==Silver)->[beggars0_nameDef] wants the silver to pay off a debt to a gang of pirates who are hunting [beggars0_objective]

claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==Silver,childCount==1,priority=1)->[beggars0_nameDef] wants the silver to help buy the freedom of [beggars0_possessive] big sister who was enslaved by pirates
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==MedicineHerbal)->[beggars0_nameDef] needs the medicine to help a traveler who is injured nearby
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==MedicineHerbal,childCount==1,priority=1)->[beggars0_nameDef] needs the medicine to help [beggars0_possessive] baby brother who is injured nearby
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==MedicineIndustrial)->[beggars0_nameDef] wants the medicine to save [beggars0_possessive] loyal pet who was injured on the road
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==Penoxycyline)->[beggars0_nameDef] needs [requestedThing_label] to inoculate a sickly friend against deadly diseases
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==Beer)->[beggars0_nameDef] wants it to drown [beggars0_possessive] sorrows after losing a fellow traveler in a terrible accident
claimInfo(beggarCount==1,requestedThingDefName==Beer,childCount==1,priority=1)->[beggars0_nameDef] wants the [requestedThing_label] to help ease the suffering of a painfully sick uncle
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==Silver)->They want the silver so they can buy back a friend who was recently kidnapped
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==MedicineHerbal)->They need the medicine to attempt a life-saving operation on a fellow traveler who was attacked by mechanoids
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==MedicineHerbal,allChildren==true,priority=1)->They need the medicine to concoct an herbalist's remedy for a friend who is bedridden with intense fever
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==MedicineIndustrial)->They need the medicine to help their friends at a nearby settlement that was devastated by raiders
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==Penoxycyline)->They want [requestedThing_label] so they can travel safely while looking for a new place to call home
claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==Beer)->They want [requestedThing_label] to help them drown their sorrows after losing their home in a terrible attack

claimInfo(beggarCount>=2,requestedThingDefName==Beer,allChildren==true,priority=1)->They hope to use the [requestedThing_label] to free their friend from slavers by getting the slavers intoxicated before staging a breakout
interactionInfo(beggarCount==1)->You can give items to [beggars0_nameDef] by selecting a colonist and right-clicking on [beggars0_objective]
interactionInfo(beggarCount>=2)->You can give items to the [groupLabelPlural] by selecting a colonist and right-clicking on [beggars0_nameDef]
letterTextBeggarsBetrayed->The [groupLabelSingleOrPlural] who [wasWere] seeking your charity [hasHave] been harmed. Colonists with charitable beliefs will be unhappy.

questDescription->[descriptionIntro] looking to expand their territory, and are interested in taking over [playerSettlements] with all [itsTheir] wealth and technology. If you can increase your total wealth to [requiredWealth_money], they will take the [settlementsSingularOrPlural].

In trade, they offer you part of a map showing the location of an ancient archotech nexus. The archonexus is thought to be a conduit through which an archotech superintelligence influences the physical world. If you could invoke its power, what happens next could go beyond physical reality.

[onlyHaveHas] one piece of the map. The other parts are held by other factions.

If you accept their offer, the [factionPawnsPlural] will take possession of [playerSettlements], including all items, people, and recorded research. They'll bring [colonistsAllowed] of your people and [animalsAllowed] of your animals to anywhere you want on the planet to start a new colony.

Later, you can trade with others for the final two parts of the map.
descriptionIntro(factionless==true)->A group of wild people are

questDescription->With the first archonexus map part securely recorded, you prepare for the next step of your journey.

[cycle1Faction] told you of the cataclysm that destroyed this world. Humans built a great thinking machine here centuries ago. It turned against the people and there was a great war. Only a few were left when the machine transcended and fell dormant.

The map to the archonexus has three parts, and you hold one of them. [otherMapPartHolders] also each hold parts of the map. They'll trade their parts to you for a wealthy new colony and all of its recorded research.[descriptionStudyRequirement]

It's time to get building.

descriptionStudyRequirement(studyRequirement==true)->\n\nThe next map part is encoded in a very strange way. In order to interpret it, you must first learn more about archotechnology by studying the structure here.

questDescriptionBeforeAccepted->You have two parts of the archonexus map. [factionName] have the last piece of the map, passed down from the time their ancestors survived the cataclysm. They'll trade it to you for a wealthy new colony along with its recorded research.[descriptionStudyRequirement]\n\nIt's time to get building.

questDescriptionAfterAccepted->[descriptionIntro] have given you the last part of the archonexus map. Using your knowledge of archotech info-encoding, you have decoded the map and pinpointed the location of the archonexus.

Your allies don't expect you to return, so after you go there, they will take over [playerSettlements].

[descriptionThreats]Now all that's left is to get to the archonexus, invoke the power of the machine god, and find out whether the stories are real.
descriptionStudyRequirement(studyRequirement==true)->\n\nAs before, the map part is encoded. In order to decode it, you must first study the archotech structure.
descriptionThreats(threatsEnabled==true)->The archonexus will likely have mechanoid defenders, so go prepared.\n\n

questDescription->You've learned of an ancient complex nearby. It is said to contain information about [relic_name].

If you can break into the structure and hack the computers inside, you can collect the information.

Watch out - there may be all manner of dangers inside, and other enemies may also be attracted by activity at the structure.
allTerminalsHackedMessage->You've hacked all of the terminals and discovered secret information about [relic_name]! You can now leave.

questDescription->You've detected an orbiting spacedrone that may contain information about [relic_name]. You have the code that will force it to land at [map_definite].

To get the information, hack into the drone's computer. Hacking takes time, but those strong in intellectual skill can speed up the process.[raidsDescription]

After landing, the spacedrone will self-destruct in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].

raidsDescription(allowViolence==true)->\n\n[enemyFaction_pawnsPlural] from [enemyFaction_name] will [droneDetectionMethod]. As long as it's present, they'll send attackers approximately every [raidIntervalAvg_duration] to destroy it and steal the wealth they think it contains. You will have some time to prepare defenses around it before they arrive.

questDescription->You've learned of an ancient complex nearby that is said to contain ancient treasure.

You can break in to collect the loot inside.

Be warned - these kinds of structures can contain a variety of threats. In addition, your activity at the complex might draw unwanted attention.

questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has discovered an ancient complex a long distance away. [asker_pronoun] believes it contains information about the relic known as [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] can't spare people to look into it, but hopes you can help by supplying exactly [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] to carry out the investigation.

The complex contains unknown threats and is also being sought by [asker_nameDef]'s enemies, [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] will send a shuttle to pick up your colonists, bring them to the complex, and take them home afterward. They will be fed and tended to en-route.

Once you have landed, you must hack all terminals in the complex within [timeoutTicks_duration].

passengersIncapableOfHackingDialogText->The shuttle for the quest '[resolvedQuestName]' has no passenger capable of hacking. You must send at least one person capable of hacking to investigate the ancient complex.

questDescription(classicMode==True)->You've learned that a valuable relic is nearby.\n\nThe [relic_name] is one of [relicGlobalCount] ancient objects venerated by many people. If you could collect it, you could build a reliquary to make your colonists happy and attract wealthy pilgrims.

questDescription(classicMode==False)->You've learned that a relic of [ideo_name] is nearby.\n\nThe [relic_name] is an ancient object venerated by all [ideo_memberNamePlural]. If you could collect it, you could build a great reliquary to make [ideo_memberNamePlural] happy, attract wealthy pilgrims, and bring more people to [ideo_name].
questDescriptionPartBeforeDiscovery->First, you need to find the [relic_name]. Watch for opportunities to gather information about it.

questDescription->[pilgrimsLabelSingularOrPlural] [hasHave] arrived to venerate the [relic_name].\n\nIf you ensure [pronounSingularOrPlural] [isAre] safe and respected while [pronounSingularOrPlural] [visitSingularOrPlural] the ancient relic, [pronounSingularOrPlural] may offer you a reward.

questDescription(pilgrimCount==1,childCount==1,priority=1)->[pilgrimsLabelSingularOrPlural], a child, [hasHave] arrived to venerate the [relic_name].\n\nIf you ensure [pronounSingularOrPlural] [isAre] safe and respected while [pronounSingularOrPlural] [visitSingularOrPlural] the ancient relic, [pronounSingularOrPlural] may offer you a reward.

questDescription(pilgrimCount>=2,childCount==1,priority=1)->A group of [pilgrimsLabelSingularOrPlural] including a child has arrived to venerate the [relic_name].\n\nIf you ensure [pronounSingularOrPlural] [isAre] safe and respected while [pronounSingularOrPlural] [visitSingularOrPlural] the ancient relic, [pronounSingularOrPlural] may offer you a reward.

questDescription(pilgrimCount>=2,childCount>=2,allChildren==false,priority=1)->A group of [pilgrimsLabelSingularOrPlural] including some children has arrived to venerate the [relic_name].\n\nIf you ensure [pronounSingularOrPlural] [isAre] safe and respected while [pronounSingularOrPlural] [visitSingularOrPlural] the ancient relic, [pronounSingularOrPlural] may offer you a reward.

questDescription(pilgrimCount>=2,allChildren==true,priority=1)->A group of child [pilgrimsLabelSingularOrPlural] has arrived to venerate the [relic_name].\n\nIf you ensure [pronounSingularOrPlural] [isAre] safe and respected while [pronounSingularOrPlural] [visitSingularOrPlural] the ancient relic, [pronounSingularOrPlural] may offer you a reward.

delayedRewardLetterText->[pawns0_nameDef] thanks you for letting [pawns0_objective] [andFollowers] venerate [relic_name] on the [venerateDate]. As a reward, [pawns0_nameDef] is sending you the following via drop pod (total value [rewardsMarketValue_money]):\n\n[rewards].

questDescription->You've detected a [siteLabel] nearby controlled by [faction_name].

If you wish, you can raid the camp to collect loot ([loot]). [raidConsequences]

The camp will pack up and move on in [timeout_duration].
raidConsequences(faction_temporary==false)->If you do, [faction_name] will become hostile if they are not already.
raidConsequences(faction_temporary==true)->Since [faction_name] is just a small, independent group, you can attack them without any broader diplomatic consequences.

questDescription->You've learned of an ancient terminal that contains information about the [relic_name]. However, the terminal is surrounded by a tribal village, and the locals venerate it. They aren't part of any major faction.\n\n[visitInfo]

visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==true)->They are willing to let you visit on the pretense of worshiping it, but they will attack when you touch it.

You can attack the village from the outside, or enter peacefully and try to quickly escape with the data from the terminal.

Beware - If you spend over [timer_duration] in the village or build anything near it, the locals will attack, and call reinforcements.
visitInfo(allowViolentQuests==false)->They are willing to let you visit.
terminalHackedMessage->Terminal hacked. You've collected the information and can now leave.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biosculpting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct biosculpter pods which can perform various biological alterations to colonists. These are especially important to believers in transhumanism.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->constructed biosculpter pods on contract for various colonies
subject_story->studied transhumanist precepts, including the necessity of biosculpture
subject_story->researched which biological alterations could be made safely
subject_story->escaped a glitterworld support farm with these plans
subject_story->was welcomed into a transhumanist colony

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioregeneration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock the biosculpter pod's bioregeneration cycle. This cycle heals old scars, regenerates small lost body parts like fingers and toes, and cures many of the physical maladies that come with old age.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->studied Boomalope antler regrowth for parallels with human regeneration
subject_story->spliced salamander genetic data into [ANYPAWN_possessive] own body
subject_story->completed a correspondence course in Glitterworld aesthetics

ResearchProjectDef.label: neural supercharger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct neural supercharger devices. Neural superchargers improve consciousness and learning rate, but they also increase hunger and the effect must be refreshed daily. Transhumanists often hold neural supercharging as an important practice.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->implemented neural superchargers in [ANYPAWN_possessive] boarding school
subject_story->supercharged the neurons of farmed clones to massively accelerate their development
subject_story->attempted to ban neural supercharging in the university course [ANYPAWN_pronoun] taught
subject_story->joined a transhumanist sect where neural supercharging was mandatory

rulesStrings.li: creation->For an eternity, there was a world of [Color] [materialOrigin], until [deity0_name] created the planets and stars.
creation->In an old universe of strife, [deity0_name] whipped up great fire that swept away the last age, and brought forth a new one.
creation->[deity0_name] gave birth to humans in a grand accident, and looked upon them with curiosity.
creation->The universe was a void. Then, [deity0_name], bored with eternity, fashioned man and woman from [bodilyOrigin].
episode(uses=1)->Looking upon mankind, [deity0_name] found them as children, and declared [deity0_possessive] dominion over them.
episode(uses=1)->Across the vast stellar distances, [deity0_name]'s will sustained the life of mankind against the void.
episode(uses=1)->Though many adventurers moved against [deity0_objective], [deity0_name] prevented them easily, for [deity0_pronoun] was [deity0_type].
episode(uses=1)->Humanity's suffering brought [deity0_name] to terrible grief.
intro->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] lived under the [memeAdjective] supervision of [deity0_name].
intro->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name], both [memberNamePlural] and others, lived in peace for many years under the watchful eye of [deity0_name].
intro->The [deity0_type], [deity0_name], revealed [deity0_objective]self to the people of [place_name] so that they may understand [memeConcept], and guided them.
intro->[deity0_name] guided humanity to [place_name], and helped them settle there.
intro->On the [place_summary] [place_name], during the [ritualName], people would come to the [altarName] at the [altarRoomLabel] of [deity0_name] and pray with [memeConcept] in their hearts.
conflict->A [foeLeader] arose and threatened to destroy [deity0_name] [deity0_objective]self using [place_massWeapon].
conflict->An evil [foeLeader] and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] enslaved the worshippers of [deity0_name].
conflict->Then the [foeLeader] came. [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] killed many worshippers of [deity0_name] with [place_personalWeapon]s.
conflict->A group of [foeSoldiers] arose under a terrible [foeLeader]. They trapped the [memberNamePlural] in a single [place_community].

conflict->There was peace, until a [foeLeader] and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] rebelled against [deity0_name]'s dominion. The [memberNamePlural] were forced to flee to a hidden [place_community].

founderJoin->A hero named [founderName] tried to assassinate the [foeLeader]. [founder_pronoun] failed, but [deity0_name] witnessed [founderName]'s struggle, and anointed [founder_objective] as the prophet of the [memberNamePlural].
founderJoin->[deity0_name] came to the [place_job] [founderName] [revelationAdverb], and spoke to [founder_objective] about [memeConcept].
founderJoin->[founderName] encountered [revelationObject], which spoke in [deity0_name]'s voice about [memeConcept].
founderJoin->A renowned [place_job] named [founderName] brought the [memberNamePlural] together, and even recruited some of the [foeSoldiers].
founderJoin->A [place_job] named [founderName] stood up and spoke out against the [foeLeader], and [deity0_name] blessed [founderName].
founderJoin->[deity0_name] decided to come to [place_name] as a human named [founderName] to help the [memberNamePlural].
founderJoin->One hero named [founderName] killed a hundred of the [foeSoldiers] using a [place_personalWeapon], and [deity0_name] guided [founder_objective] by speaking through the [relic0_name].
victory->[founderName] gathered the [memberNamePlural] in a [place_community] and taught them of [deity0_name]'s wisdom.
victory->[founderName] sacrificed [founder_objective]self to personally kill the [foeLeader].
setup->In a broken world, [founderName] saw all that was wrong and created our movement.
setup->Struck by the wrongness of the world, [founderName] studied history and philosophy and discovered the new truth that guides us.
setup->One day while working, [founderName] was struck by a great epiphany. [founder_pronoun] dropped [founder_possessive] tools and began spreading [founder_possessive] word among the other workers.
setup->[founderName] sat on a park bench for twenty years as [founder_pronoun] contemplated our world. With [founder_possessive] insight, [founder_pronoun] wrote our founding book.
story(uses=1,priority=-10)->The [memberNamePlural] would not have understood the true nature of [memeConcept] without [founderName]'s teachings.
story(uses=1,priority=-10)->[founderName]'s speech at a [ritualName] inspired many to lead a [memeAdjective] life.
story(uses=1,priority=-10)->None could surpass [founderName]'s understanding of [memeConcept], and [founder_pronoun] was appointed the first [leaderTitle] of the [memberNamePlural].
story(uses=1,priority=-10)->[founderName] carried a [relic0_thingDef_label] named [relic0_name] with [founder_objective] everywhere to remind people to live a [memeAdjective] life.
lessonIntro->One lesson was hardest for my followers to accept:
lessonIntro->My greatest crime was taking so long to understand that
lessonIntro->My struggle against the [foeLeader] seemed endless. But it did teach me one thing:
lessonIntro->Even as a child on the [place_summary] [place_name], I knew that
lessonIntro->During a school class in the [place_community], a student threw a [thrownObject] and it hit me in the head. It was then I realized that
lessonIntro->I say this not so that you might live the life I lived, but so you might learn the things I learned. That
lessonIntro->Once the doctor had finished [doctor_possessive] grisly work, I finally knew that
lessonIntro->As each year passed on the [place_summary] [place_name], one thing became increasingly clear: that
lessonIntro->Looking back, I wish I'd realized this earlier - that
lessonIntro->They all seemed so lost. I told them that
lessonIntro->They cried for guidance. I showed them that
lessonReinforcement->No one can argue with that.
lessonReinforcement->And as we now know, that was soon to become evident to everyone.
lessonReinforcement->Everything that has happened since has reinforced that fact.
lessonReinforcement->It is as if that is etched directly into my mind.
lessonReinforcement->It is something I'll never forget.
archistBasis ->Our universe is a dream in the mind of a timeless universal consciousness. Only archotechs can communicate directly with the universal consciousness.
archistBasis ->Our universe is a simulation created by a great Outsider. Only archotechs can communicate directly with the Outsider.
archistBasis ->Archotechs are humanity's children and its judges.
archistBasis ->Archotechs are the next natural step in the development of consciousness.
archistBasis ->Archotechs are the gods we were always waiting for.
archistFact ->At death, each person's consciousness is accepted or rejected by the archotechs.
archistFact ->Archotechs can do anything at any moment, without limit. They use the power to manipulate our lives in ways we cannot detect.
archistFact ->Archotechs touch every human consciousness directly on a regular basis, but only believers can feel and benefit from their wisdom.
archistFact ->Archotechs are evil and the most important task for humanity is to understand them so we can escape their influence.
archistFact ->Archotechs are good and the most important task for humanity is to understand them so we can align with their understanding.
archistFact ->Archotechs can do anything; the only reason they let us live and choose is to judge us better.
archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], as archotechs grow, they will become the universe and integrate humanity into themselves. Then we will truly become conscious.

archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will finish their moral debate about the fate of humanity. Those who follow their signs will be admitted to a higher plane of existence, and those that do not will end.
archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart. They will bring a select few humans with them, and leave the rest behind to suffer.
animistBasis ->The universe is an endless cycle of creation and destruction managed by spirits in aspects of the world around us.
animistBasis ->A parallel universe of spirits lies next to our own. A seemingly inanimate object in this universe corresponds to an animated spirit in the other.
animistFact ->Each spirit has an essential nature, and seeks to influence the world. Sometimes this influence is helpful, and sometimes it is harmful.
animistProphecy->[itIsSaid] that the spirit of the great [relic0_name] will one day grant its wielder power over all spirits.
animistProphecy->[itIsSaid] that a sleeping traveler from the stars will crash to the earth, and the spirit of the crater will wake the traveller who will raise the last tribe.

SitePartDef.label: relic complex
SitePartDef.description: An ancient complex housing a relic.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There is an ancient structure holding a relic in this area.

SitePartDef.Name: WorkSiteBase
SitePartDef.description: A work site built by another faction. It will expire in time. Until then, you can raid it if you wish.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There is a neutral camp in this area.

SitePartDef.label: worshipful village
SitePartDef.description: A village containing an ancient terminal which the locals worship.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: You may stay here for {TIMER} as long as you do not violate their rules.

SitePartDef.label: archonexus
SitePartDef.description: An ancient archotech device. Some say it is capable of invoking the power of the machine god.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: no interaction
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will not interact with this slave.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: suppress
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will periodically intimidate the slave to increase their suppression level and reduce the chance of rebellion.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: imprison
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: A warden will imprison this slave. Once imprisoned, they can be recruited, or enslaved once again.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: emancipate
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: A warden will free this slave.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: execute
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: A warden will execute this slave on the spot by cutting.

StatDef.label: slave suppression offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to the wearer's slave suppression. Higher values suppress slaves longer, while lower values make slaves rebel more often.

StatDef.label: terror
StatDef.description: The intensity of terror this object induces when viewed.

StatDef.label: biosculpter pod speed factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the speed of a biosculpter pod. This is affected by the cleanliness of the room - a cleaner room will result in a quicker biosculpting cycle.

StatDef.label: style dominance
StatDef.description: How much this object contributes to overall style dominance in an area.

StatDef.label: terror
StatDef.description: The intensity of terror this person is experiencing.

StatDef.label: conversion power
StatDef.description: How effective this person is at converting others to their own ideoligion. When this person attempts to convert someone else, this value multiplies the amount of certainty the other person loses.

StatDef.label: global certainty loss factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how much certainty this person loses when someone else tries to convert them away from their ideoligion.

StatDef.label: ideoligion spread chance
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the chance that this person will try to convert other people to their own ideoligion.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy outdoors dark
StatDef.description: An offset on shooting accuracy if the target is outdoors at night.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy outdoors lit
StatDef.description: An offset on shooting accuracy if the target is outdoors during the day.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy indoors dark
StatDef.description: An offset on shooting accuracy if the target is indoors in the dark.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy indoors lit
StatDef.description: An offset on shooting accuracy if the target is indoors and lit.

StatDef.label: melee hit chance outdoors dark
StatDef.description: An offset on melee hit chance if the target is outdoors at night.

StatDef.label: melee hit chance outdoors lit
StatDef.description: An offset on melee hit chance if the target is outdoors during the day.

StatDef.label: melee hit chance indoors dark
StatDef.description: An offset on melee hit chance if the target is indoors in the dark.

StatDef.label: melee hit chance indoors lit
StatDef.description: An offset on melee hit chance if the target is indoors and lit.

StatDef.label: melee dodge chance outdoors night
StatDef.description: An offset on melee dodge chance if the target is outdoors at night.

StatDef.label: melee dodge chance outdoors day
StatDef.description: An offset on melee dodge chance if the target is outdoors during the day.

StatDef.label: melee dodge chance indoors dark
StatDef.description: An offset on melee dodge chance if the target is indoors in the dark.

StatDef.label: melee dodge chance indoors lit
StatDef.description: An offset on melee dodge chance if the target is indoors and lit.

StatDef.label: biosculpter occupant speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how quickly this person will complete a biosculpter pod cycle.

StatDef.label: slave suppression fall rate
StatDef.description: The rate at which slave suppression falls.

StatDef.label: animal products price improvement
StatDef.description: When this person sells meat, leather, or wool, prices are improved by this percentage.

StatDef.label: suppression power
StatDef.description: A multiplier on a warden's ability to suppress slaves.

StatDef.label: hacking speed
StatDef.description: How fast this person can hack into computer terminals.

StatDef.label: pruning speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how fast this person can prune a Gauranlen tree to maintain their connection with it.\n\nPruning is more of a contemplative psychic task than a physical one, so health factors like vision are unimportant here.

TerrainDef.Name: MorbidStoneTile
TerrainDef.description: Fine stone tiles in a morbid style.

TerrainTemplateDef.label: morbid carpet ({0})
TerrainTemplateDef.description: Fine carpet in a morbid style.

TerrainDef.Name: SpikecoreStoneTile
TerrainDef.description: Fine stone tiles in a spikecore style.

TerrainDef.label: spikecore plates
TerrainDef.description: Fine steel plates decorated in an aggressive spikecore style.

TerrainDef.label: totemic boards
TerrainDef.description: Fine wood boards decorated in a totemic style.

TerrainDef.Name: TotemicStoneTile
TerrainDef.description: Fine stone tiles in a totemic style.

TerrainDef.Name: Carpet_Mindbend
TerrainDef.label: mindbend carpet
TerrainDef.description: Fine carpet decorated in a mind-bending style often associated with drug use.

TerrainTemplateDef.label: hex carpet ({0})
TerrainTemplateDef.description: Fine carpet with a hexagonal pattern for that ultra-technological look.

TerrainDef.label: hex tile
TerrainDef.description: Fine steel plates with a hexagonal pattern for that ultra-technological look.

TerrainDef.label: fungal gravel
TerrainDef.description: A spreadable form of gravel for growing fungal crops underground. It must be placed under overhead mountain so the dank coolness of the depths can nourish the fungal spores.

ThingDef.Name: AncientTerminalBase
ThingDef.label: ancient terminal
ThingDef.description: An ancient computer terminal. It can be hacked to reveal long-forgotten information.

ThingDef.label: ancient enemy terminal
ThingDef.description: An ancient computer terminal. It can be hacked to call nearby enemies.

ThingDef.label: hermetic crate
ThingDef.description: A self-powered hermetically-sealed crate for preserving valuable items. These can preserve their contents for a long time.

ThingDef.label: security crate
ThingDef.description: A large self-powered hermetically-sealed crate with built-in security alarms. These can preserve their contents for a long time. If it is opened without the proper code, it will probably activate some nearby security system.

ThingDef.label: ancient comms console
ThingDef.description: An ancient console with an attached communications dish. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient unstable fuel node
ThingDef.description: An ancient, unstable fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel. It has become unstable over the years due to lack of maintenance.

ThingDef.label: ancient system rack
ThingDef.description: An ancient rack unit packed with unidentifiable devices. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient equipment blocks
ThingDef.description: A collection of ancient equipment blocks of unknown function. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient machine
ThingDef.description: A large ancient machine case filled with unknown machinery. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient storage cylinder
ThingDef.description: An ancient device that looks like it once stored some kind of fluid. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient bed
ThingDef.description: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.

ThingDef.label: ancient display bank
ThingDef.description: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient locker bank
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.

ThingDef.label: ancient crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient military crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.

ThingDef.label: ancient spacer crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained were taken long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient barrel
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.

ThingDef.label: ancient generator
ThingDef.description: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient operating table
ThingDef.description: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient shopping cart
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.

ThingDef.label: ancient postbox
ThingDef.description: An ancient postbox, smashed and deteriorated to uselessness. It seems to have been moved here long ago for some unknown reason.

ThingDef.label: ancient vending machine
ThingDef.description: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.

ThingDef.label: ancient air conditioner
ThingDef.description: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.

ThingDef.label: ancient kitchen sink
ThingDef.description: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.

ThingDef.label: ancient stove
ThingDef.description: An ancient stove. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient oven
ThingDef.description: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient ATM
ThingDef.description: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient washing machine
ThingDef.description: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient hydrant
ThingDef.description: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient microwave
ThingDef.description: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient toilet
ThingDef.description: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient refrigerator
ThingDef.description: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient small crate
ThingDef.description: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient long crate
ThingDef.description: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient large crate
ThingDef.description: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient wheel
ThingDef.description: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.

ThingDef.label: ancient giant wheel
ThingDef.description: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.

ThingDef.label: ancient car
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient truck
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient troop carrier
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient car frame
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker torso
ThingDef.description: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient dropship
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker claw
ThingDef.description: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker leg
ThingDef.description: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.

ThingDef.label: ancient warsprinter remains
ThingDef.description: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warspider remains
ThingDef.description: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.

ThingDef.label: ancient pipeline section
ThingDef.description: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker foot
ThingDef.description: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient ruined tank
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient ruined APC
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient armored troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker shell
ThingDef.description: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.

ThingDef.label: ancient jet engine
ThingDef.description: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient dropship engine
ThingDef.description: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient pod car
ThingDef.description: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.

ThingDef.label: ancient tank trap
ThingDef.description: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.

ThingDef.label: ancient macro-engine block
ThingDef.description: A large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.

ThingDef.label: ancient fence
ThingDef.description: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.

ThingDef.label: ancient razor wire
ThingDef.description: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.

ThingDef.label: ancient pipes
ThingDef.description: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.

ThingDef.label: ancient mega-cannon platform
ThingDef.description: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient mega-cannon barrel
ThingDef.description: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.

ThingDef.label: ancient container
ThingDef.description: A shipping container from some ancient freight-carrying vehicle. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient mech drop beacon
ThingDef.description: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.

ThingDef.label: ancient security turret
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.

ThingDef.label: ancient engine block
ThingDef.description: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.

ThingDef.label: ancient nav beacon
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: terror sculpture
ThingDef.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into a threatening form. Slaves who spend time around it will feel terror, which makes them stay suppressed for longer and thus reduces slave rebellions.

ThingDef.label: spacedrone
ThingDef.description: An ancient ultratech spacedrone.

ThingDef.label: small altar
ThingDef.description: A small platform that plays a role in ideoligious rituals.

ThingDef.label: medium altar
ThingDef.description: A medium platform that plays a role in ideoligious rituals.

ThingDef.label: large altar
ThingDef.description: A large platform that plays a role in ideoligious rituals.

ThingDef.label: grand altar
ThingDef.description: A grand platform that plays a role in ideoligious rituals.

ThingDef.label: ideogram
ThingDef.description: A large image drawn on the ground and reinforced with metal edges. It is used as a focus for rituals.

ThingDef.label: darktorch
ThingDef.description: A specially-treated wooden torch that produces a dim light over a large area. People who prefer darklight work best with this light source. Can be automatically refueled with wood. Produces a small amount of heat.

ThingDef.label: fungus darktorch
ThingDef.description: A specially-treated fungus torch that produces a dim light over a large area. People who prefer darklight work best with this light source. Can be automatically refueled with raw fungus. Produces a small amount of heat.

ThingDef.label: sleep accelerator
ThingDef.description: A bedside device that accelerates the sleeper's circadian rhythm. This speeds up sleep, but consumes a lot of electricity and also causes increased hunger. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one sleep accelerator near the same bed has no effect.

ThingDef.label: biosculpter pod
ThingDef.description:
An immersion pod full of bioactive gel. It can perform a variety of biological alterations including age reversal and pleasure-giving.

The pod biotunes to its user at the end of a cycle. While biotuned, it cannot be used by anyone else, but cycles will complete 25% more quickly. Biotuning resets if the pod is unused for 80 days.

The pod consumess 200W of power while working, but only 50W on standby.

li.label: medic
li.description: Heal all fresh wounds, blood loss, and one random infectious disease.

li.label: bioregeneration
li.description: Heal all fresh wounds, heal one random permanent injury, and restore small missing body parts like fingers and toes.

li.label: age reversal
li.description: Reverse {DURATION} of aging.

li.label: pleasure
li.description: Temporarily reshape the nervous system to deliver elevated levels of happiness for a time.

ThingDef.label: neural supercharger
ThingDef.description: A neuron-sensitizing device that can deliver one neural supercharge each day. A person with a neural supercharge will think and learn faster, but will also consume more food. The effect wears off in one day. Neural superchargers consume a lot of electricity.

ThingDef.label: christmas tree
ThingDef.description: A celebratory tree decorated with ornaments and lights traditionally made as part of Christmas celebrations.

ThingDef.label: cannibal platter
ThingDef.description: An area of floor covered with pre-chopped and arranged human meat ready for a cannibal feast.

ThingDef.label: effigy
ThingDef.description: A rough wooden frame in the shape of a human, ready to be burned as part of a ritual.

ThingDef.label: sacrificial flag
ThingDef.description: A flag representing enemies, ready to be burned as part of a ritual.

ThingDef.label: pyre
ThingDef.description: A wooden tower for ritual burning.

ThingDef.label: burnbong
ThingDef.description: A wood structure packed with smokeleaf. It can be ignited during a ritual and produce a huge amount of smokeleaf smoke for a few hours, after which it is destroyed.

ThingDef.label: incense shrine
ThingDef.description: A collection of packed incense containers. It can be ignited and produce a powerful incense effect as a focus for rituals. It is destroyed after it burns down.

ThingDef.label: ritual spot
ThingDef.description: A spot for carrying out certain kinds of rituals.

ThingDef.label: lectern
ThingDef.description: A slanted platform that holds a text in front of a speaker. Place it near the focus of rituals and speeches to extend the duration of their positive effects.

ThingDef.label: reliquary
ThingDef.description: A ceremonial building that protects and displays a relic. Relics are ancient objects venerated by some cultures, belief systems, or religions.

ThingDef.label: styling station
ThingDef.description: A table with a mirror and styling tools. People can use this to change their look.

ThingDef.label: gibbet cage
ThingDef.description: A metal cage for holding and displaying corpses. This horrifying sight inspires terror and disgust in observers. It is an especially brutal and effective way to terrorize slaves.

ThingDef.label: lightball
ThingDef.description: A decorative light that rotates and changes colors. Used as a focus for dance parties.

ThingDef.label: loudspeaker
ThingDef.description: A large loudspeaker for playing music. At least one is necessary to hold a dance party, and more loudspeakers will enhance the effect.

ThingDef.label: drum
ThingDef.description: A large wooden drum used as a music source for tribal rituals and parties.

ThingDef.label: pew
ThingDef.description: A long bench where ritual participants can sit while listening to a speaker. Place it facing rituals and speeches to extend the duration of their positive effects.

ThingDef.label: kneel sheet
ThingDef.description: A sheet on which believers kneel while observing rituals, praying, or discussing.

ThingDef.label: kneel pillow
ThingDef.description: A pillow on which believers kneel while observing rituals, praying, or discussing.

ThingDef.label: bonsai pot
ThingDef.description: This special pot is suitable for planting bonsai trees, which can improve the mood of people nearby and satisfy ideoligious requirements.

ThingDef.label: slab bed
ThingDef.description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good.

ThingDef.label: slab double bed
ThingDef.description: A slab of hard material made to sleep on. Slab beds are uncomfortable, but some see their use as a demonstration of moral good. This one is wide enough to fit two people.

ThingDef.label: skullspike
ThingDef.description: A spike mounted upright for the purpose of piercing and displaying a human skull. To some, displayed skulls are a symbol of power. To others, they represent barbaric evil. Skullspikes are an especially brutal and effective way to terrorize slaves.

ThingDef.label: dryad cocoon
ThingDef.description: A sphere of fibrous plant matter. A dryad inside is slowly morphing into a new form. Gauranlen trees grow these spheres to help protect the dryads as they morph.

ThingDef.label: dryad healing pod
ThingDef.description: A sphere of fibrous plant matter. A dryad inside is slowly healing its wounds.

ThingDef.label: gaumaker pod
ThingDef.description: The result of the merging of several Gaumaker dryads, this symbiotic plant/animal pod is an essential part of the Gauranlen life cycle. After some time, it will flower into a mature Gauranlen pod which can be harvested to plant a new Gauranlen tree.

ThingDef.label: autobong
ThingDef.description: An automatic smokeleaf-burning device which generates a smoke cloud around itself. Anyone in the cloud will become high on smokeleaf over time.

ThingDef.label: archonexus core
ThingDef.description:
The central core of an archonexus. Its broad surfaces are perfectly clean, and they somehow appear both flat and curved at the same time.

To most, its purpose seems unknowable. However, some say this is part of an archotech itself, and that the one who finds it can invoke the power of the machine god.

The psychic power it emanates is terrifyingly loud and complex, yet dead silent. It is heard without ears, felt without skin, seen without eyes, known without memory. It is the thoughts of a being from another plane of existence. The perceptions are reflected directly into any human mind who ventures too close, and few can hold onto their humanity for long under such mental pressure. Only the psychically-deaf are immune.

ThingDef.label: grand archotech structure
ThingDef.description: A grand archotech structure of towering height and impressive bulk. The shape is hard to perceive, and the surfaces seem to flow when stared at too long. It could have appeared moments ago, or been here thousands of years.\n\nIt emanates intense psychic influence, forcing thoughts and perceptions directly into the mind of anyone who ventures too close. The emanations are not aggressive, but they are utterly alien and impossible to ignore. Sensations unlinked from time or space, the endless rumination of an inhuman mind a billion times larger - the weak-minded lose themselves quickly under. Only the psychically-deaf are immune.

ThingDef.Name: MajorArchotechStructure
ThingDef.label: major archotech structure
ThingDef.description: A large archotech structure. The dull green surface is utterly pristine and undamaged, and so smooth that it's slippery. There is no way to guess how long it has been here, and its purpose seems unfathomable.\n\nThe psychic power it emanates isn't aggressive, but it is overwhelming and inhuman. Like standing inside a threshing machine of whirling blades, inside the heartbeat of a sleeping giant, inside a tight tunnel and you can't move or speak or breathe... Anyone who goes near it will become unsettled unless they are psychically deaf.

ThingDef.label: archotech tower
ThingDef.description: A moderately-sized archotech tower rising from the ground. Traces along its surface glow steadily with a strange color. Humans can only begin to guess at its purpose.

ThingDef.label: headwrap
ThingDef.description: A wrapped piece of fabric which covers the wearer's hair.

ThingDef.label: broadwrap
ThingDef.description: Wrapped fabric sheets that loosely cover the wearer's head and shoulders.

ThingDef.label: visage mask
ThingDef.description: A hard facial mask that resembles a stylized face.

ThingDef.label: slicecap
ThingDef.description: A hard cap that partly covers the wearer's scalp.

ThingDef.label: slave collar
ThingDef.description: An uncomfortable collar made for slaves. It reminds the wearer of their slave status and psychologically suppresses them, reducing the chance of a slave rebellion.

ThingDef.label: authority cap
ThingDef.description: A hat with a stiff brim and peaked top. It's not particularly protective, but it creates a sense of authority and makes the wearer more effective in suppressing slaves.

ThingDef.label: tailcap
ThingDef.description: A thick cap made from animal skin with a stylish bushy tail. Great for keeping warm in winter.

ThingDef.label: shadecone
ThingDef.description: A conical woven hat. Good for keeping cool during long hours in the sun.

ThingDef.label: flophat
ThingDef.description: A large, thick cap, similar to a tuque. It has extra fabric along the back.

ThingDef.label: slave body strap
ThingDef.description: An uncomfortable arrangement of straps around the torso made for slaves. It reminds the wearer of their slave status and psychologically suppresses them, reducing the chance of a slave rebellion.

ThingDef.label: burka
ThingDef.description: A large garment that conceals the wearer's entire head and body.

ThingDef.label: torture crown
ThingDef.description: A crown-like headpiece with stubby inward-facing spikes that poke the head. It is used to induce pain in the wearer.

ThingDef.label: blindfold
ThingDef.description: A long strip of cloth that is wrapped over the eyes to block vision.

ThingDef.label: morbid slab (medium)
ThingDef.description: A stone bas relief of morbid imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: morbid slab (broad)
ThingDef.description: A stone bas relief of morbid imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: totemic slab (medium)
ThingDef.description: A wooden bas relief of totemic imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: totemic slab (broad)
ThingDef.description: A wooden bas relief of totemic imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: spikecore floor-star (medium)
ThingDef.description: A radial arrangement of metal pieces in a spikecore style, for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: spikecore floor-star (broad)
ThingDef.description: A radial arrangement of metal pieces in a spikecore style, for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: rustic rug (medium)
ThingDef.description: A homey rug with a rustic-style pattern, for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: rustic rug (broad)
ThingDef.description: A homey rug with a rustic-style pattern, for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: animalist slab (medium)
ThingDef.description: A wooden bas relief of animalist imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.label: animalist slab (broad)
ThingDef.description: A wooden bas relief of animalist imagery for decorating a floor.

ThingDef.Name: RelicInertBase
ThingDef.description: An object with ideoligious significance.

ThingDef.label: cube
ThingDef.description: A hand-sized cube. While now dormant, it was once unnaturally captivating.

ThingDef.label: nutrifungus
ThingDef.description: A meaty bioengineered mushroom grown for its nutritious value. It can grow on fungal gravel, but only in darkness - exposing it to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.

ThingDef.label: bonsai tree
ThingDef.description: A small tree, pruned and shaped to look visually pleasing.

ThingDef.label: fibercorn
ThingDef.description: An inedible, fibrous plant which produces a small amount of a wood-like substance.

ThingDef.label: timbershroom
ThingDef.description: A tall brown mushroom with a long stem. When harvested, it yields a wood-like substance.

ThingDef.label: Gauranlen tree
ThingDef.description:
A large, distinctive-looking tree with a unique life-cycle. Each Gauranlen tree contains a small non-conscious dryad queen. The queen births creatures called dryads which guard and tend the tree. In exchange, the tree nurtures its protectors by feeding them directly. From the outside, it appears the dryads are created by the tree directly and act as part of it.

It is possible for a person to form a connection with a Gauranlen tree and partially control the dryads it produces.

Some say Gauranlen trees are the homes of nature spirits that follow humanity across worlds.

ThingDef.label: chopped gauranlen stump
ThingDef.description: A stump left behind after a garuanlen tree has been felled. The stump can be extracted but yields very little usable wood. Left outdoors, the stump will deteriorate in time.

ThingDef.label: smashed gauranlen stump
ThingDef.description: The remnants of a gauranlen tree destroyed by damage. It's ugly. The stump can be extracted but yields very little usable wood. Left outdoors, the stump will deteriorate in time.

ThingDef.label: Gauranlen moss
ThingDef.description: Symbiotic moss that grows near Gauranlen trees.

ThingDef.label: Gauranlen pod
ThingDef.description: A small pod that protects a single Gauranlen seed. This seed can be harvested and used to plant a Gauranlen tree.

ThingDef.label: Gauranlen seed
ThingDef.description: The seed of a Gauranlan tree. It can be planted to create a new Gauranlen tree.

ThingDef.label: immature dryad
ThingDef.description: Dryads are small mammalian creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. This immature dryad can support and protect its tree, but its main purpose is to morph into more specialized and powerful dryad forms.

ThingDef.label: woodmaker dryad
ThingDef.description: A slow, bumbling caste of dryad which specializes in wood production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate a wood-like material on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: berrymaker dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in food production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate nourishing berries on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: medicinemaker dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in medicine production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate medicinal herbs on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: gaumaker dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste with the unique ability to produce new Gauranlen pods and reproduce the Gauranlen tree along with its symbiote, the dryad queen. To do this, three gaumaker dryads must slowly merge.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: carrier dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in carrying items. Under human influence, it can help haul things where they need to go.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: clawer dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste with huge claws that is specialized in aggression and damage-dealing attacks. Though it can do tremendous damage, it is vulnerable to attacks itself.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

ThingDef.label: barkskin dryad
ThingDef.description: A dryad caste specialized in absorbing hits during combat. Barkskin dryads are covered by a thick bark-like hide which is partly formed by the Gauranlen tree itself. Under human influence, it can act as a damage-absorbing fighter.\n\nIn general, dryads are mammal-like creatures that have a symbiotic relationship with the Gauranlen tree. They reproduce together with their tree, which contains a hidden dryad queen. Dryads can morph into various specialized castes.

li.label: Missing {BUILDING_label}
li.description: We must have {BUILDING_labelIndef}.

li.label: {BUILDING_labelCap} disrespected
li.description: We have {BUILDING_labelIndef}, but it needs to be placed in a room that satisfies the proper requirements.

li.label: participated in raid
li.description: I participated in a raid! That's how we do it!

li.label: participated in raid
li.description: I participated in a raid! Now they'll all know me!

li.label: recent conquest
li.description: We recently raided another faction. That'll show them who's boss.

li.label: no recent conquest
li.description: It's been far too long since we raided anyone. They might stop fearing and respecting us.

li.label: recent conquest
li.description: We recently raided another faction. Their suffering will be their teacher.

li.label: no recent conquest
li.description: We haven't raided anyone for so long. We're despicable - helpless worms like the rest.

li.label: Lost {ROLE_label} role
li.description: I lost my role as {ROLE_labelDef}.

li.label: No {ROLE_label}
li.description: {0}s must have {ROLE_labelIndef}!

li.label: Want {ROLE_label} apparel
li.description: I want to wear apparel appropriate for my role as {ROLE_labelDef}
I don't like having a {0} as a leader.
It's insulting to be ordered around by a {0}.
It's shameful to be ordered around by a {0}!
To accept direction from a {0} is utterly shameful and abhorrent.

li.label: was enslaved
li.description: They kept me as a slave. They forced me to suffer!

li.label: shared room with slave
li.description: I had to sleep in the same room as a slave.

li.label: Gauranlen death
li.description: My tree... its calming presence became pure pain, then went silent. Its suffering echoes in my mind...

li.label: all relics collected
li.description: We found all of our sacred relics!

li.label: biosculpter pleasure cycle
li.description: Every part of me is somehow better at feeling good.

li.label: dryad died
li.description: My tree's dryad is gone forever. You shall be missed, little one.

li.label: failed to convert {0}
li.description: I tried to convert someone and it didn't work out. Awkward.

li.label: {0} tried to convert me
li.description: Someone tried to convert me. I wish they'd just leave me alone.

li.label: counselled by {0}
li.description: I received counseling about something that's been bothering me.

li.label: failed consolation by {0}
li.description: Somehow, that attempt at helping made things even worse.

li.label: counselled by {0}
li.description: I received counseling from someone. It felt nice to be listened to.

li.label: tended by {0}
li.description: I received medical aid from one who carries the special healer status of my ideoligion.

li.label: observed gibbet cage
li.description: What a terrible sight.

li.label: observed skullspike
li.description: What a terrible sight.

li.label: {RELICNAME} at ritual
li.description: {RELICNAME} was present during our ritual.

li.label: two relics at ritual
li.description: Two relics were present during our ritual.

li.label: three relics at ritual
li.description: Three relics were present during our ritual.

li.label: exonerated
li.description: They had nothing on me, and I showed them!

li.label: failed trial
li.description: I made an accusation and couldn't even make it stick. This is humiliating.

li.label: convicted
li.description: I was unjustly convicted of a terrible wrongdoing!

li.label: terrible party
li.description: That party was terrible. Bad music, awkward dancing... ugh.

li.label: boring party
li.description: That party was not good. Uninteresting music, poor dancing. Wish I never went.

li.label: fun party
li.description: That was a fun party. A good break from daily life.

li.label: unforgettable party
li.description: That party was awesome! The music, the mood... Everything was perfect.

li.label: disgraceful funeral
li.description: That funeral was borderline insulting to everyone involved.

li.label: lackluster funeral
li.description: That funeral was really uninspired and didn't resolve anything.

li.label: good funeral
li.description: That funeral went well - a good way to say goodbye.

li.label: heartwarming funeral
li.description: That funeral went perfectly - it brought up a lot of good memories and showed us a path forward.

li.label: terrible festival
li.description: That festival was horrible. I'm still cringing from the awkwardness flashbacks.

li.label: boring festival
li.description: That festival was awkward. I wish I could have left.

li.label: fun festival
