li.description: I had fun! We got to hang out and relax.

li.label: unforgettable festival
li.description: That festival was something I'll never forget.

li.label: terrible sacrifice
li.description: That sacrifice was botched and the mood was way off. What an awful, awkward death.

li.label: boring sacrifice
li.description: That sacrifice lacked passion and the technique wasn't great.

li.label: satisfying sacrifice
li.description: That sacrifice was satisfying - well-executed and appropriately bloody.

li.label: spectacular sacrifice
li.description: The blood! The release! That sacrifice made me feel like we were connecting with another world.

li.label: terrible skylantern festival
li.description: I hated having to make that skylantern, and they looked like garbage anyway.

li.label: boring skylanterns
li.description: Those skylanterns didn't impress me. Just a waste of time and resources.

li.label: beautiful skylantern festival
li.description: I felt at peace as the lanterns drifted off.

li.label: unforgettable skylantern festival
li.description: The sense of togetherness during construction, the moment of release - it was like my troubles drifted away with those skylanterns.

li.label: terrible scarification
li.description: The scarification was botched and the mood was way off. What an awkward ceremony.

li.label: boring scarification
li.description: That scarification lacked passion and the technique wasn't great.

li.label: satisfying scarification
li.description: That scarification was satisfying - cleanly-traced and appropriately painful-looking.

li.label: spectacular scarification
li.description: The flesh curled and shaped like magic under the knife. It was a true transformation through suffering!

li.label: terrible blinding
li.description: That blinding was botched and the mood was way off. What an awkward ceremony.

li.label: boring blinding
li.description: That blinding lacked passion and the technique wasn't great.

li.label: satisfying blinding
li.description: That blinding was satisfying. The cut was deep and made a satisfying wet-sucking noise.

li.label: spectacular blinding
li.description: The intoned voices, the terrible and amazing blade, the painful shivering and cutting - That blinding ceremony was sublime!

li.label: effective conversion
li.description: That conversion ritual went well. The speech was stirring and enjoyable to listen to.

li.label: masterful conversion
li.description: Masterful! Old beliefs were left in tatters, and our true knowledge was accepted without a shadow of a doubt.

li.label: terrible duel
li.description: That duel was horrible. I'm still cringing thinking about the bumbling cowardice.

li.label: boring duel
li.description: That duel was awkward. No aggressive energy, just attempts to survive.

li.label: good duel
li.description: That duel was good. The fighters really showed heart.

li.label: unforgettable duel
li.description: The courage... the blood... the death... I could never forget that.

li.label: awkward execution
li.description: That execution was awkward. The incompetence on display made the whole thing feel unjustified.

li.label: satisfying execution
li.description: That execution was satisfying. It felt like justice was served.

li.label: spectacular execution
li.description: That execution was electrifying! Never have I felt such a sensation of justice being served.

li.label: look change desired
li.description: The way I look doesn't match who I am today. I want to change it.

li.label: masochist collared
li.description: Such restrictive discomfort... Delightful.

li.label: masochist body strapped
li.description: The straps press in and calm my soul.

li.label: wearing favorite color
li.description: I just love this color.

li.label: wearing ideoligion color
li.description: My apparel coloring is properly expressing my beliefs.

li.label: conversion resentment
li.description: Someone tried to convert me. I hate being proselytized this way.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: These thoughts coming from the structure, they open doors to such vastness... I feel so small that I might disappear.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: I can feel the edge of its wordless whispers... They make me uneasy.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: It makes me perceive so much. Eyeless knowledge of absolute existence, all minds speaking and dying and birthing at once. It's hard not to lose connection with myself.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: It pays no attention to me but I sense the edge of its perception. Flashes of terrifying timeless sight. Hard to ignore.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: The scale of it. The fractal logic-scape of the multiversal hyperplane. No distance. No time. No me or them. I'm everything. I'm nothing.

li.label: archotech emanation
li.description: I can feel the edge of its thoughts, see the endless scope when I close my eyes. I need to focus on my physical body or I drift away.

tips.li: Slaves work slower than normal colonists due to lack of motivation.
Terror-inducing buildings affect anyone within a 5-cell radius.
Sleep accelerators increase colonists' sleep quality, but also increase hunger rate. Consider assigning them more frequent, short naps to prevent starvation during sleep.

ConceptDef.label: editing memes
ConceptDef.helpText: You can edit memes by clicking on them.

ConceptDef.label: editing precepts
ConceptDef.helpText: You can edit precepts by clicking on them.

WorldObjectDef.label: archotech structure
WorldObjectDef.description: An archotech structure that you can study.

AbilityDef.label: bloodfeed
AbilityDef.description: Bite the target and extract hemogen directly from their blood. The target will lose blood and will be horrified by the interaction, but will be otherwise unharmed. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target non-hemogenic humans. Hemogen gain is affected by the target's body size.

AbilityDef.label: coagulate
AbilityDef.description: Use special glands in the wrists to quickly tend someone's wounds.

AbilityDef.label: implant genes
AbilityDef.description: Implant this person's xenogenes into a willing subject using a special injector organ. If this person's genes are currently regrowing, they will implant their xenogerm and die in the process.\n\nWhen implanted, a xenogerm will overwrite the target's xenogenes. Germline genes will be unaffected.

AbilityDef.label: piercing spine
AbilityDef.description: Use a hemogenic chemical reaction to launch a bony spine at the target. The spine exits through the skin from an opening between the collarbones. Given the method of launch, it is surprisingly easy to aim.

AbilityDef.label: resurrect
AbilityDef.description: Use archites in the bloodstream to infuse a corpse's body with new life, repairing degenerated cell structures and kickstarting vital functions. The older and worse-preserved the corpse is, the more likely it is that they will come back with memory loss or health conditions. This ability seems to exhaust the archites somehow, so it can only be used very rarely.

AbilityDef.label: acid spray
AbilityDef.description: Spray a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.

AbilityDef.label: foam spray
AbilityDef.description: Spray thick fire-retardant foam from glands in the neck up through the mouth. The foam will cover a small area and extinguish any fire it touches.

AbilityDef.label: fire spew
AbilityDef.description: Spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from the mouth. The bile can ignite anything or anyone it hits, and also form flaming pools on the ground.\n\nThe bile is generated and stored by an organ in the neck, along with a separate pouch of hypergolic reactant for ignition.

AbilityDef.Name: LongJump
AbilityDef.label: longjump
AbilityDef.description: Jump to a distant location using super-strong hemogen-powered legs.

AbilityDef.label: fire burst
AbilityDef.description: Emit a burst of burning fuel in all directions to form puddles of ignited liquid on the ground.

AbilityDef.label: animal warcall
AbilityDef.description: With a powerful bellow and psychic connection, call an animal to fight your enemies for a few hours.

AbilityDef.Name: LongJumpMech
AbilityDef.label: mech longjump
AbilityDef.description: Jump to a distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.

AbilityDef.label: jump launcher
AbilityDef.description: Jump to a distant location using a built-in jump launcher.

AbilityDef.label: mech smokepop
AbilityDef.description: Release compressed smoke from concealed vents. Smoke reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.

AbilityDef.label: firefoam pop
AbilityDef.description: Release a fire-retardant foam in a circular area.

AbilityDef.label: resurrect mech
AbilityDef.description: Resurrect a recently-killed mechanoid by externally supercharging its self-repair processes. The mechanoid will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed.

BossgroupDef.leaderDescription: The {LEADERKIND_label} is equipped with a concrete-melting hellsphere cannon. It is slow to charge, but when it fires it will annihilate anything in the blast circle.
The {LEADERKIND_label} has a built-in mech gestator and is capable of deploying war urchin combat mechs.
The {LEADERKIND_label} is a psychically-present mechanoid commander who can resurrect recently-killed mechs and jump long distances. It carries a long-range toxic needle gun.

FactionDef.label: fierce neanderthal tribe
FactionDef.description: An unfriendly, territorial tribe of neanderthals. They are open to peaceful trade, but are otherwise unfriendly and territorial. Warriors from their tribe won't hesitate to bash in the skulls of anyone they deem dangerous. Their numbers, and the extreme amounts of damage they absorb before falling make them serious foes despite their lack of technology and analytical ability.\n\nHaving been on this planet for countless generations, they have no memory of how they got here. They might be the descendants of a neanderthal service caste from a dead civilization, or even the leftovers from some ancient science experiment.

FactionDef.label: yttakin pirates
FactionDef.description: A close-knit band of hulking, fur-bodied pirates of the yttakin xenotype. They refuse to deal with outsiders and are quick to call their animal warriors against those who disrespect them - or whose wealth they intend to take.\n\nOriginally engineered to populate the icy planet Yttak, yttakin now pursue their traditional lifestyle on many worlds.

FactionDef.label: savage impid tribe
FactionDef.description: A vicious tribe of yellow-skinned, fire-spewing impids. This particular tribe has no intention of coexisting peacefully with anyone else. Their warriors are experts at using their natural speed and flame attacks to burn the towns and children of other peoples.\n\nHaving been here for thousands of years, the origins of this tribe are lost in myth. They might descend from a group of settlers who lost their technology, or an impid community in some long-ruined civilization.

FactionDef.label: rough pig union
FactionDef.description: A loose union of hardy pigskin townships. They're willing to make friends, even with thinsnouts, but they're also ready to toss a bomb and gnaw human gristle when it suits them. Treat them with respect and they'll offer a trotter to an ally in need. Turn against them and the last thing you hear might be a triumphant battle squeal.

FactionDef.label: waster pirates
FactionDef.description: A loose collection of violent pirate bands made up primarily of wasters - xenohumans engineered to thrive around toxins and pollution. They have little interest in building, or farming, preferring to take their sustenance from others using violence.\n\nTheir technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.

FactionDef.label: sanguophages
FactionDef.description: A group of ancient sanguophages.

GameConditionDef.label: acidic smog
GameConditionDef.description: Acidic smog is caused by pollution in nearby world tiles. It slows plant growth, deteriorates exposed items, and reduces mood.\n\nThe current world tile has a nearby pollution score of {NEARBYPOLLUTION}, calculated by adding up pollution of nearby world tiles. This means that, on average, acidic smog will occur every {MTB} days.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: Acidic smog has begun due to pollution in this region of the world.

GeneDef.label: fire spew
GeneDef.description: Carriers are able to spew flammable bile generated by a special organ in their neck. The bile sticks to anything in a small area and can ignite people, objects, and the ground.

GeneDef.label: foam spray
GeneDef.description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a fire-retardant foam. They can spew this foam over an area to extinguish fires.

GeneDef.label: longjump legs
GeneDef.description: Carriers have special hemogen-powered muscle fibers in their legs which allow them to jump great distances.

GeneDef.label: animal warcall
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can perform an animal warcall, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call an animal to fight for them.

GeneDef.label: bloodfeeder
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite an unresisting person, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.

GeneDef.label: coagulate
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have special glands on their hands and wrists, as well as a unique salivary compound that they can use to rapidly tend wounds.

GeneDef.label: gene implanter
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a somewhat gross-looking injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Germline genes will be unaffected.

GeneDef.label: piercing spine
GeneDef.description: Carriers grow an opening in their upper chest along with a quiver of keratin spines. Using a hemogen-powered chemical reaction, they can fire these spines at high speed at nearby targets with surprising accuracy.

GeneDef.label: acid spray
GeneDef.description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a sticky acid substance, along with acid-tolerant tissues in the mouth. They can spew this acid over an area, where it will stick to enemies and burn them.

GeneDef.label: no hair
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow no hair on the head.

GeneDef.label: short-haired
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can only grow short hair.

GeneDef.label: long-haired
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow hair on the head very quickly.

GeneDef.label: grayless hair
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene keep their natural hair color as they age.

GeneDef.label: only bushy beards
GeneDef.description: Male carriers of this gene experience rapid beard growth and are uncomfortable cutting their beards.

GeneDef.label: beardless
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow no facial hair.

GeneDef.label: unisex beards
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene always have thick facial hair, even women.

GeneDef.label: ink black skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a pale black color almost as dark as ink.

GeneDef.label: slate gray skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin slate gray.

GeneDef.label: light gray skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this produce a light-gray pigment in their skin.

GeneDef.label: sheer white skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have sheer white skin, unlike natural skin tones, due to a special engineered reflective cell covering.

GeneDef.label: blue skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a blue color.

GeneDef.label: purple skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a purple color.

GeneDef.label: pale red skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a moderate red color.

GeneDef.label: deep red skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a deep-red pigment that gives their skin an almost bloody appearance.

GeneDef.label: pale yellow skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a grayish yellow color.

GeneDef.label: deep yellow skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a deep yellow color.

GeneDef.label: orange skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin an orange color.

GeneDef.label: green skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a green color.

GeneDef.label: furskin
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur all over their body, which protects them from cold temperatures.

GeneDef.label: red eyes
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have deeply red-pigmented eyes.

GeneDef.label: gray eyes
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have pale white-gray eyes.

GeneDef.label: heavy brow
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a prominent brow.

GeneDef.label: furry tail
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow a fluffy tail which partially protects them from cold temperatures.

GeneDef.label: smooth tail
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow a slender tail that can act as a dexterous fifth limb.

GeneDef.label: facial ridges
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow raised ridges of skin on their face.

GeneDef.label: fat body
GeneDef.description: Carriers can have fat bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

GeneDef.label: thin body
GeneDef.description: Carriers can have thin bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

GeneDef.label: hulk body
GeneDef.description: Carriers can have large bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

GeneDef.label: standard body
GeneDef.description: Carriers can have average-shaped bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

GeneDef.label: human ears
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regular human ears.

GeneDef.label: pig ears
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene will grow pointed pig-like ears.

GeneDef.label: floppy ears
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow long, floppy hound-like ears.

GeneDef.label: cat ears
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have cat-like ears.

GeneDef.label: pointed ears
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have pointed ears.

GeneDef.label: human nose
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regular human noses.

GeneDef.label: pig nose
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have pig-like snouts.

GeneDef.label: human jaw
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regularly-shaped jaws.

GeneDef.label: heavy jaw
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have large jaws.

GeneDef.label: gaunt head
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a pinched, gaunt appearance in their face and head.

GeneDef.label: human hands
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regular human hands.

GeneDef.label: trotter hands
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble pig trotters. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects.

GeneDef.label: elongated fingers
GeneDef.description: Long, delicate fingers improve the carrier's manipulation capacity. This aids with many tasks, especially crafting and construction.

GeneDef.label: human headbone
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regular human skulls.

GeneDef.label: mini-horns
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow two small horns protruding from the forehead.

GeneDef.label: center-horn
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow a single horn protruding from the center of the forehead.

GeneDef.label: human voice
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have regular human vocal cords.

GeneDef.label: pig voice
GeneDef.description: Carriers have a squealing voice like that of a pig.

GeneDef.label: roar voice
GeneDef.description: Carriers have an animal-like roaring voice.

GeneDef.label: slow wound healing
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds half as fast as normal.

GeneDef.label: fast wound healing
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds twice as fast as normal.

GeneDef.label: superfast wound healing
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds four times as fast as normal.

GeneDef.label: weak immunity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases more slowly than normal. They may die from infections that others would survive.

GeneDef.label: strong immunity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases faster than normal.

GeneDef.label: super immunity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases considerably faster than normal.

GeneDef.label: partial antitoxic lungs
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are resistant to environmental toxins. They get less toxic buildup from tox gas, polluted terrain, and toxic fallout, but are still vulnerable to direct attacks with venom or injected poison. Additionally, they build up rot stink exposure slower.

GeneDef.label: total antitoxic lungs
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are immune to environmental toxins, but not from direct toxic attacks. They get no toxic buildup from tox gas, polluted terrain, or toxic fallout, and they are not bothered by acidic smog. They are still vulnerable to direct attacks like venom and injected poison. Additionally, they are immune to rot stink exposure.

GeneDef.label: sterile
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene cannot reproduce by natural means.

GeneDef.label: fertile
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a higher chance of becoming pregnant or impregnating others.

GeneDef.label: superclotting
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have extra-power coagulating factors in their blood, and will stop bleeding very quickly when wounded.

GeneDef.label: kind instinct
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are high in trait agreeableness and are very conscientious. They rarely insult others and will sometimes offer kind words to brighten the moods of those around them. They also never judge people by their appearance.

GeneDef.label: violence disabled
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are emotionally and mentally incapable of engaging in violence. They are overwhelmingly resistant to and horrified by the idea of hurting another.

GeneDef.label: nearsighted
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have difficulty seeing at a distance. Their shooting accuracy at long ranges is reduced.

GeneDef.label: strong stomach
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an extra toxin-filtering organ in their stomach and will never suffer from food poisoning even after eating rotten food.

GeneDef.label: dark vision
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene see well in low light and are unaffected by mood penalties related to darkness. They have a reflective layer behind the retina that amplifies their ability to see in the dark.

GeneDef.label: kill thirst
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene lust for the feeling of ending another's life. They will become irritated if they go for too long without killing someone in close combat.

GeneDef.label: fire resistant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have special fast-acting sweat glands and heat-resistant skin. They only take 25% of the normal damage from fire. The chance of them catching on fire is also drastically reduced.

GeneDef.label: inbred
GeneDef.description: This genetic condition affects a person's fertility, immunity, and mental capacity.

GeneDef.label: robust digestion
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold stomach, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all.

GeneDef.label: mild cell instability
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene need less metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.

GeneDef.label: major cell instability
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene need much less metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of greatly-reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.

GeneDef.label: psychic bonding
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a special neural organ that makes them psychically bond with a lover for life. As long as the lovers are together, they will be happy. If they are physically separated, they will be disturbed by the distance. If one dies, the other's mind will be badly disrupted.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Gains psychic bond with first romantic partner.

GeneDef.label: pollution stimulus
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene get a chemical rush from being exposed to pollution. This makes them move faster and helps them think clearer. A similar gene is found in combat-engineered mega-insects.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Gain stat bonuses when exposed to pollution.

GeneDef.label: unstoppable
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are not slowed down when taking damage.

GeneDef.label: naked speed
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene move slower while clothed, and faster while naked.

GeneDef.label: hemogenic
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a reserve of biological strength powered by a resource called hemogen. The resource can be gained and spent in various ways, all of which are unlocked by other genes.\n\nCarriers lose 2 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
GeneDef.resourceDescription:
A reserve of biological strength which can be gained and spent in a variety of ways.

Hemogen can be increased by bloodfeeding from a human or consuming hemogen packs. You can obtain hemogen packs using the 'extract hemogen pack' medical operation on a non-hemogenic human.

If hemogen reaches zero, {PAWN_nameDef} will become very unhappy.

GeneDef.label: hemogen drain
GeneDef.description: Carriers lose an additional 8 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

GeneDef.label: tinderskin
GeneDef.description: Carriers have dry, thin skin which burns easily from fire, and their immune systems react very poorly to this kind of threat. Damage from fire is multiplied by 4.

GeneDef.label: pyrophobia
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an intense fear of fire. When fires are close, there is a chance they will have a mental breakdown at any moment.

customEffectDescriptions.li: May have a mental breakdown when near fires.

li.label: afraid of fire
li.description: The flames make me so nervous. Such searing heat - I feel like it will leap at me at any moment!

GeneDef.label: perfect immunity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have archite-enhanced immune systems which intelligently destroy invaders. They are totally immune to most normal illnesses.

GeneDef.label: non-senescent
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia.

GeneDef.label: scarless
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a special type of regenerator cell which can heal old wounds and chronic illnesses like bad back.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Every (*DateTime)15-30 days(/DateTime), one old wound or chronic illness is healed.

GeneDef.label: deathrest
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene must periodically regenerate themselves in a special coma called deathrest. Deathrest takes days, but can confer substantial bonuses. Deathrest can be accelerated and its effects enhanced by the use of a variety of special buildings and technologies.\n\nThose who put off deathresting will suffer from deathrest exhaustion.

GeneDef.label: ageless
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have archites in the bloodstream which continuously reverse the process of aging. Starting at the age of 13, carriers begin to biologically age slower. By 18, the aging process stops completely.

GeneDef.label: deathless
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have archites in the blood which will sustain their life processes no matter what. As long as the brain remains intact, a carrier of this gene will never die.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Can only die from destruction of brain.

GeneDef.label: archite metabolism
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have special archites in their cells that facilitate and optimize metabolism. This improves overall genetic and metabolic quality.

GeneDef.label: cold weakness
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are slightly less comfortable in cold temperatures.

GeneDef.label: cold tolerant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are slightly more comfortable in cold temperatures.

GeneDef.label: cold super-tolerant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are much more comfortable in cold temperatures.

GeneDef.label: heat super-tolerant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are more comfortable in warm temperatures.

GeneDef.label: heat tolerant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are slightly more comfortable in warm temperatures.

GeneDef.label: heat weakness
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are slightly less comfortable in warm temperatures.

GeneDef.label: psychically deaf
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are deaf to all psychic energy and influence outside their own minds. They cannot be affected by psychic influence, nor can they ever wield psychic power.

GeneDef.label: psychically dull
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are less psychically-sensitive than others.

GeneDef.label: psy-sensitive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are more psychically-sensitive than average.

GeneDef.label: super psy-sensitive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are much more psychically-sensitive than most.

GeneDef.label: slow runner
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene move more slowly than normal.

GeneDef.label: fast runner
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene move more quickly than normal.

GeneDef.label: very fast runner
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene move much more quickly than normal.

GeneDef.label: very unattractive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have misshapen, asymmetrical facial structures and blotchy skin. They're hard to look at.

GeneDef.label: unattractive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have exaggerated facial features and poor skin that are generally considered ugly.

GeneDef.label: attractive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have unusually symmetrical, balanced facial features and extra-clear skin which gives them a pleasing appearance.

GeneDef.label: very attractive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have remarkably precise and symmetrical faces. Their features are distinctive and strong without being exaggerated, and their skin is nearly perfect. They are generally seen as beautiful.

GeneDef.label: slow study
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have deficient long-term memories and don't understand new ideas quickly. They are slow at learning new skills and knowledge.

GeneDef.label: quick study
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have excellent memories and grasp new ideas quickly. They learn faster than others.

GeneDef.label: very unhappy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to negative emotion. They'll see the bad in every situation and have a much lower mood than others.

GeneDef.label: unhappy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are predisposed to pessimistic perceptions. They'll tend to interpret things negatively and have lower mood than others.

GeneDef.label: happy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are predisposed to optimistic feelings. They'll have higher mood than others.

GeneDef.label: very happy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to optimism and not at all inclined to think negatively. They'll have much higher mood than others.

GeneDef.label: tox resistance
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are resistant to toxic buildup from any source. This includes pollution, toxic fallout, tox gas, and direct attacks with venom or injected poison. They'll gain half the amount of toxic buildup compared to others.\n\nCellular filters in the lung and skin reduce the dose of toxins entering the bloodstream.

GeneDef.label: tox immunity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are totally immune to toxic buildup from all sources including polluted terrain, toxic fallout, tox gas, and direct attacks with venom or injected poison. They are also not bothered by acidic smog.\n\nThe carrier's biochemical pathways are modified to route around interference from nearly all known toxins. Along with enhancements to the kidneys and liver, this keeps carriers comfortable in even the most toxic of environments.

GeneDef.label: delicate
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene take greater injuries than others from the same damage. They have thin, brittle bones and less binding molecules in joints and flesh.

GeneDef.label: robust
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene take less injuries than others from the same damage. They have thickened, densified bones, nearly-solid ribcages, and strengthened binding factors in joints and flesh.

GeneDef.label: reduced pain
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene feel half as much pain compared to a baseliner. Reduced neuron activity in the brain's nociception centers makes pain dull and faint. This can be advantageous sometimes, and dangerous other times.

GeneDef.label: extra pain
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene feel more pain than others given the same injuries. Neuron activity in the brain's nociception center is amplified, so pain feels extra-intense and fiery. This can be protective, but overall it's considered a negative and makes it hard to push through difficult situations.

GeneDef.label: dead calm
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene feel calm in every situation and have a very placid demeanor. They will never start social fights or have aggressive mental breaks.

GeneDef.label: aggressive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are quick to anger. They are twice as likely to start social fights. When they have mental breaks, they are twice as likely to choose an aggressive kind of break.

GeneDef.label: hyper-aggressive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are hormonally high-strung and very aggressive. They are three times as likely to start social fights. Any mental break they have will be of an aggressive type.

GeneDef.label: very sleepy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene get tired much faster than others.

GeneDef.label: sleepy
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene get tired somewhat faster than others.

GeneDef.label: low sleep
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene get tired less quickly than others.

GeneDef.label: never sleep
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a unique metabolic process which allows clusters of neurons to sleep while the rest of the brain stays awake. They never need to sleep.

GeneDef.label: weak melee damage
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene do less damage in close-quarters combat. Weak fast-twitch muscle fibers make their strikes shaky and weak.

GeneDef.label: strong melee damage
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene do more damage in close-quarters combat. Extra-strong fast-twitch muscle fibers make their strikes accurate and powerful.

GeneDef.label: mild UV sensitivity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react painfully to UV radiation. They are unusually sensitive to sunlight.

GeneDef.label: intense UV sensitivity
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are intensely sensitive to sunlight.

GeneDef.label: low libido
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are less likely to engage in lovin' with their partner.

GeneDef.label: high libido
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are more likely to engage in lovin' with their partner.

GeneTemplateDef.label: awful {0}
GeneTemplateDef.description: The carrier's aptitude in {0} is reduced by 8. Aptitude acts like an offset on skill level. Additionally, all passion is removed from {0}.

GeneTemplateDef.label: poor {0}
GeneTemplateDef.description: The carrier's aptitude in {0} is reduced by 4. Aptitude acts like an offset on skill level.

GeneTemplateDef.label: strong {0}
GeneTemplateDef.description: The carrier's aptitude in {0} is increased by 4. Aptitude acts like an offset on skill level.

GeneTemplateDef.label: great {0}
GeneTemplateDef.description: The carrier's aptitude in {0} is increased by 8. Aptitude acts like an offset on skill level. Additionally, one level of passion is added to {0}.

GeneTemplateDef.label: {0} dependency
GeneTemplateDef.description: Carriers of this gene need to ingest {0} on a regular basis to survive. After {DEFICIENCYDURATION} without {0}, carriers will suffer from {0} deficiency. After {COMADURATION}, they will fall into a coma. After {DEATHDURATION}, they will die.

GeneTemplateDef.label: {0} resistant
GeneTemplateDef.description: Carriers are only half as likely to become addicted to {0}.

GeneTemplateDef.label: {0} impervious
GeneTemplateDef.description: Carriers of this gene never get addicted to {0}.

XenotypeDef.label: baseliner
XenotypeDef.description: A naturally-evolved human with no major significant genetic modifications.

XenotypeDef.label: dirtmole
XenotypeDef.description: With gray skin adapted to artificial light, they thrive in cramped and dark spaces where combat and travel happen over short distances. They are extremely capable at digging or mining tasks. In the open, however, they suffer from a sensitivity to light, slow speed and poor eyesight at distance.\n\nAfter the first tunnel colonies failed due to the stress of confinement, colonization agencies began genetically altering colonists to live without open space or sunlight. This xenotype is known colloquially as the dirtmoles. Today, dirtmoles have expanded out of their original tunnel homes and rule many confined spaces in the anthrosphere. They can be found in deep mines, cramped low-tech spacecraft, and teeming by the billions in the dark underlayers of countless urbworlds.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: With gray skin adapted to artificial light, dirtmoles thrive in cramped and dark spaces where combat and travel happen over short distances. They are naturals at digging and navigating complex tunnel structures. In the open, they suffer from a sensitivity to light, slow speed and poor eyesight at distance.

XenotypeDef.label: genie
XenotypeDef.description: Designed to be engineers, genies' delicate bones and natural aptitude with machines allow them to manipulate devices with remarkable precision. They are emotionally cold and can follow orders where others might panic. However, they are fragile, and their amplified nerve impulses make them easy to debilitate with relatively little pain. With so much of their brains dedicated to analyzing machines, they lack the neural hardware to analyze emotions, so they sometimes come off as socially inept. Their dead calm makes it even harder for them to relate to what they see as madly-hotheaded baseliner humans.\n\nGenies were engineered thousands of years ago by a long-disbanded space navy to hold engineering positions on large starships. Today, genies still serve as engineers in great cities and fleets, but many can also be found working as lawyers, pilots, and musicians.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Designed to be engineers, genies have natural aptitude with machines, and are emotionally cold and calm. They are also fragile and vulnerable to pain. Focused on machines, they often come off as socially inept.

XenotypeDef.label: hussar
XenotypeDef.description:
Hussars are engineered soldiers. They fight aggressively and with precision, heal fast, thrive in extreme temperatures, and freely ingest military drugs. They have a genetic dependence on go-juice, which also makes them less likely to rebel against their commanders.

While hussars' emotions make them dangerous in combat, they can't relate to baseliner humans. They are famous for their blood-red eyes and "hussar stare", a dead expression that unsettles many people. Their lack of expression and burning aggressive nature has led to many violent misunderstandings.

In most societies where they live, hussars are kept separated from the rest of the population. Hussars are single-purpose tools - and they generally aren't bothered by the fact.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Hussars are engineered soldiers. They fight aggressively and with precision, heal fast, thrive in extreme temperatures, and freely ingest military drugs. They have a genetic dependence on go-juice.

XenotypeDef.label: sanguophage
XenotypeDef.description:
Sanguophages are a type of archotech-enhanced xenohuman. Powered by archites, their abilities go far beyond normal genetic enhancements. They are mentally adept and preternaturally beautiful. In combat, they can launch deadly spines and heal injured friends. They don't age or die naturally and never suffer from disease or poison. A sanguophage can make a new sanguophage by reimplanting their own xenogerm into a person.

Sanguophages must regularly consume hemogen derived from human blood, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.

The first sanguophage appeared thousands of years ago when the lord-explorer Varan-Dur sought to control a hyperintelligent archotech and found himself transformed by it instead. Every sanguophage is descended from him. Since then, sanguophages have often been hunted because of their destabilizing power and their need for blood. Since they can pass for baseliners, many live in hiding among typical humans.

Their numbers are unknown. Some think they are legends or rare irrelevancies. Some believe sanguophages secretly direct entire human civilizations. The stories speak of eternal lords ruling billions from slate-black space stations, or directing blood sacrifices at conferences in the underlayers of the deepest urbworlds.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Sanguophages are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are beautiful and extremely intelligent. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they can launch deadly spines and heal injured friends. The price is that sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from human blood to survive, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.

XenotypeDef.label: neanderthal
XenotypeDef.description: Neanderthals are stocky, powerfully-built humanoids. Their most salient characteristic is that they are difficult to hurt: They are very resistant to injury, and their strong immune systems protect them from infection. However, without ever having evolved in a complex civilization, they are less adept than baseliner humans at intellectual and social tasks, and their impulsiveness can make them dangerously aggressive.\n\nHomo neanderthalensis was originally an archaic population of hominids that emerged over 200,000 years ago during the Pleistocene epoch. After they were replaced by and merged with humans 30,000 years ago, they were absent for tens of thousands of years until scientists resurrected them from ancient DNA. Neanderthals now survive in sub-societies on some settled planets. On the rimworlds, neanderthal tribes carve out the same existence as their Earth ancestors did so long ago.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Neanderthals are stocky, powerfully-built humanoids. They are hardy and difficult to injure, and their strong immune systems protect them from infection. However, their minds are less adept at intellectual and social tasks, and their impulsiveness can make them dangerously aggressive.

XenotypeDef.label: pigskin
XenotypeDef.description: Pigskins are human-pig hybrids which are capable of two-legged movement, tool use, and speech, but which also retain many pig-like qualities. They are hardy and can eat almost anything without getting sick, but their trotter-shaped hands leave them at a disadvantage when attempting to precisely manipulate tools and objects. They don't see well at a distance, so pigskin gangs usually focus on close-range weapons. They also have a strong taste for explosives.\n\nPigskins were made for their organs. Uncomfortable with the idea of harvesting organs from baseliner humans, a long-gone government merged human DNA into pigs to make the animals produce more easily-transplantable hearts and lungs. They succeeded, but the resulting creatures became more humanlike than anyone anticipated.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Pigskins are human-pig hybrids. They are hardy and can eat almost anything without getting sick, but their trotter-shaped hands are bad at fine manipulation. They don't see well at a distance, so they usually focus on close-range weapons. They have a strong taste for explosives.

XenotypeDef.label: impid
XenotypeDef.description: Made for desert life, impid cultures live on many rimworlds and dry deathworlds. Impids are extremely fast-moving, easily tolerate high temperatures, and can spew fire from their mouths. Though they are masters on the sand, impids struggle in other environments. They are terrible with farming. They fight well at range, but in close combat their physical weakness becomes apparent.\n\nOutlanders call them dustrunners because of their speed over open terrain and resistance to heat. Some tribes call them devils because of their horns and because they burn their enemies. Impid tribes' combat tactics usually center on rapid-approach incendiary attacks using both handheld fire weapons and their fire spew ability.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Made for desert life, impids are very fast, can spew fire from their mouths, and easily tolerate high temperatures. They fight well at range, but in close combat they do little damage. They are terrible with farming, and have weak immune systems.

XenotypeDef.label: waster
XenotypeDef.description: Wasters are aggressive, immune to toxic pollution, almost impervious to disease, and can ingest as much psychite and wake-up drugs as they wish with no ill effects. Their toxin-adapted metabolism means they must consume some form of psychite - usually flake or yayo.\n\nOriginally engineered to prevent resettlement of post-apocalyptic deathworlds, wasters are living area-denial weapons. Waster pirates armed with toxic weapons are the bane of many frontier peoples, both on the rimworlds and in the depths of the urbworld hyperstructures.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Wasters are aggressive, immune to toxic pollution, almost impervious to disease, and can ingest as much psychite and wake-up drugs as they wish with no ill effects. Their toxin-adapted metabolism means they must consume some form of psychite - usually flake or yayo.

XenotypeDef.label: yttakin
XenotypeDef.description: Yttakin descend from colonists engineered to thrive on ultra-cold planets. Their great size and fur make them hardy in frozen environments. Yttakin share a psychic connection with the wildlife and can summon animals to their side during battles. They are not fast or energetic or precise, but can keep going when others would have collapsed long before.\n\nSince they migrated off their icy birthworld of Yttak, Yttakin settlements live on many planets. Their fur, roaring voices, and aversion to urban living sometimes leads naive outsiders to believe they are simple-minded animals. Quick-minded Yttakin are happy to make good use of such wrong beliefs, whether at the negotiating table or on the battlefield.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Yttakin descend from colonists engineered to thrive on ultra-cold planets. Their great size and fur make them hardy in frozen environments, and they have a unique ability to communicate vocally and psychically with animals. They are not fast or energetic or precise, but can keep going when others would have collapsed long before.

XenotypeDef.label: highmate
XenotypeDef.description: Designed companions and concubines with a unique ability to psychically bond with a mate, highmates are empathic, beautiful, cheerful, and talented in social matters. They are also inept at manual tasks, physically weak, and mentally incapable of violence.\n\nOn a few wealthy worlds, highmate xenogerms are commercially available and some people become highmates as a sort of career. However, many societies find them abhorrent, either because they distract people from forming natural families, or because they are humans shaped to serve the pleasures of another. On such worlds they are either reserved as playthings of the powerful, or banned entirely. This particular line of highmate fits the fashions of classical Novaroma, but many other variants exist.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Designed companions and concubines with a unique ability to psychically bond with a mate, highmates are empathic, beautiful, cheerful, and talented in social matters. They are also inept at manual tasks, physically weak, and mentally incapable of violence.

ThingDef.label: detoxifier lung
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial lung that uses microfilters to reduce the intake of environmental toxins, allowing the user to survive longer in polluted environments. Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smog and prevents lung rot in this lung.

HediffDef.label: detoxifier lung
HediffDef.description: An installed detoxifier lung. Prevents lung rot in this lung and negates the irritation of acidic smog.\n\nNote that the detoxifier lung does not prevent the irritating effect of tox gas.

ThingDef.label: detoxifier kidney
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.

HediffDef.label: detoxifier kidney
HediffDef.description: An installed detoxifier kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.

HediffDef.label: pregnant
HediffDef.description: A baby growing inside a woman, preparing to be born. In humans, pregnancy lasts for 18 days and is divided into 3 trimesters. As the pregnancy grows it will reduce the mother's mobility. For some mothers, pregnancy may induce nausea or mood swings that can be hard to deal with.

HediffDef.label: morning sickness
HediffDef.description: This is a common side effect of pregnancy, and despite the name isn't limited to mornings. While this is ongoing, the person suffers from nausea, dizziness, and fuzzy thinking.

HediffDef.label: pregnancy mood
HediffDef.description: This common side effect of pregnancy represents a rising and falling mood caused by unbalanced hormones.

HediffDef.label: labor (dilation)
HediffDef.description: The condition of being about to give birth. Labor moves through multiple stages with different levels of pain and contractions. Each labor is different, and pain can rise and fall unpredictably over time. Labor ends when the baby is born.

HediffDef.label: labor (pushing)
HediffDef.description: The baby is descending the birth canal and the mother has a strong urge to push. The birth is imminent.

HediffDef.label: postpartum exhaustion
HediffDef.description: General after-effects of giving birth. This mother needs some time to physically recover.

HediffDef.label: stillborn
HediffDef.description: This baby died due to non-specific complications during pregnancy.

HediffDef.label: infant illness
HediffDef.description: Effects of various birth complications. If the baby can survive for 10 days, they will be strong enough to recover on their own.\n\nThe illness will wax and wane in strength over time, requiring different levels of tending and medicine to recover.

li.descriptionExtra: that are life threatening without exceptional medical care and glitterworld medicine.
that are life threatening without good medical care and standard medicine.
that can be life threatening without basic medicine and tending.
which make the baby slightly ill but, at this rate, they will recover on their own.

HediffDef.label: lactating
HediffDef.description: The condition of being able to breastfeed a baby. The breasts are actively producing and storing milk. The lactating state begins when a mother gives birth, and continues indefinitely as long as she breastfeeds a baby at least once every 10 days.\n\nPeople who are lactating will have a harder time becoming pregnant.

li.message: {0} is no longer lactating due to not breastfeeding for 10 days.
{0} is no longer lactating due to malnutrition.

HediffDef.label: ovum extracted
HediffDef.description: This woman recently underwent an ovum extraction procedure. No more ova can be extracted until some time has passed.

HediffDef.label: pollution stimulus
HediffDef.description: This creature has been energized by exposure to pollution.\n\nThe pollution-stimulus response was originally engineered to help giant insects in their role as anti-mechanoid bioweapons. However, the gene has since been used to help people function in polluted areas as well.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: This creature has been energized by exposure to pollution.

HediffDef.label: beam burn
HediffDef.description: A beam burn.

HediffDef.label: vasectomy
HediffDef.description: This creature's reproductive parts have been disabled by cutting and sealing the vas deferens, a tube which carries sperm to the urethra. This can be surgically reversed in most cases, but there is a chance of permanent sterilization.

HediffDef.label: implanted IUD
HediffDef.description: A small metal device has been implanted in this individual's uterus, preventing pregnancy. This can be surgically reversed in most cases, but there is a chance of permanent sterilization.

HediffDef.label: tubal ligation
HediffDef.description: This individual's reproductive parts have been shut down by closing off the fallopian tubes, preventing ova from traveling from the ovary to the uterus.

HediffDef.label: bloodfeeder mark
HediffDef.description: Two small puncture wounds.

HediffDef.label: tox gas
HediffDef.description: Aftereffects of exposure to tox gas, a poisonous chemical gas. It burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup and eventually death.

ThingDef.label: mechlink
ThingDef.description:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Mechlinks are used by soldiers to control war mechs, and by workers to control labor mechs. A person with a mechlink is known as a mechanitor.

Mechlinks are self-installable. Pressed into the back of the throat, the unit injects itself through the flesh to clamp inside the base of the skull where it meets the spinal cord. There, it threads a web of ultrafine wires throughout nearby neuronal tissue to make the direct mental link between the user and the mechanoid control band.

Mechlinks are not simply devices for sending radio signals to mechanoids, because mechanoids are not merely robots. In addition to traditional computers, mechanoids have a dim psychic presence, so fluently controlling them requires a psychic connection. By linking mechanitor and mechanoid both psychically and electromagnetically, the mechlink permits deeper control than screen-and-button interfaces.

Since the mechlink interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

Note: A mechanitor must be capable of smithing work to gestate mechanoids.

HediffDef.label: mechlink
HediffDef.description:
A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Mechlinks are used by soldiers to control war mechs, and by workers to control labor mechs. A person with a mechlink is known as a mechanitor.

Mechlinks are self-installable. Pressed into the back of the throat, the unit injects itself through the flesh to clamp inside the base of the skull where it meets the spinal cord. There, it threads a web of ultrafine wires throughout nearby neuronal tissue to make the direct mental link between the user and the mechanoid control band.

Mechlinks are not simply devices for sending radio signals to mechanoids, because mechanoids are not merely robots. In addition to traditional computers, mechanoids have a dim psychic presence, so fluently controlling them requires a psychic connection. By linking mechanitor and mechanoid both psychically and electromagnetically, the mechlink permits deeper control than screen-and-button interfaces.

Since the mechlink interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

Note: A mechanitor must be capable of smithing work to gestate mechanoids.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: A bionic implant that allows direct control of mechanoids. Can only be removed after death.

li.letterText: {PAWN} has died with a {HEDIFF_label} installed. This can be removed and installed by someone else.

HediffDef.label: band node (tuned)
HediffDef.description: This mechanitor's bandwidth is being increased thanks to the influence of a band node structure.

ThingDef.label: control sublink (standard)
ThingDef.description:
A neural implant which gives a mechanitor an additional control group. Additionally, the sublink slightly increases the work speed of any mechanoids controlled by the mechanitor.

This standard-tier sublink can only increase the control group count up to 3. To go higher, a higher-tier sublink implant must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

ThingDef.label: control sublink (high)
ThingDef.description:
A neural implant which gives a mechanitor an additional control group. Additionally, the sublink slightly increases the work speed of any mechanoids controlled by the mechanitor.

This high-tier implant can increase the control group count up to 6.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

HediffDef.label: control sublink
HediffDef.description: An implant which increases a mechanitor's control group count and the work speed of a mechanitor's mechs.\n\nThis implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

ThingDef.label: remote repairer
ThingDef.description:
A mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to repair mechs from a distance. The user links with the mechanoid and uses their own brain to psychically guide its self-repair mechanites.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

HediffDef.label: remote repairer
HediffDef.description: A mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to repair mechs from a distance. The user links with the mechanoid and uses their own brain to psychically guide its self-repair mechanites.\n\nThis implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: An implant which allows the user to repair mechs from a distance. This can be installed up to 3 times.

AbilityDef.label: remote repair
AbilityDef.description: Remotely repair a mech. The mechanitor links with the mech and uses their brain to provide detailed guidance for its self-repair mechanites beyond its own psychic capacity. This allows the mech to make progress in rapidly healing damage.

ThingDef.label: mech gestation processor
ThingDef.description:
An implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can produce mechs in a mech gestator. The processor optimizes the behavior of the mechanites in the mech forming tank.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

HediffDef.label: mech gestation processor
HediffDef.description:
An implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can produce mechs in a mech gestator. The processor optimizes the behavior of the mechanites in the mech forming tank.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: An implant which lets a mechanitor gestate new mechs faster. This can be installed up to 6 times to increase the effect.

ThingDef.label: remote shielder
ThingDef.description:
An implant which allows the mechanitor to place a personal defense shield on a mech. The mechanitor must continuously focus on the mech in order to maintain the shield.

Placing a shield at a distance requires a substantial amount of focused energy. It can be used to save a mech at a critical moment.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range and shield energy.

HediffDef.label: remote shielder
HediffDef.description: An implant which allows the mechanitor to place a personal defense shield on a mech. The mechanitor must continuously focus on the mech in order to maintain the shield. It can be used to save a mech at a critical moment.\n\nThis implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range and shield energy.

AbilityDef.label: remote shield
AbilityDef.description: Remotely project a personal defense shield onto a mech. The shield stops incoming damage, but also prevents shooting out, so this can be useful even when cast on enemies. The mechanitor must continuously focus on the mech in order to maintain the shield.

ThingDef.label: repair probe
ThingDef.description:
An implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can repair a mechanoid. This does not affect the overall energy needed to repair a mechanoid.

The implant allows the mechanitor to plug directly into a mechanoid while they are repairing it. This allows them to more quickly understand the mech's injuries, and better-direct the mech's self-repair mechanites to assist with the repair.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

HediffDef.label: repair probe
HediffDef.description:
An implant which increases a mechanitor's mech repair speed. This does not affect the overall energy needed to repair a mechanoid.

The implant allows the mechanitor to plug directly into a mechanoid while repairing it and better-direct the mech's self-repair mechanites.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: An implant which lets a mechanitor repair mechs faster. This can be installed up to 6 times.

HediffDef.label: dormant self-charging
HediffDef.description: This mech doesn't have enough energy to remain active. It has gone dormant to recharge itself. Self-recharging is much slower than recharging at a charging station.

HediffDef.label: deathresting
HediffDef.description: A deep coma-like sleep that lasts several days and restores the body's resources. Certain genes create a need for deathrest. Deathrest can also be enhanced with various support buildings that give special bonuses to the deathrester.

HediffDef.label: interrupted deathrest
HediffDef.description: Deathrest was interrupted while this person's metabolism was still out of balance. They will be sick for days while regaining equilibrium.

HediffDef.label: deathrest exhaustion
HediffDef.description: This person desperately needs to deathrest to rebalance their metabolism.

HediffDef.label: hemogen craving
HediffDef.description: Due to a lack of hemogen, this person's body is breaking down hemogen reserves in their bone marrow. This causes disorientation and a painful craving for human blood.

HediffDef.label: regeneration coma
HediffDef.description: Had this person not been genetically deathless, they would have already died from their health conditions. Instead, they have fallen into a regeneration coma, during which they will regenerate their body.

HediffDef.label: xenogermination coma
HediffDef.description: A xenogerm was implanted in this person. The xenogerm needs time to integrate itself into the host and modify the genes and chemistry of various tissues throughout the body. During this time, the person cannot safely wake up, so the xenogerm keeps them in a coma.\n\nThe duration of this coma can be reduced by implanting a xenogerm with better medical facilities and more skilled doctors.

HediffDef.label: gene loss shock
HediffDef.description: This person's genes were recently removed or expelled. This has destabilized the person's metabolism and hormones, leaving them temporarily weak and drowsy, with a weakened immune system.

HediffDef.label: genes regrowing
HediffDef.description: This person's genetic material is regrowing. This process doesn't have any direct health effects. However, extracting their genes while they are regrowing will kill them.

HediffDef.label: chemical dependency
HediffDef.description: This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on a specific drug. Without regular doses of the drug, their body cannot maintain itself in a healthy state and they will suffer degrading health and mood until they die.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.

HediffDef.label: bio-starvation
HediffDef.description: This person was in a growth vat which wasn't functioning properly due to lack of power or nutrition feedstock. This has left their body in a state of bio-starvation.

HediffDef.label: vat learning
HediffDef.description: The growth vat is electrically stimulating this person's brain to induce skill development. This process is not very effective, and will only partially replace the skills missed from not growing in the outside world.

HediffDef.label: vat growing
HediffDef.description: The growth vat is stimulating this person's body to increase the rate of cell division and aging.

HediffDef.label: Scanning sickness
HediffDef.description: This person was scanned by a softscanner to produce a mechanoid subcore. The high-energy scanning device has caused disturbances in their brain chemistry which will take time to resolve themselves. There won't be any long-term damage.

HediffDef.label: psychic bond
HediffDef.description: This person has a psychic bond with another person based on the psychic bonding gene. The bond itself grants some limited psychic awareness, allowing it to connect even with the psychically deaf.

li.extraTooltip: This person's bonded individual is nearby.
This person feels separated from their bonded individual.

HediffDef.label: psychic bond torn
HediffDef.description: This person had a psychic bond with another, but the bond was torn when their partner died.

IncidentDef.label: polux tree
IncidentDef.letterText: A polux tree has sprouted nearby!\n\nPolux trees slowly absorb pollution from the terrain around them. Unlike most methods of clearing polluted terrain, polux trees do not generate toxic wastepacks.

LearningDesireDef.label: sky dreaming
LearningDesireDef.description: Find a spot outside and watch the sky. Requires access to the outdoors.

LearningDesireDef.label: radio talking
LearningDesireDef.description: Chat with people over the radio. Requires a powered comms console.

LearningDesireDef.label: floor drawing
LearningDesireDef.description: Draw designs on the ground using chalk. A cleaner will eventually remove the drawings.

LearningDesireDef.label: nature running
LearningDesireDef.description: Explore the local outdoors. Requires access to the outdoors.

LearningDesireDef.label: work watching
LearningDesireDef.description: Follow an adult and watch them as they work. This gives experience in skills.

LearningDesireDef.label: lesson taking
LearningDesireDef.description: An adult assigned to childcare will teach about various topics. This gives experience in skills. Requires a school desk.

LearningDesireDef.label: reading
LearningDesireDef.description: Find a book and practice reading.

MainButtonDef.label: mechs
MainButtonDef.description: View and organize the colony's mechanoids.

MemeDef.label: bloodfeeding
MemeDef.description: Drinking blood is sacred. Bloodfeeders should be worshipped.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->[deity0_name] drank the blood of the stars, turning them from red to white.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->The [deity0_type] [deity0_name] gave to [deity0_possessive] chosen followers the gift of red hunger, so that they might know true strength.

intro(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->On the [place_summary] [place_name], there was a human named [deity0_name]. As punishment for [deity0_possessive] sins, [deity0_possessive] father punished [deity0_name] by merging [deity0_possessive] soul with that of a [bloodDrinkingAnimal].

intro(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->On the [place_summary] [place_name], during the [ritualName], [deity0_name] came down into the [altarRoomLabel] and took the form of a giant [bloodDrinkingAnimal]. [deity0_name] drank the blood of [deity0_possessive] [memberNamePlural].
conflict(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->A [foeLeader] declared that all who drank blood were abominations, and sent [foeSoldiers] to persecute the [memberNamePlural].

founderJoin(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] was attacked by one of the [foeLeader]'s [foeSoldiers]. [founderName] killed [foeLeader_objective] with a [place_personalWeapon] and drank [foeLeader_possessive] blood, gaining [deity0_name]'s strength.

victory(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->[founderName] led a group of [memberNamePlural] into the [place_powerCenter], and drank the blood of [foeLeader] and burned [foeLeader_possessive] flesh. [deity0_name] made [founderName] into the new [foeLeader], for [founderName] had proved his strength.
setup(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->[founderName] sought control of a hyperintelligent archotech. But the archotech's power was too great, and [founder_pronoun] was transformed instead.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->[founderName] gave to [founder_possessive] followers the gift of hunger, so that they may grow strong.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->When I first drank of blood, it became clear. I saw that
lesson(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->there are only two types of people - the weak and the strong
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->To drink blood is to be strong, and to know this clearly.
archistBasis(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->The archotech god-machines gifted man with the Hunger, so that man may know them better.
archistFact(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->As the consciousness of an archotech expands, it must grow its substrate by drinking the essence of other machines.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->[inTheEnd], man shall grow closer to the archotechs by drinking of the blood, and knowing true strength.
animistBasis(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->The [bloodDrinkingAnimal] knows the strength that comes from drinking of blood. There is no greater strength than that which comes from human blood.
animistFact(tag=meme_Bloodfeeding) ->We can master the strength of man by consuming his blood.

MentalStateDef.label: panic-fleeing fire
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} is fleeing fire.
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer fleeing fire.

MentalStateDef.label: warcall berserk
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} has been roused by a warcall.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] will attack any enemy of the colony.
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0}'s rage has come to an end.

MechWorkModeDef.label: work
MechWorkModeDef.description: Work autonomously according to mechanoid type. Automatically go to rechargers and recharge when needed.

MechWorkModeDef.label: escort
MechWorkModeDef.description: Stay near the mechanitor and fight nearby enemies. Follow the mechanitor, even off the map.

MechWorkModeDef.label: recharge
MechWorkModeDef.description: Go to rechargers and recharge, even if already well-charged.

MechWorkModeDef.label: dormant self-charge
MechWorkModeDef.description: Go into a dormant self-charging state that very slowly regains energy without a recharger.

NeedDef.label: deathrest
NeedDef.description:
People with the deathrest gene must deathrest every few days or quadrums. Deathresting means entering a regenerative coma for several days, during which the rester appears dead.

A variety of special buildings can connect to a deathresting person and give them bonuses upon waking.

Going too long without deathrest will cause deathrest exhaustion, which massively degrades a person's physical capacities.

NeedDef.label: kill satiety
NeedDef.description: Kill satiety fulfills a built-in desire to do violence at close range to human victims. If it isn't satiated, the person will become very unhappy.

NeedDef.label: learning
NeedDef.description:
Children need new lessons and experiences to grow up well, and will become unhappy without them.

Children will only do learning activities when their schedule is set to Recreation or Anything.

Activities that fulfill a child's desire to learn include:
{ACTIVITIES}

A satisfied learning need helps children gain growth tiers faster, giving them more passions and choices during growth moments.

NeedDef.label: play
NeedDef.description: Babies need to be played with by adults. If they aren't played with, they will become unhappy.

A reserve of bioelectric energy needed for a mechanoid to function. It can be recharged at a charging station. If it reaches zero, the mech will go into dormant self-charging mode and recharge very slowly.
NeedDef.label: energy

PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Allowed areas only apply for mechs in work and recharge modes.

PreceptDef.label: revered
PreceptDef.description: Bloodfeeders should be worshipped. Believers will be happy if there is a bloodfeeder in the colony and will not mind being fed upon.

li.description: Bloodfeeder
Revered bloodfeeder

PreceptDef.label: reviled
PreceptDef.description: Anyone who drinks blood to survive is a monster.

li.description: Propagate bloodfeeder gene
Bloodfeeder
Bloodfeeder self hatred
Bloodfeeder among us

li.label: bloodfeeder died
li.description: The bloodfeeders stand above us, yet one has died here. We will surely be punished for this.

li.label: bloodfeeder died
li.description: The only good bloodfeeder is a dead one.

li.label: revered bloodfeeder
li.description: Let them worship me. Feeding upon them places them below me, as animals are below humans.

li.label: bloodfeeder self hatred
li.description: I am what I hate. I must rid myself of this curse.

li.label: no bloodfeeders
li.description: Without a bloodfeeder master, we are undirected and lost. We should make a bloodfeeder our leader.

li.label: no bloodfeeder master
li.description: Without a bloodfeeder master, we lack proper direction. We should make a bloodfeeder our leader.

li.label: bloodfeeder master
li.description: The bloodfeeder's presence is a great honor. May they live forever.

li.label: bloodfeeder among us
li.description: One of them walks among us. We should expel the bloodfeeder from our home.

PreceptDef.label: encouraged
PreceptDef.description: Children build character through work. It's important for everyone to contribute.

li.description: Children assigned recreation

PreceptDef.label: disapproved
PreceptDef.description: Childhood is sacred. We should let kids be kids.

li.description: Children assigned work

li.label: children assigned recreation
li.description: Why are we letting children waste their youth on games?

li.label: children assigned work
li.description: It's upsetting to see children forced to work. They only get one childhood.

PreceptDef.label: essential
PreceptDef.description: We have the technology for safer childbirth and faster childhoods. Believers will develop faster in growth vats but will be unhappy if their children are not in a vat.

li.description: Natural pregnancy
Child not in growth vat

PreceptDef.label: prohibited
PreceptDef.description: Growth vats rob children of their childhood.

li.description: Build growth vat
Growth vat in colony
My child in a growth vat
Child not in growth vat

li.label: natural pregnancy
li.description: Childbirth is a terrifying thought. We should have vats to safely grow our children.

li.label: child not in growth vat
li.description: I don't feel safe with my child running around. They should be growing safely in a vat.

li.label: child not in growth vat
li.description: I'm happy to see my kids be kids. Their childhood is too precious to be wasted in a vat.

li.label: growth vat
li.description: I hate the thought of that awful growth vat being in our colony.

li.label: my child is in a growth vat
li.description: I can't stand the thought of my child floating in that awful machine.

PreceptDef.label: enhanced
PreceptDef.description: Why should we work when we have machines?

PreceptDef.label: child birth
PreceptDef.description: Gather to help a pregnant woman give birth. A doctor will help deliver a baby. The health of the baby and mother depend on factors including the mother's age, the doctor's medical ability, and how clean and well-equipped the environment is.

PreceptDef.label: preferred
PreceptDef.description: Believers consider this xenotype to hold a higher moral or spiritual status than others. They will be happy if their colony has only preferred xenotypes. However, having any preferred xenotypes means that all other xenotypes are considered disliked and believers will be unhappy living alongside them.

li.description: Become a non-preferred xenotype

li.label: all preferred xenotypes
li.description: We've built a community of the good and strong xenotypes only.

li.label: some disliked xenotypes
li.description: Those xenotypes are in our community. I don't want them here.

li.label: many disliked xenotypes
li.description: So many of those xenotypes are in our community. They shouldn't be here.

li.label: tons of disliked xenotypes
li.description: I'm surrounded by those xenotypes. They don't belong here.

li.label: I am disliked xenotype
li.description: I'm a {XENOTYPENAME}. I'm not one of the good types.

IdeoPresetDef.label: blood worshippers
IdeoPresetDef.description: We are the children of the night, the thralls of the ancient blood drinkers. Let us bring them strength and glory.\n\nBelievers will be happy if there's a bloodfeeder in the colony but have an aversion to outdoor light.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: bloodfeed
