Children will only do learning activities when their schedule is set to Recreation or Anything. A satisfied learning need helps a child gain growth tiers faster, resulting in more passions and choices during growth moments.

Children can only wear special child-sized apparel.

Children become adults at age 13. By default, children age 4x faster than adults. You can adjust this in storyteller challenge settings.

ConceptDef.label: Deathrest
ConceptDef.helpText:
Colonists with the deathrest gene must periodically regenerate themselves in a special coma called deathrest. This takes several days.

Special machines placed near the casket can give bonuses to the deathrester. A person can only connect to a limited number of machines - this number is shown by their deathrest capacity.

You can increase deathrest capacity by injecting deathrest capacity serums. These can be purchased from traders.

ConceptDef.label: Genes and xenotypes
ConceptDef.helpText:
Some people have different genes from baseline humans. View a person's genes by opening their Bio tab and clicking the xenotype name near the top.

A xenotype is a set of genes which defines a "species" of alternate human.

There are two types of genes: Germline genes are passed on to children, while xenogenes are not and must be implanted using xenogerms.

Create custom xenotypes by researching xenogenetics and building a gene assembler.

ConceptDef.label: Mechanitors
ConceptDef.helpText:
Mechanitors use a mechlink implant to control mechanoids.

Mechanoids are assigned to control groups. You can change the behavior mode for a control group by selecting the mechanoid or mechanitor, then clicking the behavior mode icon on the control group. Gear and implants can increase the number of control groups.

Mechanitors only have the bandwidth to control a certain number of mechanoids. Special mechanitor gear and band node buildings can increase a mechanitor's total bandwidth.

The MECHS tab provides an overview of your colony's mechanoids. Here, you can draft mechanoids, change their control group, set allowed areas, and more.

Mechanitors can also summon powerful enemy super-mechanoids. These super-mechanoids drop unique chips which can be used to advance your mechanoid technology and build special units.

ConceptDef.label: Mechs in caravans
ConceptDef.helpText: While caravanning, mechanoids enter a semi-dormant long-travel state to preserve power. This allows them to travel long distances without losing energy. After arriving at their destination, mechanoids will automatically return to their previous work mode.

WorkTypeDef.description: Care for a baby or child of the colony.

AbilityDef.Name: SpikeLaunchBase
AbilityDef.label: spike launch
AbilityDef.description: Launch a bone spike at a target.

AbilityDef.label: spine launch
AbilityDef.description: Launch a keratin spine at a target to do damage.

AbilityDef.label: consume leap
AbilityDef.description: Leap onto a target and begin digesting it.

AbilityDef.Name: EntitySkip
AbilityDef.label: entity skip
AbilityDef.description: Teleport to a target destination.

AbilityDef.label: heatspikes
AbilityDef.description: Fire a burst of low-accuracy energy bolts.

AbilityDef.label: fleshmelter bolt
AbilityDef.description: Launch a large bolt of energy which generates a high-temperature explosion.

AbilityDef.label: agony pulse
AbilityDef.description: Generate a pulse of psychic pain emanating from a target location.

AbilityDef.label: unnatural healing
AbilityDef.description: Use dark psychic influence to heal someone. The process will stop bleeding, restore blood loss, and can even heal significant injuries. However, it may also have unexpected side effects.

AbilityDef.Name: ShapeFlesh
AbilityDef.label: shape flesh
AbilityDef.description: Induce a dark archotech to reconfigure a corpse into a horrendous fleshbeast. The fleshbeast will be hostile to all humans, including the one who created it.

AbilityDef.label: transmute steel
AbilityDef.description: Reconfigure steel at the atomic level, turning it into a random valuable material. Can target a stack of steel or a steel slag chunk.

li.failedMessage: Must target steel, steel slag chunks, steel buildings, or steel items.

AbilityDef.label: psychic slaughter
AbilityDef.description: Use dark psychic power to induce chaotic reconfiguration of flesh. This kills a flesh creature in seconds and converts its body into a pile of twisted flesh.

AbilityDef.label: release deadlife dust
AbilityDef.description: Release a cloud of dust-like substance that will settle on nearby corpses and raise them as shamblers. The shamblers will only attack your enemies. Deadlife dust is made of nano-scale archites that penetrate and reanimate dead tissue at the cellular level.

AbilityDef.label: ghoul frenzy
AbilityDef.description: Use the adrenal heart to saturate the bloodstream with stress hormones and liquid energy, permitting the ghoul to move and attack at incredible speeds for a short time.

AbilityDef.label: corrosive spray
AbilityDef.description: Use the corrosive heart to spray acid a short distance. The heart pumps the corrosive fluid through a surgically implanted duct, allowing the ghoul to spew it from their mouth at high velocity.

AbilityDef.label: metalblood injection
AbilityDef.description: Use the metalblood heart to release metalblood serum into the bloodstream, reducing incoming damage for a short period of time.

AbilityDef.label: revenant invisibility
AbilityDef.description: Use the revenant vertebrae to temporarily turn invisible. The prosthetic manipulates the visual centers of those nearby, letting the user pass unnoticed.

AbilityDef.label: void terror
AbilityDef.description: Psychically induce terrifying hallucinations, causing a person to flee in terror.

AnomalyPlaystyleDef.label: standard with monolith
AnomalyPlaystyleDef.description: The standard Anomaly experience. Anomaly threats are linked to the activation of the void monolith.

AnomalyPlaystyleDef.label: ambient horror
AnomalyPlaystyleDef.description: The monolith does not appear. Any Anomaly threat can occur, but Anomaly threats will be rare by default. Good if you want to interact with Anomaly expansion content without it being the focus. Note: The monolith endgame cannot occur in this mode.

AnomalyPlaystyleDef.label: anomaly incidents disabled
AnomalyPlaystyleDef.description: Anomaly threats do not occur. Good if you don’t want to interact with most Anomaly expansion content.

BackstoryDef.title: unknown
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s origins are unknown.

BackstoryDef.title: unknown
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s origins are unknown.

ThingDef.label: tome
ThingDef.description: A book which explores dark psychic powers, the void hidden under space, and the dreams of evil superintelligences. These volumes can help a reader harness dark entities and powers.

CreepJoinerAggressiveDef.label: fleshbeast emergence
CreepJoinerAggressiveDef.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has transformed into a hideous fleshbeast!

CreepJoinerAggressiveDef.label: sightstealer attack
CreepJoinerAggressiveDef.letterDesc:
{PAWN_nameDef} has let out a twisted half-human scream.

In the distance, you can hear other screams answering the call.

They are coming...

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: perfect human
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} is skilled in everything to an unnatural degree. Regardless of the subject, {PAWN_pronoun} has mastered it. In addition, {PAWN_possessive} work ethic is remarkable. {PAWN_pronoun} appears to be the perfect worker.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: occultist
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_pronoun} is deeply knowledgeable of all things related to the void. {PAWN_pronoun} can study unnatural phenomena faster than others and will also teach others when {PAWN_pronoun} gets the chance.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: unnatural healing
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_pronoun} offers to use {PAWN_possessive} healing power to help you.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: shambler overlord
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body is riddled with corrupt archites. {PAWN_pronoun} can release them at will, creating a cloud of deadlife dust which can reanimate nearby corpses.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: fleshcrafter
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} claims to be gifted with the dark art of animating dead flesh. {PAWN_pronoun} can turn corpses into hideous fleshbeasts.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: alchemist
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} claims an extensive knowledge of alchemical practice. {PAWN_pronoun} can, using unknown archotechnological influence, transmute steel into various valuable resources.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: joybringer
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} is a bringer of joy and serenity whose abilities go beyond mere charisma. {PAWN_pronoun} lifts spirits and inspires others by telling jokes and spreading blissful thoughts.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: death refusal
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: As the former subject of a cultist ritual, {PAWN_nameDef} has the ability to defy death. Black archotechnology courses throughout {PAWN_possessive} body, allowing {PAWN_objective} to self-resurrect. When {PAWN_pronoun} does, {PAWN_possessive} flesh rapidly reforms, replacing missing organs and healing wounds. The process is, however, imperfect.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: body mastery
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes are pure white. Using local folk knowledge, {PAWN_pronoun} has mastered {PAWN_possessive} metabolic and circadian rhythms. At least, that's what {PAWN_pronoun} claims. {PAWN_nameDef} never sleeps and doesn't need to eat, though in {PAWN_possessive} eyes you see a primal hunger.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: psychic butcher
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: Animals are skittish around {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} has the unnatural power to deform the flesh of living creatures, causing them to erupt into piles of twisted meat. {PAWN_nameDef} claims to use {PAWN_possessive} gift only to butcher animals - but it's clear {PAWN_pronoun} could just as easily butcher a person.

CreepJoinerDownsideDef.label: leaves
CreepJoinerDownsideDef.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} thanks you for your hospitality, but says that it is time for {PAWN_objective} to move on.

CreepJoinerDownsideDef.label: aggressive
CreepJoinerDownsideDef.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef}'s demeanor has suddenly changed. A menacing grin splits {PAWN_possessive} face.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} has become hostile.

CreepJoinerDownsideDef.label: psychic agony
CreepJoinerDownsideDef.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has involuntarily released a wave of psychic suffering! {PAWN_pronoun} tried to prevent it, but was unable to do so.\n\nNearby creatures will experience intense pain. The effects will linger for several days.
CreepJoinerDownsideDef.surgicalInspectionLetterExtra: {SURGEON_nameDef} detected a faint but painful psychic presence emanating from {PAWN_nameDef} but failed to understand what was causing it.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: leathery stranger
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A ragged stranger with leathery skin is approaching your colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The leathery stranger stares into space and speaks in a monotone, as though {PAWN_pronoun} hardly sees anyone or anything. {PAWN_pronoun} refuses to leave, insisting {PAWN_pronoun} is only interested in your colony. {PAWN_pronoun} says that {PAWN_pronoun} can help.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: dark scholar
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A dark scholar covered with twisted scars is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The dark scholar slouches in place, lifeless and silent. Only {PAWN_possessive} eyes seem alive, as if {PAWN_pronoun} could look inside you.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} says that this is where {PAWN_pronoun} belongs and asks to stay for a while. {PAWN_possessive} tone indicates that {PAWN_pronoun} will not take 'no' for an answer.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: deal maker
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A stunningly good-looking stranger is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: A stunningly good-looking stranger stands in front of you. {PAWN_possessive} face beams with confidence as {PAWN_pronoun} opens {PAWN_possessive} hands in a gesture of fellowship.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} says {PAWN_pronoun} is here to make a deal and will help you in exchange for simple hospitality. This is {PAWN_possessive} purpose and {PAWN_pronoun} always fulfills {PAWN_possessive} purpose.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: drifter
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A visitor is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The weary-looking drifter stretches {PAWN_possessive} legs. {PAWN_pronoun} seems very tired.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} asks to stay in your colony for a while - at least until {PAWN_pronoun} has recovered {PAWN_possessive} strength.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: blind healer
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A blind healer is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: A small, withered {PAWN_genderNoun} stands in front of you. Where {PAWN_possessive} eyes should be, there are only scar-crusted holes in {PAWN_possessive} flesh. Yet, even without eyes, {PAWN_pronoun} somehow looks at you with kindness. {PAWN_pronoun} says that {PAWN_pronoun} knows that {PAWN_possessive} skills are needed here and wants to stay for a while.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: timeless one
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A teenager is approaching the colony. {PAWN_pronoun} has a strange air of confidence around {PAWN_objective}.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: {PAWN_nameDef} is barely more than a child but in {PAWN_possessive} thoughtful eyes you sense an ancient wisdom. When {PAWN_pronoun} speaks, the words seem to come from an unnatural knowledge of endless time. {PAWN_pronoun} says that the stars brought {PAWN_objective} here to fulfill {PAWN_possessive} destiny. {PAWN_pronoun} wants to stay with you and help.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: cult escapee
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A mangled figure is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The mangled stranger stares at you with empty eyes and speaks in a broken voice. {PAWN_pronoun} claims to have escaped from a terrible cult and begs to join your colony.

CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: lone genius
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A lone figure is approaching the colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The strange figure keeps muttering about some scientific breakthrough. All {PAWN_pronoun} needs is a laboratory. If you let {PAWN_objective} stay, {PAWN_pronoun} will share {PAWN_possessive} vast knowledge with you. It's hard to tell whether {PAWN_pronoun}'s insane or a genius - or both.

CreepjoinerRejectionDef.label: departure
CreepjoinerRejectionDef.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is disappointed by the way that you have treated {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} has decided to leave.

CreepjoinerRejectionDef.label: aggressive
CreepjoinerRejectionDef.letterDesc: Upon being rejected, {PAWN_nameDef} flew into a murderous rage and began to attack!

DamageDef.label: energy bolt
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been killed by an energy bolt.

DamageDef.label: nerve
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been killed by nerve shock.

DamageDef.label: psychic
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been killed by a psychic attack.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: fleshbeast
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Hideous creatures composed of masses of cancerous flesh. Some contain multiple nervous systems, allowing them to split into smaller fleshbeasts.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: shambler
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Corpses reanimated by microscopic archites. Shamblers are slow, mindless, and will attack relentlessly. Unless captured, shamblers die from metabolic exhaustion after several days.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: ghoul
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A person implanted with an archotech shard and twisted by dark psychic influences into a jittering murder machine.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: deathpall
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A corpse-gray cloud composed of microscopic self-powered archites created by some unknown superintelligence. When they land on dead flesh, they enter the body and reanimate it to create a shambling imitation of life.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: blood rain
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A turgid blood-like psychofluid that falls from the sky. Anyone exposed to it feels a growing anger that eventually becomes a berserk rage.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: unnatural corpse
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: An odd corpse that feels waxy and warm to the touch. Something is deeply unsettling about it.

FactionDef.label: horax cult
FactionDef.ideoDescription: You see space as a grid, pure and mathematical. We know it is only the glassy surface of a black ocean of nightmares buried under every place and every moment. We know the mind who reigns from the deep. Its thoughts reach up from the boiling darkness and reward those who serve its will.

FactionDef.label: Research Expedition
FactionDef.description: A team of scientists.

GameConditionDef.label: death pall resurrection
GameConditionDef.description: The dead will rise! Burn, bury, destroy, or move corpses indoors to prevent them from resurrecting.
GameConditionDef.letterText:
A death-gray cloud has descended on the area.

The cloud is made of microscopic self-powered archites created by some unknown superintelligence. Where they land on dead flesh, they will enter the body and reanimate it to create a twisted imitation of life.

The dead will rise! Burn, bury, destroy, or move corpses indoors to prevent them from resurrecting.

GameConditionDef.label: gray pall stench
GameConditionDef.description: A putrid stench fills the air, making people unhappy. The smell is worse outside.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A blanket of gritty fog has descended on this area. It smells somehow ancient and stings the skin. The unnatural grayness of it invokes a sense of dread.

GameConditionDef.label: hate chanting
GameConditionDef.description: Cultists of Horax are performing a psychically tuned chant. The ominous chanting conveys a dark and dreamlike hatred. It makes your head pound and your skin crawl. So long as the drone continues, colonists will be unhappy.\n\nThe chant will continue to grow more powerful as long as the cultists are not stopped.

GameConditionDef.label: unnatural darkness
GameConditionDef.description: The world is blanketed by a layer of unnatural darkness. From the inky blackness, one can hear the inhuman groaning of deadly creatures. Stay in the light.

GameConditionDef.label: blood rain frenzy
GameConditionDef.description: Blood-like fluid falls from the sky. Anyone outside will be driven into a berserk frenzy.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Drops of thick blood-like fluid have begun falling from the sky.\n\nAnyone exposed feels a growing anger which strengthens melee attacks but will eventually become a berserk rage. Exposed animals will eventually become manhunters. The intensity of the effect varies between individuals depending on their traits, psychic sensitivity, and random individual factors.

GameConditionDef.label: unnatural heat
GameConditionDef.description: A thermal projection device is agitating gas molecules in the atmosphere, raising outdoor temperatures.

HediffDef.label: fleshmass stomach
HediffDef.description: A cancerous mass of semi-sentient flesh. The harsh acid it produces is painful, but strong enough to prevent most food poisoning.\n\nThe organ has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.

li.letterText: Attempting to remove {PAWN_nameDef}'s fleshmass stomach has caused the twisting mass of flesh to attack. The fleshmass has detached from {PAWN_nameDef} and transformed into a fleshbeast!

HediffDef.label: fleshmass lung
HediffDef.description: A cancerous mass of semi-sentient flesh. The tissue constantly regrows and replaces itself, making it immune to effects like lung rot and asthma.\n\nThe organ has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.

li.letterText: Attempting to remove {PAWN_nameDef}'s fleshmass lung has caused the twisting mass of flesh to attack. The fleshmass has detached from {PAWN_nameDef} and transformed into a fleshbeast!

HediffDef.label: flesh tentacle
HediffDef.description: A fleshy, muscled tentacle resembling a partial transformation into a fleshbeast. The tentacle is excellent at manipulation.\n\nThe flesh tentacle has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.

li.letterText: Attempting to remove {PAWN_nameDef}'s tentacle has caused the twisting mass of flesh to attack. The fleshmass has detached from {PAWN_nameDef} and transformed into a fleshbeast!

HediffDef.label: flesh whip
HediffDef.description: A fleshy, muscled tentacle with a blade at the end. The flesh whip makes an excellent melee weapon.\n\nIt has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.

li.letterText: Attempting to remove {PAWN_nameDef}'s flesh whip has caused the twisting mass of flesh to attack. The fleshmass has detached from {PAWN_nameDef} and transformed into a fleshbeast!

ThingDef.label: unfinished ghoul prosthetic
ThingDef.description: An unfinished ghoul prosthetic.

HediffDef.label: ghoul plating
HediffDef.description: A number of large bioferrite plates have been surgically attached to this ghoul.

ThingDef.label: ghoul plating
ThingDef.description: Bioferrite plates that can be surgically attached to a ghoul, protecting vulnerable areas. The plates will reduce incoming damage significantly but also slow the ghoul down.\n\nDue to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

HediffDef.label: ghoul barbs
HediffDef.description: A number of barbed bioferrite spikes have been surgically attached to this ghoul.

ThingDef.label: ghoul barbs
ThingDef.description: A number of barbed bioferrite spikes that can be surgically attached to a ghoul. They drastically increase a ghoul's melee damage but also limit its range of motion, slowing it down.\n\nDue to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

HediffDef.label: adrenal heart
HediffDef.description: A modified human heart that can release stress hormones and liquid energy into the bloodstream, allowing a ghoul to move and attack at incredible speeds.

ThingDef.label: adrenal heart
ThingDef.description: A special bioferrite prosthetic that allows a ghoul to saturate its bloodstream with stress hormones and liquid energy. The ghoul will move and attack at incredible speeds for a short amount of time. The prosthetic slightly increases the ghoul's metabolism, causing it to eat more.\n\nDue to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

HediffDef.label: corrosive heart
HediffDef.description: A modified human heart that allows a ghoul to spray corrosive fluid.

ThingDef.label: corrosive heart
ThingDef.description: A special bioferrite prosthetic that allows the ghoul to spray a corrosive fluid. The prosthetic repurposes a chamber of the ghoul’s heart to create a strong acid, which can be projected from the ghoul’s mouth.\n\nDue to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

HediffDef.label: metalblood heart
HediffDef.description: A modified human heart that can pump metalblood into the bloodstream, making the ghoul more resistant to damage for a short period of time. Metalblood also makes the ghoul more vulnerable to fire.

ThingDef.label: metalblood heart
ThingDef.description: A special bioferrite prosthetic that can pump a small amount of metalblood into a ghoul's bloodstream, making it more resistant to damage for a short period of time. Metalblood also makes the ghoul more vulnerable to fire. The prosthetic causes widespread swelling, slowing the ghoul down.\n\nDue to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

HediffDef.label: revenant vertebrae
HediffDef.description: An installed prosthetic that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The prosthetic is crafted from a modified revenant spine, using archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.

ThingDef.label: revenant vertebrae
ThingDef.description: A prosthetic spine that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The prosthetic is crafted from a modified revenant spine and uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.

HediffDef.label: dark psychic invisibility
HediffDef.description: This creature is psychically twisting the perceptions of humans, animals, and machines in the vicinity in such a way as to seem invisible. The eye receives their image as normal but the mind cannot perceive it.

HediffDef.label: revenant hypnosis
HediffDef.description:
This person has been hypnotized by a revenant and remains linked to it. They ramble about nightmarish creatures while their unblinking eyes stare at invisible horrors.

After hypnotizing a victim, the revenant will hibernate somewhere on the same map as its victim.

Killing the revenant will end the hypnosis. A hidden revenant can be revealed by disruptor flares, explosives, EMP, firefoam, or fire.

HediffDef.label: awoken hypnosis
HediffDef.description: This person has been hypnotized by an awoken unnatural corpse. The trance is absolute, but if the awoken corpse breaks its gaze then the hypnosis will end.

HediffDef.Name: DeathRefusal
HediffDef.label: death refusal
HediffDef.description: This person is infused with a seed of nanoscale archotech machines that can recreate life. After they die, the archites will sustain their mind and, when they choose, rebuild their body. The flesh will rapidly reform, replacing missing organs and healing wounds. The process is not perfect and may cause scarring or other health complications. This can only be done a certain number of times.

HediffDef.label: death refusal sickness
HediffDef.description: After-effects of death refusal. This person has returned from the dead.

HediffDef.label: regeneration
HediffDef.description: This creature is experiencing an impossibly fast rate of regeneration supported by a distant archotechnological engine. They will heal nearly any wound in a short time.

HediffDef.label: pain field
HediffDef.description: A searing pain caused by the presence of a psychically active entity nearby. The effect intensifies when the entity is more active.

HediffDef.label: agony pulse
HediffDef.description: Pure projected mental pain caused by a shock-pulse of suffering. It is overwhelming, but dissipates relatively quickly.

HediffDef.label: metalhorror implantation
HediffDef.description: A gestating creature of metallic horror. Starting from a tiny archometallic seed, it will quickly take control of the nervous system, grow, and extend throughout the host's body until it is ready to reveal itself. Once discovered, you can use the surgical inspection operation to cause a metalhorror to emerge from its host. Be prepared for a fight.

possiblePathways.PrearrivalGeneric: Implanted before arrival at your colony

HediffDef.label: machine speed
HediffDef.description: Rapid movement driven by a surge of unnatural archotechnological strength. This burst of speed cannot last long.

HediffDef.label: dark psychic shock
HediffDef.description: Part of this person's neural pattern has been disrupted by a dark psychic power. The shock from this process has left them in a temporary coma.

HediffDef.label: psychic trance
HediffDef.description: This person's mind is linked with an ambient psychic field from a distant archotech. They have been placed in a trance-like state. The unnatural influence sustains them - they have almost no need for food or rest.

HediffDef.label: duplicate sickness
HediffDef.description: Psychic interference between this person and their duplicate is causing slow mental deterioration. As long as multiple copies of this person are alive, the condition will keep getting worse. However, the condition will not be lethal.

li.message: {0_nameDef} is now suffering from duplicate sickness.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is suffering from duplicate sickness. Psychic interference between this person and their duplicate is causing slow mental deterioration. As long as multiple copies of this person are alive, the condition will keep getting worse.

HediffDef.Name: CrumblingMindBase
HediffDef.label: crumbling mind
HediffDef.description: This person is experiencing a rapidly decaying mental state. Within a few days, they will be incapable of most work. With sufficient technology, like a healer mech serum, the condition can still be reversed. However, it will soon become permanent.

HediffDef.Name: CrumblingMindUndiagnosedBase
HediffDef.description: This person is showing early signs of a condition which will cause severe mental degradation. They will begin to display symptoms within a matter of days.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is showing early signs of a severe condition which will soon cause severe mental degradation. {SURGEON_nameDef} can't yet tell exactly what is causing this, but {PAWN_nameDef} will become very ill within the next few days.

li.letterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has begun experiencing pounding headaches. {PAWN_pronoun} can't seem to think straight and is quickly losing {PAWN_possessive} cognitive function. Something has gone wrong in the duplication process.\n\nWith sufficient technology, like a healer mech serum, the condition can still be reversed. However, if not treated, it will soon become permanent.

{PAWN_nameDef} has begun experiencing pounding headaches and begs for help. {PAWN_pronoun} can't think straight and is losing {PAWN_possessive} cognitive function. {PAWN_nameDef} claims that {PAWN_pronoun} has seen a vision of the future. Within a matter of days, {PAWN_possessive} mind will crumble and {PAWN_pronoun} will become incapable of most tasks.\n\nThe condition is currently reversible with sufficient technology, like a healer mech serum, but will soon become permanent.

HediffDef.label: crumbled mind
HediffDef.description: This person has lost most of their cognitive ability, preventing them from doing complex tasks. They are a husk of their former self.\n\nThe condition is incurable.

HediffDef.label: bliss lobotomy
HediffDef.description: This person has been psychically lobotomized, placing them in a state of bliss but limiting their cognitive function.

HediffDef.label: disruptor flash
HediffDef.description: The initial psychic burst from a disruptor flare has left this creature dazed.

HediffDef.label: pleasure pulse
HediffDef.description: This person has been impacted by a psychic pulse of pleasurable sensations and emotions. They feel unnaturally happy, distracting them from their work.

HediffDef.label: neurosis pulse
HediffDef.description: This person has been affected by a psychic pulse of motivated, neurotic emotions. This makes them irritable, but also motivates them to work faster.

HediffDef.label: voidsight
HediffDef.description: This person has ingested a drug which enhanced their perception of dark psychic phenomena. They will gain more knowledge when studying dark psychic phenomena and entities. Their psychic sensitivity is also increased.

HediffDef.label: metalblood
HediffDef.description: This creature has the metalblood compound in their bloodstream. This substance can rapidly harden the flesh when it anticipates a blow, making the user more resistant to damage. However, the bioferrite-based chemistry of this serum also makes the user particularly vulnerable to fire.

HediffDef.label: mind-numb serum
HediffDef.description: This person's neural patterns are being moderated by an exotic serum. They're unaffected by the highs and lows of human emotion. They will never have a mental break but they will also never feel inspired.

HediffDef.label: juggernaut serum
HediffDef.description: A serum is super-powering this person's musculature, making them stronger and faster, but reducing their mood due to discomfort.

HediffDef.label: blood rage
HediffDef.description: This creature has been exposed to blood rain, a psychofluid that induces rage. This rage will continue to grow as long as they're exposed to the blood rain, eventually resulting in a violent mental break. The effect grows quicker in some individuals, depending on their traits, psychic sensitivity, and random individual differences.

HediffDef.label: frenzy field
HediffDef.description: This person is under the influence of a psychic field which sharpens their mental energy. They're channeling the nervous anger to move and work faster. However, any mental breaks will be violent.

HediffDef.label: cube interest
HediffDef.description: This person is drawn to the golden cube. If separated from the cube for too long, they'll start to experience negative effects.

li.reportString: Wandering and thinking about the cube.
Wandering and thinking about the cube.

HediffDef.label: cube withdrawal
HediffDef.description: This person obsessively wants to find their golden cube. Their skin itches and their mind races, thinking of ways to get closer to the cube. Their symptoms will get worse until they play with the cube.

HediffDef.label: cube coma
HediffDef.description: This person was connected to a golden cube and then separated from it. Severing the link this way has put them in a coma.

HediffDef.label: cube anger
HediffDef.description: This person is upset that their cube sculptures have been destroyed. Continuing to destroy their sculptures may cause them to become violent.

li.overrideLetterDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} can no longer control {PAWN_possessive} anger. Too many of {PAWN_possessive} precious cube sculptures have been destroyed.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} has flown into a berserk rage!

HediffDef.label: void shock
HediffDef.description: This individual has witnessed the void. Their mind reels from the shock, overflowing with visions of infinite roiling, squirming, searing darkness stretching into the bottomless abyss from every surface and every screaming face.

HediffDef.label: brainwipe coma
HediffDef.description: This person has had their memories erased. The violent nature of the process has put them into a coma.

HediffDef.label: void touched
HediffDef.description: This person has seen the depths of the void and drank from its essence. It lives inside them still, guiding their actions and twisting their flesh. It has turned their hair brittle and white. They no longer need sleep or comfort. The void provides for them.

HediffDef.label: corpse torment
HediffDef.description: This person shares a psychic link with a corpse that appears to be their exact duplicate. They have done something to anger it, causing them to fall unconscious.

HediffDef.label: psychically dead
HediffDef.description: This person's psychic presence has been consumed and burned away, leaving them cut off from psychic phenomena.

HediffDef.label: psychophage
HediffDef.description: This person has devoured the psychic presence of another, making them more psychically sensitive for a period of time.

HediffDef.label: sleep suppression
HediffDef.description: This person's brain chemistry is being affected by a psychic pulsation, preventing the buildup of fatigue toxins. This reduces their need for sleep.

HediffDef.label: shard holder
HediffDef.description: This creature will drop a shard when defeated. This text is visible in dev mode only.

HediffDef.label: rage speed
HediffDef.description: This creature has been enraged by its wounds and is moving faster.

HediffDef.label: inhumanization
HediffDef.description: This person's mind is dominated by the psychic patterns of the void. They are completely disconnected from human concerns of family, friendship, and love. Their experience of reality is distant and muted, guided by the psychic rhythm of a dark hyperintelligence.

HediffDef.label: light exposure
HediffDef.description: Even the slightest exposure to light causes great discomfort to this creature, slowing it and weakening its attacks.

HediffDef.label: darkness exposure
HediffDef.description: This person is immersed in the unnatural darkness. Creatures or influences in the darkness will harm them if they stay too long.

HediffDef.label: bioferrite extracted
HediffDef.description: Bioferrite has been surgically removed from this entity. It will regenerate, but the process takes days.

HediffDef.Name: OrganDecayUndiagnosedBase
HediffDef.description: This person is showing early signs of a severe condition which will cause their organs to rapidly deteriorate. They will begin to display symptoms within a matter of days.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is showing early signs of a severe condition which will cause their organs to rapidly deteriorate. {SURGEON_nameDef} can't yet tell exactly what is causing this, but {PAWN_nameDef} will become very ill within the next few days.

HediffDef.label: digestion
HediffDef.description: This part has been digested.

HediffDef.label: energy bolt
HediffDef.description: A wound from an energy bolt.

HediffDef.label: psychic burn
HediffDef.description: A psychic burn.

HediffDef.label: psychic burn
HediffDef.description: A psychic burn.

HediffDef.label: psychic burn
HediffDef.description: A psychic burn.

HediffDef.label: shambler
HediffDef.description: This dead creature has been re-animated by corrupted archites. Shamblers are slow and mindless, and will attack relentlessly. After a few days on their feet, shamblers die from metabolic exhaustion. Captured shamblers can't move and thus won't expire.

HediffDef.label: rising
HediffDef.description: Mysterious archotechnological influences are reanimating this creature's corpse.

HediffDef.label: shambler corpse
HediffDef.description: This creature had previously been re-animated by corrupted archites.

HediffDef.label: ghoul
HediffDef.description:
This person has been implanted with an archotech shard, twisting them into a jittering murder machine. Its body is an amalgam of flesh and metal, while its mind cycles between half-conscious stupor and murderous intent.

They cannot work; they only fight. Ghouls must eat raw meat. If they go hungry, they can turn hostile.

Many find ghouls' constant twitching to be disturbing, even when they aren't killing someone.

HediffDef.label: meat hunger
HediffDef.description: This creature is ravenously hungry for raw meat. It may become hostile if it gets too hungry.

HediffDef.label: ghoul frenzy
HediffDef.description: This creature's blood is saturated with stress hormones and liquid energy, permitting it to move and attack at incredible speeds for a short time.

HediffDef.label: resurrection coma
HediffDef.description: A mixture of deadlife dust and advanced biochemicals course through this creature’s veins.

HediffDef.label: awoken unnatural corpse
HediffDef.description: The energy building within this corpse is erupting. It has risen and is attacking with increasing power and speed. It will not stop until it reaches its victim.

li.message: The unnatural corpse is moving faster!

HediffDef.label: rapid regeneration
HediffDef.description: This creature has stored an incredible amount of healing energy. While not unlimited, it will rapidly regenerate until its energy has been exhausted.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] went over the subject of [subjectDarkStudy].
askedAbout->tried to catch [RECIPIENT_nameDef] off-guard with questions about
identityTopic->[RECIPIENT_possessive] previous relationships with other factions
identityTopic->[RECIPIENT_possessive] emotional responses to disturbing situations
identityTopic->[RECIPIENT_possessive] reasons for joining [RECIPIENT_possessive] current faction
identityTopic->[RECIPIENT_possessive] role in a past significant event

JobDef.reportString: transferring TargetC to another holding location.

BiomeDef.label: labyrinth
BiomeDef.description: This place feels disconnected from any familiar environment. The heavy air and crushing silence create a pervasive sense of dread.

BiomeDef.label: metal hell
BiomeDef.description: The room is made entirely of gray metal with jagged and twisted shapes that seem to defy human comprehension. The air thrums with dirty energy, accented by the occasional creak of the grinding metal walls.

BiomeDef.label: undercave
BiomeDef.description: This cave is filled with the putrid stench of rotting flesh.

MemeDef.label: inhuman
MemeDef.description: Humanity is a barrier to our connection with the machine god and its pleasurable rewards.

MemeDef.label: ritualist
MemeDef.description: There is a greater energy in the universe. Through ritual we can understand it and harness its power.

MentalStateDef.label: dark visions
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {PAWN_nameDef}'s dark visions have stopped.
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} has become overwhelmed with horrible visions, rambling about things that only {PAWN_pronoun} can see. {PAWN_pronoun} will snap out of it in a few hours.

MentalStateDef.label: insane ramblings
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped rambling.
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} has become completely untethered from reality, ranting about impossible subjects. {PAWN_pronoun} will snap out of it in a few hours.

MentalStateDef.label: entity slayer
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer slaughtering random entities.
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} has snapped. {PAWN_pronoun} can no longer tolerate holding such dangerous entities in captivity and intends to destroy as many as {PAWN_pronoun} can.

MentalStateDef.label: entity liberator
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer freeing entities.
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} has become suddenly allured by a captive entity and is convinced it must be freed.

MentalStateDef.label: terrifying hallucinations
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer hallucinating.
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: Vivid hallucinations swirl around {0}, twisting and distorting allies into horrifying abominations. {PAWN_pronoun} will flee from anyone {PAWN_pronoun} perceives as a threat.

MentalStateDef.label: humanity break
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} has relinquished {PAWN_possessive} remaining ties to humanity and embraced {PAWN_possessive} ideology’s worship of the void. {PAWN_possessive} concern for health, family, friendship, and love have been broken.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} is now inhumanized, and will suffer a breakdown as {PAWN_pronoun} tries to grapple with {PAWN_possessive} new mental alignment.

MentalStateDef.Name: ManhunterBloodRain
MentalStateDef.label: manhunter
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0}'s manhunting bloodlust has come to an end.

MentalStateDef.label: cube sculpting
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {PAWN_nameDef}'s obsession with the cube has caused {PAWN_objective} to fall into a daze. {PAWN_pronoun} is going to build a sculpture to release the pressure growing in {PAWN_possessive} mind.
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} has finished {PAWN_possessive} cube structure.

MonolithLevelDef.levelInspectText: Twisting lines carved into the surface form a disturbing pattern.
MonolithLevelDef.activateGizmoDescription: Send a colonist to investigate the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.pawnSentToActivateMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} has been sent to investigate the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.activateQuestText: Send a colonist to investigate the monolith.

MonolithLevelDef.extraQuestDescription: You've activated the monolith. It is a conduit for psychic energy, just barely cracked open now. A mind of incomprehensible horror stirs on the other side, and is now touching our world.\n\nThe monolith seems to be partly active, and there seems to be no way to shut it down. To learn more you must activate it further, which will require some special research.
MonolithLevelDef.activateGizmoDescription: Send a colonist to attune the monolith.\n\nThis will attract new and more dangerous entities.
MonolithLevelDef.pawnSentToActivateMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} has been sent to attune the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.activateQuestText: Send a colonist to attune the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.activatableLetterText: You now have sufficient knowledge of void-related phenomena to attune the void monolith and further open its psychic conduit.\n\nThis will draw the attention of more dangerous anomalous entities.
MonolithLevelDef.activatedLetterText:
As the monolith twisted and changed, {PAWN_nameDef} was overcome with a horrifying vision. In an instant, {PAWN_pronoun} understood.

The monolith is a doorway, just barely cracked open now. Something dark beyond imagination stirs on the other side, seeping into our reality.

Terrified but excited, {PAWN_nameDef} is convinced {PAWN_pronoun} can learn more if given the time to study the monolith.

 - Building category unlocked: Anomaly
 - Research tab unlocked: Anomaly
 - Entity codex unlocked
 - You can now study the monolith and other entities to gain Anomaly research.

(*Gray)Note: You can adjust the percentage of major threats that will be Anomaly-related at any point in the storyteller settings.(/Gray)

MonolithLevelDef.extraQuestDescription: The monolith is a conduit to the void where a dark superintelligence processes endless vast dreams of rage and hate. You opened the conduit and it is now partially active. If you activate it further you can find a way to close it - or harness its power.
MonolithLevelDef.activateGizmoDescription: Send a colonist to wake the monolith. The psychic signature will be detectable for hundreds of miles and attract all manner of horrors. Make sure you are prepared.\n\nOnce fully awakened, the monolith will provide a direct link to the void.
MonolithLevelDef.pawnSentToActivateMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} has been sent to awaken the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.activateQuestText: Send a colonist to awaken the monolith.
MonolithLevelDef.activatableLetterText:
You now have enough knowledge of dark phenomena to fully awaken the void monolith, opening a two-way conduit to the void.

Be warned - once you begin awakening the void monolith, there is no going back. The process will shroud the region in unnatural darkness and manifest waves of horrifying entities.

Make sure your colony is well-lit and well-prepared.
MonolithLevelDef.activatedLetterText:
Attuning the monolith caused it to twist and grow once more. As it did, {PAWN_nameDef} caught a glimpse of what lurks beyond. {PAWN_pronoun} understood.

The monolith is a doorway, opened wider by your actions. On the other side, {PAWN_nameDef} sensed an inhuman intelligence of vast complexity and endless rage. The dark machine god is stirring, and its physical influence will grow.

 - New entities are now discoverable.

MonolithLevelDef.extraQuestDescription: The void has awoken. The gate is open. The darkness of the void rushes into our reality, manifested from a vast mind of endless rage.
MonolithLevelDef.activatedLetterText:
The sky darkens and a malevolent hum fills the air. The monolith has begun to awaken. Your actions have attracted the attention of something beyond human understanding.

Soon, structures of the void will begin manifesting into this reality. Activate the arriving void structures to fully awaken the monolith.

The first wave will appear shortly. Prepare yourself.

MonolithLevelDef.extraQuestDescription: The void has awoken. The gate is open. The darkness of the void rushes into our reality, manifested from a vast mind of endless rage.

MonolithLevelDef.monolithDescription: The remnants of the monolith which linked our world to the void lie broken. The twisted patterns that once writhed across its surface are now motionless. You can study the broken stones to gain further knowledge of the void phenomena.

MutantDef.Name: BaseShambler
MutantDef.label: shambler
MutantDef.description:
A creature who has been raised from the dead by corrupted nano-scale archites.

About shamblers: Shamblers are corpses which have been reanimated by archotechnology. They attack living creatures relentlessly and their immunity to pain makes them difficult to kill. However, the archites which animate them cannot sustain the rotting body for long, so shamblers expire after a few days of movement.

There are ways to raise your own shamblers and make yourself invisible to them, so they attack only outsiders.

MutantDef.label: ghoul
MutantDef.description:
A person who has been turned into a ghoul.

About ghouls: Ghouls are engineered murder machines, twisted by dark psychic influences.

Ghouls are very dangerous in melee combat. However, the process of their creation leaves them incapable of higher levels of thought, preventing them from holding weapons or tools. They cannot work and outside combat they wander in a half-conscious stupor.

Many people find the constant twitching of ghouls disturbing. More disturbing is their dependence on raw meat. If they go hungry they will turn hostile, even attacking their creators to sate their hunger.
MutantDef.deathLetter: One of your ghouls has died.
MutantDef.deathLetterExtra: Unlike regular colonists, ghouls do not need to be buried and their death will not upset others. You may choose to bury them should you wish.

PawnsArrivalModeDef.textEnemy: A group of {0} from {1} have arrived from nearby.
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textFriendly: A group of friendly {0} from {1} have arrived nearby.

PawnsArrivalModeDef.textEnemy: A horde of {0} shambling, rotting corpses is approaching.
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textWillArrive: A horde of {0} shambling, rotting corpses are about to arrive.

PawnsArrivalModeDef.textEnemy: A group of {0} have arrived from nearby.
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textFriendly: A group of friendly {0} have arrived nearby.

PitGateIncidentDef.label: fleshbeast emergence
PitGateIncidentDef.letterText: A horde of fleshbeasts is emerging from the pit gate. Get ready!

PreceptDef.label: required
PreceptDef.description: Human morality and feeling are a distraction. We must leave humanity behind.\n\nMental breaks will cause followers to become inhumanized.

li.label: human shame
li.description: I’m ashamed of my humanity. I want to embrace the void but I fear it.

PreceptDef.label: abhorrent
PreceptDef.description: Psychic rituals are utterly evil.

li.description: Participate in psychic ritual

PreceptDef.label: disapproved
PreceptDef.description: Psychic rituals should be avoided when possible.

PreceptDef.label: exalted
PreceptDef.description: Connecting with psychic flows brings us closer to truth.

li.description: No psychic ritual for {DURATION}

li.label: psychic ritual performed
li.description: To use such filthy rituals shows we are among the most base of creatures. We have lowered ourselves so much.

li.label: involved in psychic ritual
li.description: I have touched the filthy psychic power below space. I am disgusted with myself.

li.label: psychic ritual performed
li.description: We shouldn't be using such dark powers. It's just not right.

li.label: involved in psychic ritual
li.description: That ritual was wrong. I should not have been there.

li.label: involved in psychic ritual
li.description: It was an amazing experience to truly connect with something greater than myself.

li.label: no psychic rituals
li.description: Failing to use these rituals shows everyone how misguided we are.

PreceptDef.label: very inefficient
PreceptDef.description: All this void nonsense is superstition. Let's focus on reality.

PreceptDef.label: inefficient
PreceptDef.description: Trying to understand the unknowable is pointless. We should focus on more meaningful activities.

PreceptDef.label: efficient
PreceptDef.description: The void is a true mystery that deserves to be studied.

PreceptDef.label: very efficient
PreceptDef.description: The void is the ultimate truth.

IdeoPresetDef.label: void followers
IdeoPresetDef.description: There is no truth except the void. Let us learn its secrets and bathe in the endless black ocean.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: study
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Researchers interact with them to gain knowledge.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: interrogate
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: Wardens will interrogate the prisoner and watch their reactions to try to determine if they are who they say they are. The chance of detecting an imposter increases with the warden's social interaction ability. There is always a chance the imposter goes unnoticed.

PsychicRitualRoleDef.Name: ChanterBase
PsychicRitualRoleDef.label: chanter
PsychicRitualRoleDef.description: Chanters add psychic power to the ritual.

PsychicRitualRoleDef.label: defenders
PsychicRitualRoleDef.description: Defenders protect the ritual participants from harm.
PsychicRitualRoleDef.allowedConditions: Default, Sleeping, Downed, Bleeding, Burning, NoPsychicSensitivity

PsychicRitualRoleDef_DeathRefusalTarget.label: target
PsychicRitualRoleDef_DeathRefusalTarget.psychicRitualLeaveReason_MaxDeathRefusal: {PAWN_labelShort} cannot have any more death refusals stacked

PsychicRitualDef_VoidProvocation.label: void provocation
PsychicRitualDef_VoidProvocation.description: Psychically commune with the void, attracting an entity which can be captured and studied. There’s a chance that the invoker will fall into a coma for several hours.
PsychicRitualDef_VoidProvocation.outcomeDescription: With the current quality, there's a {0} chance the invoker will receive dark psychic shock.

PsychicRitualDef_ImbueDeathRefusal.label: imbue death refusal
PsychicRitualDef_ImbueDeathRefusal.description: Link a target with a distant archotechnological engine that can bring them back from the dead in seconds. This process is not without side-effects.
PsychicRitualDef_ImbueDeathRefusal.outcomeDescription: The target will gain death refusal.\n\nWith the current quality, all the target's skills will also be reduced by {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_Philophagy.label: philophagy
PsychicRitualDef_Philophagy.description: Psychically draw experiences from the victim's mind and transfer them to the invoker, targeting the victim's highest skill. The target will suffer brain damage, causing them to fall into a coma for several days.
PsychicRitualDef_Philophagy.outcomeDescription: With the current ritual quality, the invoker will steal {0} of the target's XP in their best skill.\n\nThe target will suffer brain damage and fall into a coma.

PsychicRitualDef_SummonAnimals.label: draw animals
PsychicRitualDef_SummonAnimals.description: Create a psychic pulse which will draw a distant herd of animals into the local area. You can then hunt or make use of them as you choose. If not done correctly, this may attract scaria-infected manhunters.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonAnimals.outcomeDescription: With the current ritual quality, there is a {0} chance that the animals will arrive as manhunters.

PsychicRitualDef_SummonShamblers.label: draw shamblers
PsychicRitualDef_SummonShamblers.description: Create a psychic pulse which will draw a distant horde of animated corpses towards your local area. While they attack any humans that they see, they won't attack your colony directly. You can capture them for study.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonShamblers.outcomeDescription: The higher the ritual quality, the more shamblers that will be summoned.

PsychicRitualDef_SummonPitGate.label: provoke pit gate
PsychicRitualDef_SummonPitGate.description: Use a psychic pulse to provoke underground fleshbeasts into opening a massive pit gate in the ground somewhere in the local area. The massive sinkhole will lead down to a fleshbeast-infested cavern which can be explored for resources.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonPitGate.outcomeDescription: A higher-quality ritual will attract more fleshbeasts. The fleshbeasts can be captured and studied, or butchered for twisted meat.

PsychicRitualDef_Chronophagy.label: chronophagy
PsychicRitualDef_Chronophagy.description: Induce a distant archotech to transfer entropy from one person to another. This causes the target to age rapidly while the invoker becomes younger, potentially healing scarring or age-related illnesses. The target will suffer brain damage, causing them to fall into a coma for several days.
PsychicRitualDef_Chronophagy.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the invoker will become {0} years younger and the target will become {1} years older.\n\nThe target will suffer brain damage and fall into a coma.

PsychicRitualDef_PleasurePulse.label: pleasure pulse
PsychicRitualDef_PleasurePulse.description: Emit an intense psychic pulse that makes any psychically sensitive individual in the region happier but reduces their desire to work. This will replace the effect of other active pulses.
PsychicRitualDef_PleasurePulse.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the effect will last for {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_NeurosisPulse.label: neurosis pulse
PsychicRitualDef_NeurosisPulse.description: Emit an intense psychic pulse that makes any psychically sensitive individual in the region work faster but become more irritable. Those affected will feel less need for recreation but will be unhappier and more likely to have a mental break. This will replace the effect of other active pulses.
PsychicRitualDef_NeurosisPulse.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the effect will last for {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_BloodRain.label: blood rain
PsychicRitualDef_BloodRain.description: Cast a ritual which causes blood-like psychofluid to fall from the sky. The fluid will slowly drive exposed humans and animals into a berserk frenzy. Traits and psychic sensitivity modulate the effect.
PsychicRitualDef_BloodRain.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the blood rain will last for {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_Brainwipe.label: brainwipe
PsychicRitualDef_Brainwipe.description: Erase a person's memories. Traumatic events will be forgotten. Prisoners will forget their allegiance and become easier to recruit, even if they were unwavering before. Inhumanized individuals will forget their connection to the void. Unfortunately, the disruptive effect of the ritual will induce a coma that could last a long time, especially if the ritual is of poor quality.
PsychicRitualDef_Brainwipe.outcomeDescription: The target will be brainwiped.\n\nWith the current ritual quality, the target will also enter a coma for {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_Psychophagy.label: psychophagy
PsychicRitualDef_Psychophagy.description: Consume the psychic sensitivity of a target. The invoker will increase their psychic sensitivity for a period of time. The effect does not stack. The target will suffer brain damage, causing them to fall into a coma for several days.
PsychicRitualDef_Psychophagy.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the invoker will increase their psychic sensitivity for {0}.\n\nThe target will suffer brain damage and fall into a coma.

PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbduction.label: skip abduction
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbduction.description: Teleport a random hostile person to the ritual location and place them in a coma.
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbduction.outcomeDescription: The target will be teleported to the invoker's location and fall into a coma.
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbduction.letterAICompleteText: {PAWN_nameDef} has been abducted by the cultists!
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbduction.letterAIArrivedText: They intend to use a psychic ritual to abduct a colonist via teleportation.

PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbductionPlayer.label: skip abduction
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbductionPlayer.description: Abduct a random hostile person from anywhere in the world, prioritizing those nearby. The ritual induces a dark archotech to warp space, teleporting a distant person to the center of the ritual circle. The process causes the target to fall into a short coma.
PsychicRitualDef_SkipAbductionPlayer.outcomeDescription: At the current ritual quality, the target will remain in a coma for {0}.

PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeasts.label: draw fleshbeasts
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeasts.description: Create a psychic pulse which will draw fleshbeasts to dig upwards and emerge near your enemies. They will attack anyone they find, including your enemies and allies. The fleshbeasts can be captured and studied, or butchered for twisted meat.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeasts.outcomeDescription: Create a psychic pulse which will draw a horde of fleshbeasts.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeasts.letterAICompleteText: Fleshbeasts are clawing their way out of the ground. Prepare for their attack!
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeasts.letterAIArrivedText: They intend to use a psychic ritual to summon hideous fleshbeasts to attack you.

PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeastsPlayer.label: draw fleshbeasts
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeastsPlayer.description: Create a psychic pulse which will draw fleshbeasts to dig upwards and emerge near your enemies. They will attack anyone they find, including your enemies and allies. The fleshbeasts can be captured and studied, or butchered for twisted meat.
PsychicRitualDef_SummonFleshbeastsPlayer.outcomeDescription: A higher quality ritual will attract more fleshbeasts.

rulesStrings.li:
questDescription->You've intercepted a distress signal from a nearby camp of [faction_name].

The frantic voice begged for immediate assistance defending against a threat, and offered everything at their camp, including recently discovered shards of archotechnology, to whoever is willing to come help.

As the speaker tried to explain the nature of the threat, the signal went dead.
darknessStartedLetterText->An unnatural darkness has descended. Inhuman things move just outside the light. Keep colonists in well-lit areas.

structuresArrivingAlertExplanation->The boundary between our world and the void is breaking down. Soon, void structures will manifest nearby. To fully awaken the void monolith, you must activate them.\n\nPrepare for their arrival.

voidStructuresLetterText->Several twisted structures are appearing, seemingly from nowhere. They pulse with a dark psychic energy which wilts nearby plant life.\n\nActivate the structures to progress further.
gleamingMonolithWarningLetterText->The monolith's shape has begun to distort and shift with growing intensity. Something is about to happen...

gleamingMonolithLetterText->The monolith has fully awakened. A swirling dark vortex sits atop its peak, forming a conduit to the void.\n\nGo to the monolith and use it to pass through to the other side. Doing so will end the unnatural darkness and end the horror assault.
monolithTwistingAlertExplanation->The monolith is twisting without moving, bending itself and the minds of those who look at it. Something is happening - get ready.

questDescription->Your colonists all feel a psychic message echoing. It's a signal from an inhuman, twisted mind that was left behind somewhere far away. You can focus on the signal and echo it back, but you can't tell what will happen if you do.

questDescription(askerIsNull==true)->An anonymous AI has reached out with an odd request. It would like you to accept some unspecified cargo. It avoids all your questions about the cargo.\n\nIf you accept, it will deliver the mystery cargo by transport pod.

questDescription(asker_factionLeader==true)->[asker_faction_leaderTitle] [asker_nameFull] of [asker_faction_name] has an odd request. [asker_pronoun] would like you to accept some unspecified cargo. When pressed for more details, [asker_pronoun] avoids the question. There is desperation in [asker_possessive] voice.\n\nIf you accept, [asker_nameFull] will deliver the mystery cargo by transport pod.

questDescription(asker_royalInCurrentFaction==true)->[asker_nameFull], a [asker_royalTitleInCurrentFaction] of [asker_faction_name] has an odd request. [asker_pronoun] demands that you accept some unspecified cargo. When pressed for more details, [asker_pronoun] avoids the question. There is desperation in [asker_possessive] voice.\n\nIf you accept, [asker_nameFull] will deliver the mystery cargo by transport pod.

deliveredLetterText(pawnOnMap==true)->The mysterious cargo has been delivered. It appears to be a human corpse.

On further inspection, the corpse looks identical to [pawn_nameDef]. Its skin feels waxy and warm to the touch. [pawn_nameDef] is deeply unsettled by its presence.

Study the corpse to learn more about it.

deliveredLetterText(pawnOnMap==false)->The mysterious cargo has been delivered. It appears to be a human corpse.

On further inspection, the corpse looks identical to [pawn_nameDef]. Its skin feels waxy and warm to the touch. [pawn_nameDef] will be deeply unsettled by its presence.

Study the corpse to learn more about it.

deliveredLetterText(pawnOnMap==true)->The mysterious cargo has been delivered. It is a simple cube that shines like gold but is impossible to scratch. It is light and warm to the touch. The way light plays across its surface is captivating.\n\n[pawn_nameDef] feels inexplicably drawn to the cube.

deliveredLetterText(pawnOnMap==false)->The mysterious cargo has been delivered. It is a simple cube that shines like gold but is impossible to scratch. It is light and warm to the touch. The way light plays across its surface is captivating.

deliveredLetterText->The mysterious cargo has been delivered. It resembles a thick, jagged human spine made out of a rough-cast black metal. It looks like it's covered in a dark fluid.\n\nThe spine vibrates in response to touch and twists angrily. You can study it on a holding platform to learn more.
questDescription->A transport pod crashes with a ghoul

initialPhaseLetterText->The sky is dimming. Soon it will be hard to see anything that isn't directly lit by lamps or torches.\n\nBuild well-lit areas to survive. Craft disruptor flare packs to explore the darkness.

mainPhaseLetterText->An unnatural darkness is descending. Inhuman things move just outside the light.

Pillars of jagged, oily metal are falling from the sky. They are terrible to look upon but surely contain valuable technology. Reach them by building well-lit paths - and destroy them to end this nightmare.

Alternatively, if you can survive long enough, the darkness will dissipate on its own.
darknessLiftedLetterText->The unnatural darkness has begun to dissipate. The metallic pillars have somehow folded into themselves and vanished. You survived!

RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextEnemy: They intend to perform {RITUAL_definite} ritual. Interrupt them before they can complete it. If they aren't stopped they may invoke the ritual multiple times.
Some unnatural force is animating these lifeless corpses. They are intent on attacking your colony. As they exhaust their strange energy, they will begin to collapse within hours.

RecipeDef.label: incubate bioferrite
RecipeDef.description: Process a corpse in order to incubate a batch of bioferrite from archites seeded into the flesh and nervous tissue.

RecipeDef.label: bliss lobotomy
RecipeDef.description: Remove part of a person's brain, placing them in a state of bliss while rendering them incapable of intellectual and skilled labor. They will also learn more slowly, and be less likely to rebel or attempt a prison break.

RecipeDef.label: ghoul infusion
RecipeDef.description: Infuse a living person with an archotech shard to create a terrifying creature known as a ghoul. Ghouls are ferocious melee fighters and are incapable of work. They eat raw meat to survive but never sleep. Hungry ghouls are dangerous.\n\nGhouls created by this operation will be a part of your colony.

RecipeDef.label: surgical inspection
RecipeDef.description: An invasive surgery to find any hidden abnormalities within a patient.

RecordDef.label: kills (entities)
RecordDef.description: The number of entities I have killed.

RecordDef.label: enemies downed (entities)
RecordDef.description: The number of entities I have downed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioferrite extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extract bioferrite directly from captured entities. Use it to craft weapons and apparel at a crafting spot or bioferrite shaper.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->extracted an organic compound from a rapidly mutating flesh sample
subject_story->stripped and boiled the flesh of a harbinger tree
subject_story->investigated reports of an archotech phenomenon

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioferrite harvester
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build bioferrite harvesters that automatically extract bioferrite from captured entities. Produces more bioferrite than manual extraction.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->investigated an exotic metal-like fibrous substance
subject_story->discovered a cache of organic metals

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioferrite shaping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Shape and re-form bioferrite into useful tools, weapons, flooring, and more.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->learned unique techniques for molding and sculpting
subject_story->worked in an exotic materials foundry
subject_story->studied the formation of archotech artefacts

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioferrite weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Create advanced weapons that use bioferrite as a fuel source.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->worked for an extraction rig on an archotech asteroid
subject_story->researched the combustion points of exotic materials
subject_story->joined the research arm of a milword weapons corp
subject_story->cleared biomines in an archotech desert

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioferrite generator
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build power generators that burn bioferrite as a fuel.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->was trained in the use of innovative power sources
subject_story->explored the use of metal- and fibre-based fuels
subject_story->discovered a love of fire and things that burn
subject_story->worked as a technician, maintaining orbital energy systems
subject_story->rendered the wildlife of a system down for fuel

ResearchProjectDef.label: void sculptures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft special void sculptures from bioferrite to enhance the quality of psychic rituals.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->was employed by a sibyl to sculpt her dreams
subject_story->wanted to bring sculptures to life
subject_story->dreamed of an endless ocean, shaped by human hands

ResearchProjectDef.label: insanity weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that shock, manipulate, and destroy enemies using archotechnology.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->watched an Imperial battalion rout and learned the value of fear
subject_story->worked in an asylum of archotech victims
subject_story->vivisected archite-infested wildlife to understand the effects on the mammalian brain

ResearchProjectDef.label: mutation weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that twist living targets into terrifying creatures.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->dreamed of new life, infused with archites
subject_story->studied new life on transcendent worlds
subject_story->grew archite-based life in the laboratory

ResearchProjectDef.label: atmospheric heater
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build bioferrite-powered heaters that produce enough heat to warm an entire region.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->studied the heat output of biometals
subject_story->researched the impossible capacity of archotech energy storage
subject_story->examined the hypocaust systems on densely occupied iceworlds

ResearchProjectDef.label: frenzy inducer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build shard-powered structures that generate a frenetic psychic field to make anyone nearby move and work faster. However, the unstable emotional energy creates a tendency towards violence, irritating anyone nearby.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->beat the drums on a feralworld galley
subject_story->researched the effects of varied archofields on human consciousness
subject_story->managed a trance station in an urbworld underclub

ResearchProjectDef.label: sleep suppressor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build shard-powered structures that stimulate those nearby to prevent fatigue. The device will irritate anyone nearby.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->studied sleep deprivation in factory workers
subject_story->researched stimulant use among Imperial troopers
subject_story->researched the effects of varied archofields on human consciousness
subject_story->worked in a glitterworld eversleep lab, where the wealthy dreamed their lives away
subject_story->managed the reveille at a prisonworld work camp

ResearchProjectDef.label: entity containment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build holding platforms and inhibitors to better contain entities.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->worked in a prisonworld research facility
subject_story->was held captive on a prisonworld
subject_story->worked with a guerilla movement to breach holding facilities
subject_story->constructed meatpacking plants in the dinoworld chains

ResearchProjectDef.label: electroharvester
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a generator that draws electricity from contained entities. This process aggravates entities, making them harder to contain.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->researched ion pumps in cell membranes
subject_story->studied the life of the rare Terran electric eel

ScenarioDef.label: The Anomaly
ScenarioDef.description: Your research expedition has finally arrived at the source of the anomalous signal: an ancient archotech monolith on a distant planet. As you survey the structure from orbit, the scanner's audio feed forms garbled syllables which repeat your own name over and over. Your crewmate screams as her flesh begins flowing and reforming. A blinding beam of energy reaches up from the planet and tears your research vessel apart. You have disturbed something ancient and inhuman.\n\nNote: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.

scenario.summary: Three researchers and a ghoul investigate an ancient monolith.

li.text: The ancient monolith unleashed an energy pulse that tore your research vessel apart and mutated your crew. Only a few of you made it to the escape pods.\n\nDespite the setback, your mission is far from over. If you can learn more about the monolith, perhaps you can find a way to shut it down - or harness its inhuman power.

li.customSummary: Start with one ghoul and three colonists.

SitePartDef.Name: DistressCallBase
SitePartDef.label: {FACTION_name} distress signal
SitePartDef.description: You've intercepted a distress signal from this outpost. The threat is unknown, but the caller offered everything in the camp as a reward for help.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow unnatural corpses
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow strange and unnatural dead bodies.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: anomaly research
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow books with information that advances anomaly research.

StatDef.label: containment strength
StatDef.description: How securely this can contain an entity. This is improved by stronger walls and doors, more light, fewer other entities in the room, and special containment devices. Some entities are easier to contain in cold temperatures.

StatDef.label: min containment strength
StatDef.description: The containment strength needed to contain this entity properly. An entity in a chamber below its minimum containment strength will have a very high chance to escape.

StatDef.label: cold containment bonus
StatDef.description: This entity is less likely to escape if kept in a very cold room.

StatDef.label: entity study rate
StatDef.description: The rate at which this person generates knowledge from studying unnatural entities.

StatDef.label: study efficiency
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how much knowledge a person gets when studying unnatural entities.

StatDef.label: activity suppression speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person can suppress unnatural entities. A higher speed means they take less time to suppress each entity.

StatDef.label: psychic ritual quality
StatDef.description: How much nearby buildings improve quality of psychic rituals performed here.

StatDef.label: psychic ritual quality offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to psychic ritual quality when this person participates. The total quality offset is divided by the total number of participants.

IncidentDef.Name: ObeliskBase
IncidentDef.letterText:
A mysterious obelisk has crashed nearby.

The obelisk hums with putrid psychic energy, gradually intensifying as it approaches some dangerous limit. You can send colonists to suppress the obelisk to prevent it from activating.

You can also mark the obelisk for study to try to learn its purpose and perhaps make use of it.

You can always attack the obelisk to destroy it, but doing so may unleash unnatural and dangerous phenomena.

IncidentDef.label: nociosphere
IncidentDef.letterText:
A strange metallic sphere has appeared. It hurts to be near it.

You could attack it, though you're not sure how it might defend itself. Or, you could capture it using a holding platform and learn to make use of its power.

It seems quiet for now, but it is gaining energy over time. You can suppress the sphere when it is captured to a holding platform, reducing its energy.

IncidentDef.label: pit gate
IncidentDef.letterText: A wide piece of terrain has begun sinking into the depths, forming a deepening hole. At this rate, it will deepen out of sight within a day. You can hear inhuman shrieks rising from the depths.\n\nMove buildings and items away from the emergence point.

IncidentDef.label: fleshmass heart
IncidentDef.letterText: A small circle of terrain has begun to shift and crack apart. Something is digging up towards the surface. Rhythmic pulsations shake the ground from underneath.

IncidentDef.label: revenant emergence
IncidentDef.letterText: The revenant spine is becoming more active and emitting an ominous hum. Destroy it or restrain it on a holding platform before it's too late.

IncidentDef.label: harbinger tree
IncidentDef.letterText: A harbinger tree has sprouted nearby. These gnarled trees grow flesh-like coverings, and can feed on corpses and raw meat placed nearby. If well fed, the grove will continue to grow.\n\nIn a tribal myth, these trees are the emissaries of a shapeless god who rules an endless black ocean. The myth ends after the shapeless god reaches up from the water and tears down the sky.
